reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/21/four-soldiers-seven-suspects-killed-chapo-isidro-capture/) reported that four soldiers and seven suspects were killed in the capture operation.

On 21 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-mexico-captures-drug-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-after-deadly-firefight), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/21/video-shows-mexican-forces-capturing-el-chapo-isidro-fbi-most-wanted-cartel-boss) reported that Mexican military forces captured suspected drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, during a raid in Sinaloa.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/detencion-de-chapo-isidro-deja-11-muertos-y-8-detenidos-en-sinaloa-33248169), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/mueren-7-agresores-y-4-militares-durante-captura-de-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-harfuch-lamenta-deceso-de-soldados/) reported that four military personnel and seven criminals died during the capture operation.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/rfi/capturan-sinaloa-mexico-chapo-isidro-uno-narcotraficantes-buscados-fbi_1795275150) reported that Mexican forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, in Sinaloa.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/mexico-captures-fbi-wanted-cartel-boss-in-military-raid?traffic_source=rss) reported that Mexico's military captured FBI-wanted cartel leader El Chapo Isidro in a military raid in Guasave, Sinaloa.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/chapo-isidro-podria-enfrentar-pena-de-muerte-en-estados-unidos-por-narcoterrorismo-33247698) reported that Fausto Isidro N, detained in Guasave, Sinaloa, faces an extradition order and accusations in the United States for narcoterrorism, support for terrorism, and criminal enterprise.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/reconoce-embajador-de-eu-a-fuerzas-mexicanas-por-la-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-33246876) reported that the US ambassador recognized Mexican forces for the capture of El Chapo Isidro and stated the US contributed with intelligence and information exchange.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-fuerzas-estatales-y-federales-mantienen-vigilancia-en-guasave-situacion-bajo-control-graciela-dominguez/) reported that state and federal forces maintained surveillance in Guasave following the capture of El Chapo Isidro.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/who-is-el-chapo-isidro-the-alleged-cartel-boss-arrested-in-mexico?traffic_source=rss) reported that Mexican forces arrested Chapo Isidro in Sinaloa.

On 21 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxNYTFlMEtKYm1odmQ4dzRLQ0JFd3N6cnlhR1dDeTdhT1RoWHQtYzIxU2RJTDJDc1phM0EzN1duaHdvU2xBVlJqRmN2UHZtNjh1NTRoX25BQndKNTlSX2pIQm5hYkRlYmNxamQ3V0R0RzVhdEFvemdIQi02VGtkYzg1THZNeTY0VFZHQXQtcjhiX3FNbmwz?oc=5) reported that the detention of El Chapo Isidro set off a burst of violence in Sinaloa.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/quienes-son-serafin-y-jose-n-los-otros-detenidos-en-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro-garcia-harfuch-destaca-capturas/) reported that the Defense Ministry released a video of the detention of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores and highlighted other arrests.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/zar-antidrogas-de-trump-destaca-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-es-una-victoria-para-estados-unidos-y-mexico/) reported that Trump's drug czar highlighted the capture of El Chapo Isidro as a victory for the United States and Mexico.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/suspected-cartel-leader-el-chapo-isidro-from-fbi-most-wanted-list-captured-in-mexico-13614689) reported that suspected cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, has been captured from the FBI most-wanted list.

On 21 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/0fb4e485c575) reported that the Defence Ministry said the arrest followed intelligence cooperation with the US, and armed clashes and roadblocks were reported across Sinaloa state.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mexico/capturan-en-mexico-a-el-chapo-isidro-uno-de-los-diez-fugitivos-mas-buscados-por-el-fbi-durante-operativo-en-sinaloa-3602961) reported that the US offered a reward of five million dollars for information leading to his localization.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/21/governo-do-mexico-confirma-captura-de-um-dos-dez-criminosos-mais-procurados-pelo-fbi.ghtml) reported that Mexican army special forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro and leader of the Guasave Cartel.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mexican-drug-lord-felix-gallardo-dies-at-80/a-79954351?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Felix Gallardo died of multiple organ failure at the age of 80.
On 16 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/16/politica/021n1pol?partner=rss) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the Country 2000 private hospital.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/poco-a-poco-hay-que-darle-tiempo-cuando-felix-gallardo-pidio-confiar-en-amlo-para-combatir-la-violencia-en-mexico/) reported that drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the age of 80 after spending 37 years in prison.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/el-sacrificio-de-kiki-nunca-sera-olvidado-terry-cole-jefe-de-la-dea-reacciona-a-muerte-de-felix-gallardo/) reported that DEA chief Terry Cole reacted to the death of Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, stating that Kiki Camarena's sacrifice will never be forgotten.

On 16 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/world/americas/felix-gallardo-mexico-dead.html) reported that Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, who helped build the foundations of modern-day drug empires, died in prison.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/mexico-notorious-drug-lord-felix-gallardo-dies/) reported that Mexican drug lord Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo died at the age of 80 in a hospital due to multiple organ failure.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/felix-gallardo-el-capo-que-hacia-valer-su-jerarquia-en-el-altiplano-33152474) reported that Israel Vallarta's book portrays Felix Gallardo in prison as a reclusive, nearly blind man in deteriorating health.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261115-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-mexican-drug-lord-dies), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mexicos-guadalajara-cartel-founder-dies-hospital-aged-80) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a founder of Mexico’s Guadalajara cartel known as the 'boss of bosses', died in a hospital on Sunday at the age of 80 after spending nearly four decades in prison.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/founder-of-guadalajara-cartel-dies-in-hospital-after-decades-in-prison?traffic_source=rss) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo was convicted of the 1985 murder of a US drug enforcement agent and a Mexican pilot.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/15/notorious-mexican-drug-lord-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-dies/), [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/muere-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-el-jefe-de-jefes-fundador-del-cartel-de-guadalajara-33150574) reported that notorious Mexican drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the age of 80 in a hospital in Guadalajara.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/muere-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-el-jefe-de-jefes-fundador-del-cartel-de-guadalajara-fallece-a-los-80-anos/) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo was the founder of the Guadalajara Cartel and was serving a 77-year sentence for drug trafficking and the murder of DEA agent Enrique Camarena.

reports.text: On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/microsoft-blames-outage-software-defect-introduced-july/) reported that Microsoft blamed a costly outage of its 365 services on complications related to a software defect introduced in July.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-says-bug-undetected-in-data-centres-since-july-triggered-worldwide-outage-101794878116415.html) reported that Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president, noted that the incident was caused by three main factors triggering a global outage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/microsoft-global-outage-cause) reported that Microsoft identified a months-old bug, malfunctioning internal connections, and server capacity as root causes of the global outage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outlook-outage-blames-hidden-server-defect-increased-traffic-and-reduced-capacity-101794851196756.html) reported that Microsoft apologized for the global Outlook outage and blamed a hidden server defect, increased network traffic, and reduced server capacity.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/microsoft-announces-the-full-restoration-of-its-service-after-the-technical-crash/) reported that technology company Microsoft announced the full restoration of its services following a technical crash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/microsoft-s-widespread-outages-caused-global-chaos-including-in-the-healthcasre-industry) reported that Microsoft stated it is seeing improvements in service availability after an hours-long disruption affecting platforms including Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/massive-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-schools-and-governments-around-the-world/) reported that a massive Microsoft outage disrupted businesses, schools, and governments globally by cutting access to Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/Microsoft-apologizes-for-global-outage-rules-out-cyberattack-1S3I9qOB6F2/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Microsoft apologized for a global outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/14/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outage-and-rules-out-cyberattack/) reported that Microsoft stated service has been restored across Teams, Outlook, and other products.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-restablece-totalmente-su-servicio-tras-la-caida-tecnica-33130869) reported that Microsoft fully restored its service after a technical outage caused by an error during a previous network capacity expansion.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-caida-a-nivel-mundial_0_r0vc83xCJ0.html) reported that the global outage left several products inoperative across 74 countries.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-su-caida-a-nivel-mundial-y-alerta-por-estafas-que-buscan-aprovechar-el-caos-3601146) reported an alert regarding scams attempting to exploit the technical chaos.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/workday-outage-disrupts-11-500-businesses-worldwide-walmart-target-workers-face-payroll-and-hr-access-issues-101794666114407.html) reported that a Workday technical failure disrupted HR and payroll access for companies including Walmart and Target.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b) reported that Microsoft stated it is working to recover email and other services affected in the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/13/microsoft-restores-services-after-a-global-outage-hit-outlook-and-teams-in-more-than-70-countries?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Microsoft stated its services were recovering after a global outage that began on Thursday afternoon.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-announces-service-restored-global-outage-over/) reported that Microsoft announced it has restored service to customers, drawing a close to a global outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/outlook-teams-copilot-microsoft-annonce-la-fin-de-la-panne-mondiale-apres-plus-de-24-heures-de-perturbations-20261114) reported that the American giant announced the restoration of all its services following a global disruption.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/microsoft-global-outage-down-nhs-b3084951.html) reported that Microsoft stated the disruption was due to a technical issue not related to cyber or AI agents.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/14/microsoft-says-services-fully-restored-after-global-outage) reported that operations were restored to all customers and regions affected by one of the worst IT failures in years.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-3725563) reported that Microsoft announced its consumer products and services fully recovered following a global outage affecting users in at least 70 countries.
On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqzjr903n01po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a server outage affected Microsoft services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that an Outlook outage hit users in 74 countries while Microsoft sought alternative solutions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-recovered/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident affecting consumer products services and ruled out AI as the cause.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-services-recovered-still-monitoring-enterprise-services/article71701075.ece) reported that the technology giant stated it was monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during the event before considering enterprise services.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261114-microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-business-services-improving) reported that Microsoft confirmed all services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications fully recovered, ending the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-loses-measles-free-status-as-cases-soar) reported that the United States lost its measles elimination status after 26 years due to failing to control rising cases.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/us-measles-elimination-status-experts) reported that doctors and public health leaders condemned damage by the Trump administration and called for RFK Jr. to resign after the U.S. lost its measles elimination status.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649012-us-loses-measles-elimination-status/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that the U.S., Mexico, and Bolivia lost their measles elimination status after 26 years due to prolonged outbreaks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bo-mx-us-lose-measles-elimination-status/) reported that Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States lost their measles elimination status after at least 12 months of uninterrupted transmission.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/retroceso-importante-tres-paises-perdieron-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-y-la-ops-advierte-sobre-el-nid17112026/) reported that the Pan American Health Organization noted the re-establishment of endemic measles virus transmission in the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/rfk-jr-measles-democrats.html) reported that incoming senators and prospective presidential candidates blamed the health secretary's history of vaccine skepticism for the rise of measles.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/mexico-bolivia-ee-uu-pierden-estatus-paises-libres-sarampion-registrar-miles-casos-decenas-muertes_1794939654) reported that Mexico, Bolivia, and the United States lost their measles-free status after recording thousands of cases and dozens of deaths.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-pierde-el-estatus-de-pais-libre-de-sarampion-tras-registrar-diez-muertes_0_kjl8snYN45.html) reported that the Pan American Health Organization revoked the United States status as a measles-free country following 10 deaths in 2026, while the CDC reported 5,412 cases this year.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-perdio-su-estatus-de-pais-libre-de-sarampion-despues-de-mas-de-20-anos-nid17112026/) reported that the United States lost its measles-free status after more than 20 years, having obtained the condition in 2000, and that the organization also removed Mexico and Bolivia from the list.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/mexico-busca-recuperar-certificacion-como-pais-libre-de-sarampion-en-2028-asi-es-el-plan-de-90-dias-para-alcanzarlo-33174690) reported that Health and Population Wellbeing Policy Undersecretary Rafael Valdéz stated Mexico has a 90-day plan to recover its certification as a measles-free country by 2028.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-y-mexico-pierden-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-dicen-funcionarios-internacionales-de-salud_0_7l6dxuGYZx.html), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/eu-mexico-y-bolivia-pierden-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-reporta-la-ops-virus-se-ha-propagado-principalmente-entre-personas-no-vacunadas/) reported that international health authorities stated the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia have lost their measles-free status.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-and-mexico-lose-measles-free-status/a-79973966?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261117-us-mexico-and-bolivia-lose-measles-free-status-as-deaths-mount) reported that Bolivia and Mexico also lost their measles-free status alongside the United States.

On 17 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-26-years/107397030) reported that the United States reported more than 5,400 measles cases this year.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-outbreak-vaccine-b3086570.html) reported that Mexico also lost its measles-elimination status following a virus resurgence there.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/life/us-reportedly-loses-measles-elimination-status-3725690) reported that an independent commission of the Pan American Health Organization voted to revoke the U.S. measles-elimination designation after finding continuous circulation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-26-years-as-virus-spreads-across-country/articleshow/135910807.cms) reported that the United States is no longer recognized as free of measles after witnessing a dramatic surge in cases.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/science-health/us-loses-measles-elimination-status/) reported that the CDC confirmed 5,412 measles cases in 2026, marking the highest number since 1991.

On 14 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-after-26-years-wsj-reports/a-79946974?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the Pan American Health Organization reportedly stripped the U.S. of its measles-elimination status after 26 years.
On 12 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/12/cdc-measles-deaths) reported that the CDC recorded six measles deaths in 2026 amidst the worst outbreak in 35 years.
On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914841) reported that the U.S. measles elimination status was revoked as the outbreak spread through 45 states.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQNmxORmhpLU9PVHl1bVFzT1A5QVhUVU5FWTM5Uzl3WDRJeWFvUXJVNWJxcmp1T3A5T2Z3MmlTMjJLUmVuZVRxa1VFWVFPbFZ2TnFBRlpNU3ZqOUpzczBTTzBkRXVaZ01oZEU5WGM4SzQ1ZTlBeFh0YnlMbzgzNHN4VFpTc3BiYXJMVEdkUHdFWFZKYV9vZzhHMUV4MjV6WGZjRndHSFlUczFvV2FIcFdPeHpYSQ?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-continued-spread-of-the-disease-report/article71700760.ece) reported that the Americas branch of the World Health Organization stated the U.S. lost its measles-free status after continued spread of the disease.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-leaves-asia-empty-handed-as-kim-snubs-meeting-overtures), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045915/why-kim-jong-un-didnt-meet-trump-despite-the-hype) reported that US President Donald Trump left Asia without meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong Un after knocking repeatedly for a meeting.

stories.title: COP31 Talks Enter Overtime Amid Deadlock Over Fossil Fuels And Climate Finance

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/tuvalu-warns-that-climate-negotiations-remain-deadlocked-at-cop31/) reported that the government of Tuvalu stated at COP31 that negotiations to reach an agreement remain deadlocked.

On 21 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/countries-race-to-secure-cop31-deal) reported that COP31 climate talks have overrun their schedule as countries race to agree on a new global climate deal following criticism of an earlier draft.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-climate-summit-risks-failure-talks-go-deep-overtime) reported that the COP31 climate summit risks failure as talks go deep into overtime.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/environment/2026/11/21/cop31-talks-deadlocked-as-eu-signals-willingness-to-walk-away-if-no-move-on-fossil-fuels/) reported that COP31 talks deadlocked as the EU signaled a willingness to walk away if there is no movement on fossil fuels, with a potential compromise excluding fossil fuel wording while deleting carbon capture support.

On 21 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-un-climate-summit-runs-into-overtime-as-deal-remains-elusive/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/cop31-talks-enter-overtime-amid-deadlock-over-fossil-fuels-and-climate-finance/) reported that negotiations at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Turkey, extended into Saturday following a deadlock among delegates.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/fossil-fuel-row-sees-cop31-talks-spill-into-overtime) reported that countries including France and Panama released a letter insisting that a deal include a clear transition away from fossil fuels.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/countries-race-to-secure-cop31-deal-after-fossil-fuel-row/) reported that the COP31 climate talks spilled into Saturday as countries raced to secure a deal after a draft text dropped all mention of fossil fuels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168845) reported that a group of countries from Europe, Africa, Latin America and the Pacific challenged the proposed COP31 agreement, demanding explicit action on fossil fuels.

On 21 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/environment/2026/1121/1600094-cop31-turkey/) reported that there are fears the COP31 climate talks in Turkey could end without a deal as a serious dispute over whether even to mention fossil fuels in the final agreement continues.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/cop31-deal-stalls-as-nations-struggle-to-agree-on-climate-plan?traffic_source=rss) reported that the COP31 deal stalled as nations struggled to agree on a climate plan.

On 20 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-20/COP31-talks-face-overrun-as-divisions-over-fossil-fuels-persist-1SdXA01OHZe/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that countries remained divided over fossil fuels, climate finance, and scientific assessments as the COP31 summit neared its conclusion.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/environment/20261120-un-climate-talks-run-into-overtime-as-countries-clash-over-fossil-fuel-cuts-cop31) reported that deep divisions over fossil fuels and financial support for poorer nations pushed the COP31 summit beyond its scheduled closing day.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/global-affairs/cop31-climate-talks-spill-into-overtime-as-nations-quarrel-over-fossil-fuels/) reported that the draft text dropped mention of a $120 billion target for climate finance.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/20/cop31-talks-overtime-fossil-fuels-vanish-from-draft-deal) reported that African ministers stated they did not come to beg while civil society groups called it the worst COP ever.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/news/cop31-turkey-fossil-fuel-transition-b3088614.html) reported that the Cop31 climate talks headed toward overtime due to a dispute over fossil fuels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-cop31-wrapping-up-in-turkey-climate-deal-elusive-as-fossil-fuels-go-unmentioned) reported that UN COP31 climate talks in Turkey spilled into overtime as countries remained deadlocked over a draft deal making no mention of fossil fuels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-delivers-deals-host-turkey-climate-diplomacy-stalls) reported that Turkey is set to emerge from COP31 with billions of dollars in investment deals as climate diplomacy stalls.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-outcry-as-fossil-fuels-scrubbed-from-draft-un-climate-deal) reported that UN climate talks co-host Australia unveiled a draft agreement dropping any mention of fossil fuels, sparking an outcry.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1120/1599970-cop31-turkey/) reported that former Irish President Mary Robinson stated the EU should reject a COP31 draft text that removed references to ending fossil fuel use.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/pala-tajna-mreza-nsa-net-preko-koje-americki-obavjestajci-razmjenjuju-povjerljive-informacije/261117240), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1088763/pala-tajna-mreza-nsa-net-americki-obavjestajci-ostali-bez-sistema-za-razmjenu-povjerljivih-informacija) reported that the internal communication network used by the United States National Security Agency (NSA Net) suffered an outage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNMktLaW5kdHVTN3VMZTk4bGp1WWZZZGVJLXFWa2QxOExBN25NdXNYd0F6RW1wZER4QTFDZHlZaWNpbURDdVk1UFBoT3N2ME5UcnIybFRyb0dsemJJbzNHQlJnd0lTSEs3LVJibVRCQjk1c2xNNFpHSTlia0VhRUNCbktOaWtOQlNhNzBvZURB?oc=5) reported that a defense official stated the classified communications network at the National Security Agency went down.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/staff-deserve-answers-eu-commission-cyberattack-union-says/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/european-commission-staff-criticise-lack-of-communication-over-cyberattack) reported that the main civil servants' union criticized senior management at the European Commission for a lack of communication and updates to staff regarding a recent cyberattack, leaving employees to learn of the breach from the press.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89352482) reported that internal human resources systems of the European Commission were targeted in an AI-assisted cyberattack.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/eu-confirms-it-was-targeted-in-cyberattack-through-use-of-ai-tools) reported that the European Commission confirmed it was targeted by a cyberattack through the use of AI tools.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/eu-commission-confirms-it-was-targeted-in-cyberattack-using-ai-tools/a-79993016?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/technology/2026/1119/1599850-eu-cyberattack/) reported that a spokesperson confirmed the European Commission was targeted by an AI-generated cybercampaign.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90639) reported that the cyberattack disrupted internal systems for more than 10 days and may have exposed staff data.

stories.title: Jair Bolsonaro hospitalised with abdominal pain while under house arrest
stories.label: Jair Bolsonaro hospitalized in Brasilia

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324608-moraes-autoriza-filhos-visitarem-bolsonaro-em-internacao.html) reported that Moraes authorized Carlos, Jair Renan, Laura, and the stepdaughter of former president Jair Bolsonaro to visit him in the hospital without mobile devices or other electronic equipment.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/expresidente-de-brasil-jair-bolsonaro-es-enviado-a-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-que-se-sabe-3603041) reported that treating doctors initiated clinical hydration, oral fasting with nutritional support, and placed a gastric tube for Jair Bolsonaro.

On 21 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/21/lex-presidente-del-brasile-jair-bolsonaro-ricoverato-in-terapia-intensiva_839ca9c3-f07e-4473-a141-0031f216f432.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the intensive care unit and is clinically stable, conscious, alert, and breathing spontaneously.

On 21 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-esta-internado-en-terapia-intensiva-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-y-podria-ser-nid21112026/) reported that a tomography scan detected an almost total small bowel obstruction and doctors are evaluating a possible new surgery.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/bolsonaro-esta-internado-na-uti-com-abdomen-obstruido-em-estado-estavel-e-sem-previsao-de-alta-diz-hospital.ghtml) reported that DF Star hospital stated former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro is in the intensive care unit with an obstructed abdomen in stable condition without a discharge date.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/moraes-autoriza-visita-de-filhos-de-bolsonaro-em-hospital-durante-internacao.ghtml) reported that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized daily hospital visits for Jair Bolsonaro's children but prohibited the use of mobile phones and other electronic devices during the visits.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-en-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-33247549) reported that Jair Bolsonaro is in intensive care due to an intestinal obstruction.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-internado-cuidados-intensivos-obstruccion-intestinal-dice-primer-parte-medico_0_IMGmDv1K84.html) reported that the former Brazilian president entered the hospital on Friday and there is no prediction for medical discharge.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/defesa-de-bolsonaro-pede-autorizacao-para-entrada-de-filhos-de-ex-presidente-no-hospital-durante-internacao.ghtml) reported that the defense of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro communicated with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes about Bolsonaro's hospitalization.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/jair-bolsonaro-hospitalised-with-abdominal-pain-while-under-house-arrest) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to hospital with abdominal pain while accompanied by military police.

On 21 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/21/former-brazilian-president-jair-bolsonaro-hospitalised-in-brasilia-with-abdominal-pain?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to a hospital in Brasília with abdominal pain and distension.

On 21 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-ex-president-jair-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-over-abdominal-pain/a-80007648?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to a hospital in Brasilia with intestinal obstruction.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/brazil-ex-president-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-with-abdominal-pain-son-says-3013246) reported that Jair Bolsonaro's son stated the condition was related to past injuries from a 2018 stabbing.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/brazils-jailed-ex-president-jair-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-son-alleges-psychological-torture/articleshow/136039037.cms) reported that Carlos Bolsonaro expressed concern for his father's well-being regarding his declining health condition.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/bolsonaro-e-internado-em-hospital-apos-episodio-de-dor-abdominal.ghtml) reported that former president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to the DF Star hospital in Brasília after experiencing severe abdominal pain.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324429-bolsonaro-e-internado-com-quadro-de-dor-e-distensao-abdominal.html) reported that Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to a hospital in Brasília with abdominal pain and distension while serving house arrest.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-expresidente-de-brasil-es-hospitalizado-por-fuertes-dolores-abdominales-33236011), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-expresidente-de-brasil-es-hospitalizado-de-nuevo-tiene-dolores-en-el-abdomen-dice-su-hijo-carlos/), [El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-20/hospitalizado-el-expresidente-jair-bolsonaro-con-dolores-abdominales-en-brasilia.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalized in Brasilia due to severe abdominal pains.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/bresil-jair-bolsonaro-quitte-sa-residence-surveillee-pour-l-hopital-en-raison-de-douleurs-abdominales-20261121) reported that Bolsonaro left his monitored residence for the hospital, having previously suffered injuries from a 2018 knife attack.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-hospitalizado-fuertes-dolores-abdominales-causados-obstruccion_1795222172), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-fue-internado-en-un-hospital-de-brasilia-tras-sufrir-un-fuerte-dolor-abdominal-nid20112026/) reported that Bolsonaro was admitted to the DF Star hospital and remains under house arrest.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/endurance-athlete-lewis-pugh-swims-in-strait-of-hormuz-to-highlight-iran-wars-impact-on-wildlife-3013343) reported that endurance athlete Lewis Pugh swam across the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to environmental threats and the impact of regional conflict on wildlife.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/uk-man-swims-strait-hormuz-highlight-environmental-damage) reported that a British endurance swimmer swam in the Strait of Hormuz and called for the waterway to be reopened and cleaned up.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249562/Non-compliant-tanker-blasts-after-hitting-mine-near-Oman-port) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps Navy Force stated an oil tanker attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz exploded after hitting a mine.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584814/another-oil-tanker-strikes-naval-mine-as-tensions-persist-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that an oil tanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz according to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915628) reported that one tanker was hit on its stern 11 nautical miles north of Khasab and another in its engine room 17 nautical miles east about 50 minutes later.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584935/gold-and-silver-prices-decline-further/) reported that gold and silver prices recorded further declines in local and international markets.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNSXBvSnRkak5uYmtzMFNqMmE5Q25TMzBWeFh1ZmRhUHlMemIySllSU0FKcXZRQ2FjalhyMWhOZ3k2UWNXN3FjLTZiaUNvRk95S2FzeUlGeVJBQWNnQ19XYTAxd2NxNXNDN01TSWhYNXo0ellDaDBwZ0szdkR6azU5SkdFNWF4SWxiSF80Mi1ZdENoS1RuTWZkUVpCMHk0V0JpcDdz?oc=5), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-21/ty-article/two-oil-tankers-hit-by-unidentified-projectiles-near-strait-of-hormuz/000001a1-fe7c-dad7-a9fd-fe7f22a00000), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/ukmto-says-2-tankers-struck-hormuz-iran-says-ship-fire) reported that the British maritime agency UKMTO reported two tanker incidents near Oman and the Strait of Hormuz.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-21/ty-article/two-oil-tankers-hit-by-unidentified-projectiles-near-strait-of-hormuz/000001a1-fe7c-dad7-a9fd-fe7f22a00000), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/ukmto-says-2-tankers-struck-hormuz-iran-says-ship-fire) reported that Iran stated a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine, while Reuters could not verify the account.

reports.text: On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186596-zelensky-meets-with-witkoff-kushner-and-european-national-security-advisers.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with U.S. presidential special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, along with European national security advisers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/merz-rechaza-paz-negociada-trump-putin-ucrania-europa_202611196aff481121e74551e81f9358.html) La Razón reported that Friedrich Merz rejected any peace negotiated by Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping without Ukraine and Europe.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186503-zelensky-outlines-key-topics-for-coalition-of-the-willing-meeting-in-berlin.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky outlined covering budget needs as a key topic for the meeting.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/wadephul-coalition-of-the-willing-talks-in-berlin-send-strong-signal-to-moscow/a-79990664?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German Foreign Minister Wadephul stated the talks send a strong signal to Moscow.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/zelensky-lands-in-berlin-for-key-summit-with-ukraines-allied-partners/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky arrived in Berlin for a summit of allied nations.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063612/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrived in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing talks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1119/1599769-coalition-of-willing-berlin-meeting/) reported that Taoiseach Micheál Martin joined other European leaders for a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/19/taoiseach-in-berlin-for-ukraine-talks-as-triple-lock-row-rumbles-on/) reported that Micheál Martin joined Coalition of the Willing leaders in Berlin while Fianna Fáil rebels proposed Defence Bill amendments at home.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/zelenskyy-says-he-expects-debrief-from-us-envoys-on-trumps-talks-with-xi-and-putin) reported that US envoys told Kyiv they would give a debrief on Donald Trump's talks in China during meetings in Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-s-allies-gather-in-berlin-for-coalition-of-the-willing-summit/live-79986520?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukraine's European backers are convening in Berlin for a 'Coalition of the Willing' summit with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner attending.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/european-allies-say-more-support-crucial-for-ukraine-to-withstand-long-winter/) reported that a Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin pledged continued aid to Ukraine as Trump and Putin sat down in Shenzhen.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/eu-plans-a-new-45bn-loan-to-ukraine-how-much-will-it-cost-and-will-it-be-repaid) reported that the European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro support loan to Ukraine.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-confident-all-eu-members-will-back-45bn-loan-for-ukraine/) reported that Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary, and Bulgaria stated they do not intend to take part in the bloc's latest round of funding for Kyiv.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/18/europe-ukraine-russia-eu-germany-serbia-latest-news-updates) reported that EU leaders will vote on the measure in two weeks and that the commission president stated Ukraine has a €70 billion funding gap for next year.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063426/) reported that the €45 billion loan is split between €25 billion for military aid and €20 billion in reform-linked funds.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185725-axios-witkoff-kushner-to-meet-ukrainian-eu-officials-to-discuss-peace-plan.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials to discuss a peace plan.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-announces-berlin-talks-with-us-european-allies-to-shape-next-phase-of-russia-negotiations/) reported that a Ukrainian official stated the meeting in Berlin could take place on November 19.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063195/), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219295) reported that US Special Presidential Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin on November 19 to discuss security guarantees and economic recovery plans.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/eu-disburses-1-7-billion-euros-for-ukraines-military-needs/), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/european-commission-disburses-e1-71-billion-to-ukraine-for-military-equipment/) reported that the European Commission disbursed 1.71 billion euros to Ukraine for military needs including drones, ammunition, and air defenses.

stories.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
stories.label: Italy School Bomb Threats

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/8703d9468de5), a state-media outlet, reported that Italian authorities stated school bomb threats were aimed at destabilising institutions and posed no concrete danger.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPbjZhbFk0amM2UzJvb1FIRXRrMjhhLWJmUVBUTkZXUExtLXp1VExsR0tKZmQzbFQxT2VpWDk5MDh3TElwdC03bmlZVjktcThjMEs2eWRRbWxWZ0cyRVd5c3lMLXFBSUVEUmMxaGRhcWtRb19YR2tLb01Dem5mX3ROSWpMMXZCY2hOYU5fdXMxajl6aDNNWVdxaW5R?oc=5) reported that Italy received fake bomb threats targeting nearly 7,500 schools.

On 18 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/speciali/ansa-newsroom/2026/11/18/ansa-newsroom-fuori-tutti-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-caos-e-evacuazioni_732f890a-dda9-4cbc-9dca-a464e6d7c70b.html) reported that bomb alarms caused chaos and evacuations at schools.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915187) reported that more than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted schools, airlines, and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/italian-schools-hit-by-new-wave-of-bomb-and-poison-threats) reported that under new security guidelines, Italian schools are no longer automatically evacuated for vague mass threats, leaving the decision to schools.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/europe-scrambles-to-respond-to-wave-of-bomb-threats-disrupting-transport-media-and-schools/) reported that an unprecedented wave of bomb threats disrupted transport, media, and schools across Europe.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
On 11 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

On 11 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/hungary-magyar-orban-corruption-cash.html) reported that Hungary's new government uncovered $20 million worth of bank notes hidden in farmhouses and woods in corruption investigations.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPTWYtR2ZRc1RDTm1IX3Q2eGZMRVBaMGZyT2Y4b0pobEUxR2ZvS083aFhtNXF0ZGNvcEtfUVlzM19iZlFaTXhwTElHTExvS3d2cG83NUkyUWE4SlNuRC1TbVhhcmJsblNNZG42UmxZS2ZyT0hSME5yRHZHdTdxZlNBelJkWXBnTzFFUGU3U1RwNWMyZDc0Q0ZsbXdhYXFUbEFhU0ZkUlJjVjlKbG1nMXhIZnRTY2g?oc=5) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Magyar urged Fidesz lawmakers to quit following a cash haul in a graft probe.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/hungarian-investigators-found-19-5-million-in-cash-buried-in-forests-and-hidden-in-buildings-while-probing-allegations-against-a-former-minister-treasury-staff-needed-eight-hours-and-five-machines-to-count-it/articleshow/135847472.cms) reported that Hungarian investigators found $19.5 million in cash buried in forests and hidden in buildings while probing allegations against a former minister.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86180999), a Moldovan news outlet, reported that Hungarian authorities recovered cash worth nearly €17.7 million in an investigation involving former National Development Minister Miklós Seszták.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/hungary-finds-30-million-cash-some-buried-in-forests-in-bribery-probe-20261115-p61e7e.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Hungary found $30 million in cash, some buried in forests, in a bribery probe.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/cash-found-in-hungary-in-anti-graft-probe-20261115-p61e8r.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported on footage released from Hungary’s National Asset Recovery and Protection Office showing cash found in an anti-graft probe.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/hungary-seizes-195-million-cash-hidden-forests-graft-probe.1137115) reported that Miklos Sesztak, two other ministers from Viktor Orban's cabinet, and his brother have been taken into custody in different cases.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/hungary-seizes-millions-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-corruption-investigation) reported that investigators uncovered large amounts of cash buried in forests, concealed in agricultural buildings, and stashed inside safes.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90112) reported that Hungary's National Asset Recovery and Protection Agency seized over 5 billion forints, €2.7 million, and $1.3 million in physical cash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/hungarian-investigators-uncover-19-5m-hidden-in-forests-and-buildings?traffic_source=rss) reported that nearly $20 million was found in Hungary's forests and buildings amid a corruption probe into an ex-minister.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914852) reported that it took a dozen State Treasury workers eight hours to count the cash as part of Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s Operation Purgatory anti-corruption drive.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/hungary-seizes-195m-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-graft-inquiry), [Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/billions-in-buried-cash-found-in-forests-and-safes-in-ex-ministers-bribery-case/) reported that Hungary's anti-corruption agency seized $19.5 million in cash found buried in forests and safes as part of a bribery inquiry into an Orbán-era minister.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/hungarian-authorities-uncover-millions-hidden-by-former-orban-officials-in-forests-warehouses/) reported that Hungarian authorities seized more than 6 billion forints in cash found hidden or buried in forests and warehouses by the National Asset Recovery and Protection Directorate.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Bratu-Viktora-Orbana-odredjen-pritvor/992017) reported that a Hungarian court ordered a one-month detention for Aron Orban, the brother of former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban, due to suspected human smuggling.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/12/4978901_bratut_na_orban_e_zadurjan_zaradi_vizi_za_vietnamski/?ref=rss) reported that Aron Orban was detained on Monday due to suspicions regarding visas for Vietnamese migrants.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/viktor-orbans-brother-jailed-pending-trial-over-people-smuggling-ring/) reported that Viktor Orbán's brother was jailed pending trial over a people-smuggling ring.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Orbanovog-brata-u-lisicama-doveli-pred-sud-FOTO/991883) reported that Aron Orban was brought before a court in Budapest to decide on his detention.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNRWRHb01HTTFuYmlwb1F5Z1k1YVBYYlVHRGVaSFhFbk9nMzk3MjF0cWZEUE1JOVVwclppT0x1YmVlMGFjMGpnOEI4WWZTN1B3MVRCN2JscHFKeWdIX3JkRXB0U2twcEtZRzktbkc5ZHdHRWlVbTA3a0EtS0tsY0Eyc01HTVRBYkVVUlhmMHlLR0pDTUFnNUZ4T3VCNA?oc=5) reported that a judge jailed Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, after he cut off his ankle monitor.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9j3433zy4vro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Thomas Markle is back in federal custody after allegedly removing his ankle monitor.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/thomas-markle-sent-back-to-jail-after-cutting-off-his-ankle-bracelet/article71688238.ece) reported that U.S. Magistrate Judge Lindsay Griffin found Thomas Markle had violated the terms of his pretrial release and ordered him returned to federal custody.

On 10 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648650-orban-hungary-brother-arrest/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) (state-media) reported that former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban slammed his brother's detention as a government attempt to eliminate the opposition.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/viktor-orban-aron-brother-human-trafficking-b3082359.html) reported that Viktor Orbán stated the target is him after his brother Áron Orbán was detained for suspected human trafficking and corruption.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQcjZsUDI4UUNSUXdGOEhPQTZBLTFMRmxzalB0VDhqYXYtZmpJUzlvVlI2c3R3dkZoM21lUENZQzVNUjlGU2dqOG1QbDc1Q0RIZkNtRWROcWZTc3FvVXBDZkkxNmVfV1FwMm9zdDU3aGR1anRsUE1wZVp1bWs0OE1ZUUk0RGVvNnJrNnV2R1ptY2pJc3A3LWhsbG9XTTExcmcyT18yNXhOSWxRNHZSZklOamozOE8tUQ?oc=5) reported that Hungarian authorities detained Viktor Orbán's younger brother for suspected human trafficking.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/irmao-de-viktor-orban-e-preso-sob-suspeita-de-envolvimento-em-trafico-de-pessoas.shtml) reported that Hungarian authorities arrested the brother of former prime minister Viktor Orbán during an investigation into a human trafficking case.

reports.text: On 19 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/documentos-filtrados-revelan-como-deutsche-bank-dio-la-espalda-a-sus-promesas-climaticas/) reported that leaked documents revealed Deutsche Bank turned its back on climate promises regarding emissions reduction.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/epstein-and-deutsche-bank-the-filings-identfied-payments-made-to-women-a-e8f529f6-c583-4c99-a432-d0684c6697d7#ref=rss) reported that documents from Deutsche Bank show the financial institution processed many more payments for Jeffrey Epstein than previously known.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88667080) reported that Deutsche Bank is at the center of a scandal following an investigation based on millions of internal documents leaked to the press involving Russian oligarchs, Epstein, and Trump.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/the-bank-and-the-oligarchs-how-deutsche-bank-continued-expanding-in-russia-despite-the-warning-signs-a-668c08a5-0383-4d66-86b5-671b3c348774#ref=rss) reported that Deutsche Bank decided to continue expanding operations in Russia despite Putin's aggression following the Donbas, Crimea, and European attacks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-autorizou-transacoes-potencialmente-ilicitas-na-colombia-mostram-documentos.shtml) reported that documents show Deutsche Bank authorized thousands of potentially illicit transactions in Colombia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/deutsche-bank-chair-backs-ceo-after-reports-expose-past-lapses-trump-calls-tax-leak-illegal/article71715150.ece) reported that the Deutsche Bank chair backed the CEO after leaked records exposed past financial lapses, and the German Finance Minister called for an investigation.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/los-papeles-del-deutsche-bank-exponen-operaciones-que-vinculan-a-trump-con-rusia-y-us5819-millones-nid18112026/) reported that the leaked Deutsche Bank papers exposed operations linking Donald Trump to Russia and millions related to Jeffrey Epstein.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-banco-aleman-deutsche-bank-es-senalado-de-procesar-transacciones-sospechosas-por-casi-600-millones-de-dolares-vinculadas-a-epstein-y-donald-trump-3601659) reported that Deutsche Bank faces accusations of allowing corruption and ignoring internal controls after being signaled for processing nearly $600 million in suspicious transactions linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/deutsche-bank-acusada-de-permitir-corrupcion-vinculada-a-epstein-trump-y-oligarcas-rusos-33175792) reported that an international investigation led by CLIP and Barracuda Media documented Deutsche Bank links with high-risk clients and suspicious transactions based on a leak of 15 million files.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-falhou-em-controle-e-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-mostram-documentos-vazados.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-falhou-na-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-apesar-de-alertas-internos-revela-investigacao.ghtml) reported that an investigation based on more than 15 million leaked documents revealed that Deutsche Bank maintained serious flaws in its anti-money laundering controls and compliance.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-on-mass-data-leak) reported that Deutsche Bank shares plunged after international media published reports based on millions of leaked emails and documents.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-shares-fall-as-leak-reveals-trump-tax-document-error) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% after reports based on 15 million leaked records shed light on dealings with clients including Donald Trump and revealed a tax document error.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim) reported that an international investigation using leaked internal data claimed the German bank overlooked compliance concerns regarding risky clients to safeguard profits.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-exposing-epstein-payments-russia-dealings) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% following media reports detailing dealings with Jeffrey Epstein and Russian oligarchs.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532266/Deutsche-Bank-processed-582-million-for-Epstein-despite-explicit), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648963-whistleblowers-expose-deutsche-bank-dealings-epstein/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that leaked internal documents indicate Deutsche Bank processed nearly $600 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-leaks-german-lender-s-dealings-with-russian-oligarchs-under-scrutiny) reported that Germany's finance minister urged full transparency from Deutsche Bank following the leaked records.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/deutsche-bank-russia-oligarchs-leaked-documents.html) reported that leaked records showed Deutsche Bank courting wealthy Russian clients while bracing for sanctions.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915581) reported that Yashar is preparing for the possibility that both coalition negotiation tracks will fail.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-19/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-plans-knesset-vote-on-govt-led-by-him-even-if-coalition-talks-fail/000001a1-f454-d287-adbb-f65e3bfb0000) reported that Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot plans to hold a Knesset vote on a government led by him even if coalition talks fail.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915505) reported that the Eisenkot-led bloc and Likud are scheduled to meet on Sunday for continued talks on a potential unity government.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahus-surprise-meeting-with-bennett-stirs-anger-in-eisenkot-bloc-3725753) reported that figures in Gadi Eisenkot's bloc accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of trying to break up their alliance after meeting Naftali Bennett.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/bennett-meets-netanyahu-eisenkot-unaware-coalition-talks/) reported that B'Yachad chief Naftali Bennett held a long Knesset meeting with Benjamin Netanyahu on November 18 while Gadi Eisenkot's spokesperson stated he was unaware of it.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-rattled-bennett-holds-talks-netanyahu) reported that members of Israel's opposition bloc insisted they remain unified after a meeting between Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/bennett-meets-netanyahu-ahead-of-talks-with-eisenkot-bloc-leaders/000001a1-ee32-d24f-a1e5-efbfec8b0000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915298) reported that Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu held a secret meeting without informing Gadi Eisenkot and Yair Lapid in advance, which delayed planned opposition bloc talks.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-915097) reported that an Eisenkot-led bloc is weighing a unity government and coalition talks with haredi parties following the October election, while Golan and Liberman warned against a Netanyahu-led unity government.
