On 15 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/whats-behind-netanyahus-frantic-push-for-a-unity-government/000001a1-e027-d59b-a1f3-f8b72d260000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Gadi Eisenkot to share power after losing his majority.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/can-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-form-a-unity-government-in-israel?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-again-urges-rival-to-join-him-in-forming-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urged rival Gadi Eisenkot to join him in forming a unity government.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-rejects-netanyahus-unity-government-call-as-media-stunt-3725584) reported that Gadi Eisenkot described the call as a media stunt and noted that negotiating teams from his Yashar party and Likud are due to meet.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-israel-vows-gaza-offensive-policy-despite-caretaker-status?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel has pledged to continue its offensive policy on Gaza.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261114-netanyahu-renews-call-for-israeli-government-unity-as-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/netanyahu-calls-for-israeli-unity-government-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks-3011919), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1114/1599234-netanyahu-renews-call-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu renewed his call for a national unity government with Gadi Eisenkot, who dismissed the appeal as tricks.
On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914874) reported that Netanyahu invoked the Hatikvah walkout and warned of Iran's nuclear threat.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/netanyahu-pushes-trump-iran-strikes-amid-mossad-us-visit) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing Donald Trump to renew attacks on Iran while Mossad chief Roman Gofman visits Washington.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/after-briefing-eisenkot-netanyahu-urges-unity-government-without-preconditions/000001a1-db08-ddc9-abb7-dfca699e0000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu invoked the threat from Iran and the need for national reconciliation in his appeal to Eisenkot.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914878) reported that Eisenkot accused Netanyahu of political spin over his unity government appeal and demanded a break with extremists.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-calls-netanyahus-unity-plea-a-bluff/000001a1-db48-d59b-a1f3-dbdcd9bd0000) reported that Eisenkot called Netanyahu's unity plea a bluff and urged backing for Yashar's Knesset speaker pick.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-undo-netanyahus-judicial-coup-through-knesset-committees/000001a1-d12f-da30-a7fb-d9bf1ba40000) reported that the Eisenkot bloc seeks to control key Knesset committees to undo Netanyahu's judicial coup.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-12/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-controls-the-knesset-netanyahu-is-still-pm-what-each-bloc-is-planning/000001a1-ce67-dfd7-a7a3-ce7757c70000) reported on what Eisenkot's bloc and Netanyahu's bloc are planning to do regarding the Knesset and government formation.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177688) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz responded to Eisenkot by stating that Tel Aviv does not need the opposition's approval to continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and the West Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190016/%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D9%81%D8%A9) reported that Hamas leader Abdul Rahman Shadid warned against the acceleration of land expropriation and settlement expansion in the West Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2xtdC1iNFRNSEZwNjVlM1hTeFVjREM0MlU4ZFlaWkVBYnQyNmxEdnZKeXRLQXBmbVVOeHI1U1l0TFN2cG1tQS02TFV0OElNUzhqZ1dRbUVfS3BtTVphOVFud1R6N1hZdGlpVl9GVE45dk93akNtcGRhUFB6cmpOd0FZbC1GOXBFendqUmtmalYwcUJybFo2WWRtOA?oc=5) reported that Israel's president gave Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/israel-swears-in-new-parliament-as-netanyahu-remains-caretaker-pm/) reported that Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/crime-in-israel/article-914571) reported that Amit Hadad, Netanyahu’s lawyer, stated that the judges could summon Baharav-Miara regardless of her position and that the door remains open to talks.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-rejects-palestinian-state-warns-of-iran-threat-and-calls-for-unity-government/) reported that outgoing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of potential international pressure on Israel to withdraw from territories it controls in Gaza.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-11/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-leaders-were-unaware-of-yashars-planned-talks-with-likud/000001a1-ca01-d1f4-a7f9-cac3d5240000) reported that Lieberman, Bennett and Golan learned of the planned Yashar-Likud talks only after they were canceled following Netanyahu's speech attacking Arab parties.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/netanyahu-heckled-by-bennett-at-knesset-opening-session?traffic_source=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu was heckled by Naftali Bennett at the Knesset opening session.

On 11 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261110-eisenkot-pushes-october-7-inquiry-as-netanyahu-targets-arab-parties-in-tense-new-parliament) reported that Gadi Eisenkot pledged to launch an official inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-politics-sara-netanyahu-heated-shouting-match-with-naftali-bennett-during-benjamin-netanyahus-knesset-address-101794372417173.html) reported that Naftali Bennett and Sara Netanyahu got into a heated exchange after the former questioned caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu about his Qatari advisers.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/unfit-to-remain-in-office-eisenkot-attacks-netanyahu-after-hateful-knesset-speech/articleshow/135722286.cms) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after a hateful Knesset speech.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-vows-to-undo-netanyahu-policies-as-israeli-parliament-opens) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the newly opened parliament began.

On 10 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261108-ex-army-chief-eisenkot-given-first-chance-to-form-government-in-israel) reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority.

On 10 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

stories.label: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Extramarital Affair and Espionage Claims

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/chips-h200-de-nvidia-son-el-limite-que-eu-puede-enviar-a-china-bessent-empresa-dejo-de-exportar-procesadores-de-ia-al-pais-asiatico/) reported that Bessent stated Nvidia H200 chips are the limit the U.S. can send to China, while the company stopped exporting AI processors to the Asian country.

On 21 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649186-trump-second-chance-nvidia-huang/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Donald Trump stated Jensen Huang deserves a second chance while Nvidia faces a congressional inquiry, an SEC investigation, and a share price drop.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1089686/tramp-huang-zasluzuje-drugu-sansu-volio-bih-da-se-iskreno-izvini-i-vrati-na-posao) reported that Donald Trump stated that Huang deserves a second chance and that he would like him to apologize and return to work.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/dzensen-huang-nece-se-vratiti-u-nvidiu-iako-tramp-trazi-oprostaj/wcwgn3b) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang deserves a second chance, while Nvidia stated there is no return to his position.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/nvidia-donald-trump-scott-bessent-amd-chinese-b3089013.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/no-further-restrictions-on-nvidias-chip-exports-to-china-after-block-on-remote-access-scott-bessent-101795216575430.html) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated no further restrictions on older Nvidia chips exported to China are needed.

On 21 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3375287/nvidia-faces-further-blow-after-shock-us-export-permit-data-release-analysts) reported that US lawmakers released confidential licensing records showing Washington approved semiconductor trade with Chinese firms.

On 20 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-war/article/3375249/after-nvidia-will-amd-be-target-chinas-second-choice-ai-chips) reported that short sellers targeted Advanced Micro Devices over alleged connections to Chinese firms blacklisted by Washington.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641359/california-subpoenas-nvidia-over-possible-china-chip-transfers-investor-claims) reported that California subpoenaed Nvidia over possible China chip transfers and investor claims regarding risks linked to Jensen Huang's ties to a woman suspected of Chinese espionage.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/20/california-investigates-nvidia-over-whether-chip-exports-ended-up-in-china) reported that the California attorney general served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia to determine whether the company misled investors regarding chip exports ending up in China.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/kalifornija-izdala-istrazni-poziv-nvidiji-zbog-cipova-i-afere-bivseg-direktora/261120013), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/biznis/1089402/nvidia-pod-istragom-zbog-afere-bivseg-direktora-kalifornija-istrazuje-moguce-veze-s-kineskom-spijunkom) reported that California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia regarding former CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a suspect in a Chinese spy case.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584300/california-subpoena-nvidia-over-possible-china-chip-transfers-and-investor-disclosures/) reported that California Attorney General Rob Bonta served an investigative subpoena on US chipmaker Nvidia regarding whether China illegally obtained advanced chips or confidential information.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/chinas-ai-firms-are-addicted-to-nvidia-chips-now-they-are-facing-withdrawal-101795144023280.html) reported that US moves to cut off Chinese access to high-end computing power have dealt a blow to Beijing's artificial intelligence ambitions.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/california-attorney-general-subpoenas-nvidia-over-chips-former-ceos-affair/article71722914.ece) reported that the California Department of Justice subpoenaed Nvidia regarding whether advanced chips or confidential information went to China.

On 19 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375135/us-congress-releases-list-chinese-firms-seeking-nvidia-chips) reported that a US House committee released confidential licence applications from Chinese companies seeking to buy advanced artificial intelligence chips from Nvidia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqn70vxp5p4no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-19/california-investiga-a-nvidia-por-posibles-transferencias-de-chips-avanzados-a-china.html) reported that California launched an investigation into Nvidia regarding potential transfers of advanced chips to China following the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang.
On 20 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/e85a87e93654), a Turkish state outlet, reported that the US president criticized the ICC and backed Nvidia's Huang.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/he-is-a-good-man-trump-backs-jensen-huang-s-return-as-nvidia-ceo-asks-him-to-make-a-big-apology-101795203021126.html) reported that Donald Trump stated he would love to see Jensen Huang return as Nvidia CEO and asked him to make a big apology.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/trump-pide-a-nvidia-una-segunda-oportunidad-para-jensen-huang-es-una-de-las-mentes-mas-brillantes-del-mundo-3602818) reported that Jensen Huang resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia after revelations of a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPVXRKZGYxUkVSVnNCbGJHOG9wWjFSY1puTVMtdUMyeGg4VTFXR2xhRXd1ZmxYZ1g5QlBZRzljX1F0V1R5WERUOGdhb09IWXE0MTJXWXl3Z0F1czYyck1OT1NHc012Rm1PaDdXR1BQSkVRTkNqQkpCVUZZSUdTMnY1S1Zsa0kwYV8tai16c1Z3QnBwb0JZNjA5QXA1TkllMFhacFZMcm9MNHoyYU1LNHBlY2ZiN1lHUElQSURVSFo5aw?oc=5) reported that former Nvidia CEO Huang agreed to testify at a public US Senate hearing.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fact-check-former-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-is-not-launching-a-new-semiconductor-startup-101795208710468.html) reported that a viral video claiming Jensen Huang is raising $50 billion for a new chip company is false and features a clip from July.
On 20 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/us/politics/nvidia-alice-huang-chips-china.html) reported that Alice Huang is linked to firms with ties to China's military.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jensen-huang-mistreated-nvidia-employees-for-decades-with-violent-threats-public-insults-report-101795193670064.html) reported that a New York Times report detailed decades of alleged insults, threats, and employee complaints against Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trump-urges-nvidia-to-give-jensen-huang-second-chance/), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/j-adorerais-le-voir-revenir-donald-trump-incite-nvidia-a-donner-une-deuxieme-chance-a-son-ex-patron-jensen-huang-20261120) reported that US President Donald Trump called for Nvidia to give Jensen Huang a second chance and reinstate him.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/colette-kresss-leadership-under-strain-as-10-000-employees-seek-jensen-huangs-return-to-nvidia-101795169638679.html) reported that many at Nvidia believe Jensen Huang should be reinstated despite the internal probe.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/trump-calls-musk-a-friend-despite-billionaires-maga-retreat) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump sought to play down Elon Musk's apparent distancing from the MAGA movement, stating the billionaire remains a friend despite his retreat.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/20/depois-de-musk-dizer-que-nao-e-mais-maga-trump-defende-empresario-ele-tem-boas-intencoes.ghtml) reported that US President Donald Trump defended Elon Musk, stating the tech magnate has good intentions, after Musk stated he is no longer 'MAGA'.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/could-jensen-huang-nvidia-and-company-s-board-be-held-liable-over-affair-scandal-101795143853237.html) reported that the SEC is reportedly investigating while state officials weigh potential inquiries regarding Nvidia.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/scandale-jensen-huang-la-californie-ouvre-une-enquete-sur-nvidia-et-les-ventes-de-puces-a-la-chine-20261120) reported that the California attorney general opened an investigation into Nvidia over suspected concealment from investors of chip export risks to China.
On 19 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/us/politics/elon-musk-maga-trump.html) reported that Elon Musk is backing away from MAGA and the Trump presidency.

On 19 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/electricity-evs-cop31-southeast-asia-6561641) reported that a new global push to replace fossil fuels with electricity is gaining support at COP31.

On 19 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/ai-investments-returns-asia-growth-imf-dan-katz-6565666) reported that the International Monetary Fund's second-in-command stated that the sustainability of the artificial intelligence investment boom will depend on whether companies can achieve returns on their investments.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/could-new-us-chip-restrictions-torpedo-southeast-asias-ai-ambitions/) reported that Washington is targeting the renting of advanced AI computing capacity to Chinese companies in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/there-is-no-private-individual-who-has-helped-ukraine-more-than-i-have-elon-musk-says-russia-would-have-won-the-war-if-ukraine-did-not-have-starlink/articleshow/135998158.cms) reported that Elon Musk stated at the DealBook Summit that Russia would have won the war if Ukraine did not have Starlink.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/swedish-gripen-pilot-unable-to-shoot-down-suspected-russian-missile-over-poland-due-to-poor-weather-commander-says/) reported that a Swedish Gripen pilot participating in a NATO air defense deployment was unable to shoot down a suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/nato-pledges-to-defend-poland-after-russian-missile-incursion/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte pledged to defend Poland after two Russian missiles hit its southeast during a meeting of the alliance's council in Brussels.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/russian-missiles-hit-poland-what-happened-and-could-nato-respond?traffic_source=rss) reported that Warsaw accused Moscow of intentional provocation after Russian missiles hit Poland, while the bar for triggering NATO's collective defense clause remains high.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063930/) reported that the pilot of a Swedish Gripen fighter jet patrolling Polish airspace during airspace violations on Friday 20 November was authorized to shoot down a Russian missile but unable to identify it.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90803) reported that a Swedish JAS 39 Gripen pilot received NATO authorization to shoot down a suspected Russian Kh-101 cruise missile during Friday’s airspace violation over southern Poland, but held fire due to weather.
On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90785) reported that European Union, British, and NATO leaders condemned Russia's overnight violation of Polish airspace.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641478/russian-missiles-land-in-poland-amid-nato-drills), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375302/russian-missiles-land-poland-europe-holds-military-drills-nearby) reported that two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland during European military drills, prompting the Polish prime minister to call it an intentional provocation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russia-fires-cruise-missile-into-poland-during-british-troop-drills/3IBFJX7GAZGOLJUZRDPA2ND3PY/) reported that Russia fired a cruise missile into Poland during British troop drills 100 kilometers from the exercise.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPb2dKNkEyLW5VNkNqNmI3U2lRMGcwUzZxUEUzb2FqTmVPYmFSZVhWYXM3Z0VfN3JfVi1FbkZydE5UWkRmNlhSZTFOa1pBLUpMaG5lRzZKbmJRYjdkcHZRYXlwWVlSQ3hoSUxwSzdtZDRld1FCSzVUUThhR1dicE5XbjNiSnc5VThLSGdpUkhrM2xueDRmR19DYg?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russian-missile-incursion-into-poland-seems-intentional-tusk-says/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the Polish prime minister stated a Russian missile's crash in Poland was likely an intentional provocation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063854/) reported that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVGl6dU85bExfQlhuODY0Rkh6a3M2UVhRTlV1QmRsclI5ZHpRbWo5M3JIbUdydkRzOFNrZkZ6RDBIMHJVNGhqeklnRl9UVVAzRFpFUUk0OTVDVnU3RVh2VjdWZ2ktMUhMNmZZMUZkVDE5RFAtTjJ4UEZjUDlKZWd4YlhSaFBoYXdnYVI1ajFaRkdnTkpyMExkU0U4YjBHMTNSblZkRWt6aUVtTGJ5UWU1RVdrNA?oc=5), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/european-troops-from-11-countries-hold-a-drill-in-poland-for-a-potential-postwar-ukraine-mission) reported that European troops from 11 countries began a two-week military exercise in Poland on November 9 to test the coalition's ability to deploy in Ukraine once the war ends.

On 20 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx2x9dklxnro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/warsaw-says-russian-missiles-hit-poland-intentional-provocation.1137425), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/poland-says-russian-missile-that-crashed-in-its-territory-was-a-provocation-20261121-p61g3a.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident in which objects hit Poland as an intentional provocation from Moscow.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90744) reported that Donald Trump stated on Fox News that Russian drones and missiles had previously entered Poland by mistake.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Cipher Brief](https://www.thecipherbrief.com/washington-should-allow-ukraine-to-hit-russia-s-ballistic-missile-launchers) reported that a traveler to Ukraine visited soldiers and leaders in Kyiv, Dnipro, Pavlohrad, and Kharkiv, arguing that Washington should allow Ukraine to hit Russia's ballistic missile launchers.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russian-missile-attacks-hit-major-bridges-across-kyiv/) reported that Russian ballistic missiles struck three bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing six people.

On 20 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-russia-crimea-strikes-bridge-kyiv-power-outage-poland/107411538), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/russia-pummels-ukraine-putin-vowed-painful-attack.1137390) reported that Russia pummelled Ukraine with dozens of missiles and hundreds of drones overnight, killing eight people, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed a painful response.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90708) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine destroyed one of three Russian ballistic missile launchers and downed 79 cruise missiles.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89346957) reported that Russia proposed that European representatives travel to Moscow to clarify their position on peace talks concerning Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063766/) reported that the Ukrainian Prime Minister stated energy sites, businesses, and houses in nine oblasts and a wastewater facility in Kyiv were damaged, with the Kyiv death toll rising to six and 28 injured across Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186726-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-kyiv-rises-to-six-15-injured.html) reported that the death toll from the overnight attack on Kyiv rose to six, with 15 injured.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-targeted-by-missile-strikes-bridges-hit/live-79999822?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that at least three deaths were reported in Kyiv following missile strikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/3-killed-in-bridge-strikes-on-kyiv-mayor-says-a94324) reported that eight people were killed across Ukraine in the strikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/20/putin-invites-european-leaders-to-moscow-for-peace-talks-as-russia-pounds-kyiv/) reported that Vladimir Putin invited European leaders to Moscow for peace talks.

On 20 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-crimean-bridge-destruction-significance-explained/107408488) reported that an expert stated Ukraine's destruction of the Crimean Bridge marked a huge blow to Vladimir Putin's credibility.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-live-deadly-russian-attacks-damage-two-bridges-in-kyiv-mayor-says), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063728/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186643-kyivs-podilskyi-and-darnytskyi-bridges-damaged-in-russian-ballistic-attack-mayor.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/russian-missile-and-drone-attack-on-kyiv-kills-three-and-damages-three-dnipro-bridges-mayor-says) reported that Russian attacks damaged bridges in Kyiv.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1120/1599948-ukraine-russia/) reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack hit three bridges on Kyiv's Dnipro River and killed three people, according to the city's mayor.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-launches-mass-missile-attack-against-ukraine-after-putin-vows-revenge/) reported that Russia launched a mass missile attack against Ukraine after explosions rocked Kyiv following Putin's vows of retaliation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/19/ukraine-war-briefing-russia-embassy-netherlands-destinus-missiles-kerch-crimea-bridge-strike) reported that the Russian embassy questioned whether the Netherlands joined the conflict after missiles made by a Dutch-based company were used in the Kerch bridge attack.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/20/world/putin-ukraine-crimea-bridge/) reported that Vladimir Putin stated there will be no sea or energy truce following the strike on the Crimea Bridge.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186437-putin-sets-condition-for-european-involvement-in-talks-on-war-in-ukraine.html) reported that Russian ruler Vladimir Putin stated the Kremlin is ready to include European representatives in negotiations on Ukraine after they come to Moscow.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/russia-invites-european-representatives-to-moscow-for-talks-putin-says) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin stated the United States has been pushing Russia to accept European participation in talks to end the war.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90624) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin stated Moscow has invited European representatives to discuss their position on Ukraine and European security.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063631/), [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221855) reported that Vladimir Putin stated during his visit to Shenzhen that Moscow invited European Union representatives to Moscow via diplomatic channels to clarify Europe's position on settling the war in Ukraine.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-forces-once-more-hit-russias-crimean-bridge-days-after-devastating-strike/) reported that Sergey Aksyonov confirmed the Crimean Bridge was hit again just after midnight.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-ukrainian-strike-in-4-days-halts-rail-traffic-on-russias-kerch-bridge-to-crimea/article71721511.ece) reported that a third Ukrainian strike in 4 days halted rail traffic on Russia's Kerch Bridge to Crimea hours before talks in Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/putin-vows-to-retaliate-as-ukraine-hits-prized-crimea-bridge-for-third-time-in-four-days-13613963) reported that Vladimir Putin vowed to retaliate after Ukraine hit the Crimea bridge for the third time in four days.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/fuel-restrictions-reportedly-cause-gas-station-queues-in-occupied-sevastopol-after-crimean-bridge-strikes/) reported that panic buying prompted Russian-installed authorities to impose fuel purchase limits at two major gas station chains in Sevastopol following Crimean Bridge strikes.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221993), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian OSCE Permanent Representative Dmitry Polyansky described Ukrainian attacks on the Crimean Bridge as a PR stunt that will not impact the battlefield.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063662/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/satellite-images-show-a-collapsed-span-of-the-crimean-bridge-after-ukraine-s-third-strike-in-a-week) reported that open-source analysts and Ukrainian OSINT channels published satellite images showing impact points and a collapsed span of the Kerch Bridge following overnight strikes.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90603) reported that Moscow stated it may reopen some sections of the Crimean Bridge within months.

stories.title: Thousands protest overs prices, education, military spending in France and Europe
stories.label: European cost of living and student protests

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/thousands-protest-overs-prices-education-military-spending-in-france-and-europe), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/thousands-protest-across-europe-over-living-costs-and-housing?traffic_source=rss), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-students-and-unions-unite-for-sixth-weekend-of-protests-across-france) reported that thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across France and Europe for protests over the cost of living, housing, and government policies.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNT203dWpPR19PY3FGeGlGWkNqRklXMDA0cEtFTXBoY21LbVhhaEVNNzVXWTJfOUhUOURwUVVtQXBVazBOdjRjNmVnRktLOGxHam9tZ3ZneGp3bXNfQ2lHOU0yY0I2WF9qdnJxSkNrVm1Pc0REblNaMXJxRHZqRnpDcmY5MEhOdkNaeUZMUVFQYUxDUXRKbmhmckRvQnBHZUlXclh6ZEJJSUJQYll3SUNfdGJ5WQ?oc=5) reported that student protests were held across Europe with demands ranging from school funding to climate action.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/gen-z-protests-sweep-europe-over-wars-rising-costs-and-climate?traffic_source=rss) reported that thousands of Gen Z protesters rallied across 25 European countries over living costs, military spending, and climate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/protestas-en-europa-la-militarizacion-y-el-costo-de-la-vida-vuelven-a-sacar-a-las-personas-a-las-calles-este-fin-de-semana-3602870) reported that Spain, Italy, and Austria experienced a new wave of demonstrations over militarization and the cost of living.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/young-demonstrators-take-to-streets-across-europe-in-widespread-protests/) reported that young Europeans poured into the streets from Milan to Berlin and London to protest high living costs, military spending, and climate issues.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/20/pelo-nosso-futuro-jovens-protestam-de-forma-coordenada-na-europa-contra-custo-de-vida-condicoes-de-ensino-e-gastos-militares.ghtml) reported that students and young workers took to the streets in over 20 European countries in coordinated protests.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/young-people-europe-coordinated-protests-cost-of-living), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/thousands-protest-across-europe-demanding-better-wages-and-services) reported that young people and activists across more than 20 European countries staged coordinated protests over the cost of living, learning conditions, and military spending.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/protestos-contra-gastos-militares-e-alta-do-custo-de-vida-mobilizam-jovens-na-europa-nesta-sexta.shtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7324329-jovens-protestam-na-europa-contra-custo-de-vida-e-militarizacao.html) reported that young protesters demonstrated in European cities against the high cost of life and militarization.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261120-protesters-join-forces-across-europe-against-high-living-costs), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-gen-z-protests-spread-across-europe-mass-rallies-over-cost-of-living-in-spain), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6dx12ppeqn4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that protesters across Europe took to the streets in coordinated demonstrations against the rising cost of living.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-italy-strike-draws-workers-students-into-nationwide-protests-over-wages-and-living-costs), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/20/italy-workers-and-students-stage-nationwide-strike-over-living-costs) reported that a nationwide strike in Italy disrupted schools, hospitals, and local transport.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/a-decade-after-brexit-vote-uk-strikes-sweeping-deal-to-rebuild-ties-with-eu/) reported that Britain and the European Union reached an agreement to rebuild economic, trade, educational, and security relations ten years after the Brexit vote.

On 21 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/eu-uk-reach-reset-deal-after-brexit) reported that the UK and the EU signed three agreements in Brussels marking a new effort to reset post-Brexit relations.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/uk-european-union-summit-meeting-on-november-20-2026/article71723782.ece) reported that the U.K. and E.U. are expected to announce a youth mobility scheme for 100,000 individuals aged 18 to 32 to live and work across borders.

On 20 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/20/uk-and-eu-sign-their-biggest-deal-since-brexit-in-brussels?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and European Council President António Costa signed three agreements in Brussels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/uk-and-eu-agree-deals-on-trade-and-youth-movement-pledging-to-rebuild-ties-after-brexit-20261121-p61g38.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham touted the agreement as a win for the UK's cost of living.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/eu-and-uk-strike-landmark-deal-to-strengthen-ties-after-brexit/a-80001076?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the European Union and the United Kingdom agreed on landmark deals on youth mobility and trade.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-uk-and-eu-strike-landmark-deal-to-rebuild-ties-after-brexit) reported that leaders reached the agreement following a summit in Brussels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/dix-ans-apres-le-brexit-le-royaume-uni-s-enflamme-autour-d-un-hypothetique-retour-vers-l-europe-20261120) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's remarks sparked debate over a hypothetical return to Europe ten years after Brexit.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxPMFZfOXJRS2RFTTlMenB0cXUxNG1mNnVFaThZUGVfM0J0cnY5ckZmRTZDbWZGVWtWSFBhR3lHMF9ZZWVMOHpOSFNMZjNROTc0Z3JFSkJzaUdXYVpQWmg2T1E5ckIyYk82bXpHUzUzTTRkc1dTX2hzYi12RHVVYUxPM0ExbDRNb29tcVhPdEJaZ3RrUQ?oc=5), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1120/1599959-eu-uk-summit/) reported that Downing Street announced that an EU-UK reset deal has been agreed during British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's visit to Brussels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-burnham-hails-landmark-eu-uk-deal-as-good-day-for-britain-europe) reported that Britain and the European Union agreed deals on trade, carbon emissions, and youth movement at a Brussels summit, with Prime Minister Andy Burnham hailing the agreement as a landmark turning point.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/burnham-drew-a-line-under-brexit-at-the-eu-uk-summit-but-where-does-britain-go-next) reported that Burnham drew a line under Brexit at the EU-UK summit, which exposed the limits of negotiating one deal at a time as Brussels signaled its positions.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOdHA4czl2OVhoMVN6dURzVWJSVFBpRlhNOS1kYllMMm54RkNKTFBpM1ZVaG5jUE1yYzBlT0Q0Nk1YYlBFVFBQWC1MQW15WERjMWpZWEJ5QU1xaVFjbXRodUxuclNHVFNsWnE5WF9uY1pzcEMyRGk2MEVvRnhBUzMxRXpSeHlQV3Z4ZjlQSENjd0MySnFXbkVrZWVpY19XNjZZSklEYjJVOEgxTmZRM0NzbDdXU3A?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/20/burnham-trade-youth-mobility-deals-biggest-step-towards-eu-since-brexit), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375289/uk-eu-seal-food-and-youth-deals-are-stuck-tuition-fees) reported that Britain and the European Union sealed deals on food trade and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261120-eu-and-uk-agree-landmark-deal-at-burnham-s-brussels-summit) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU officials sealed deals to ease trade and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/20/uk-eu-european-union-brexit-deal-andy-burnham-latest-news-updates), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/20/the-deal-is-done-uk-says-brexit-reset-deal-with-eu-is-agreed/) reported that the EU stated the reset deal will not take effect without an agreement on tuition fees for European students.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-rare-eu-uk-summit-as-andy-burnham-seeks-to-mend-brexit-damage) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU top officials were set to announce deals to ease trade and youth mobility at a Brussels summit.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/andy-burnham-brussels-antonio-costa-brexit-ursula-von-der-leyen-b3088477.html), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/20/g-s1-154576/uk-eu-summit) reported that top EU officials met with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham in a rare summit to strengthen ties and mend Brexit damage a decade after the leave vote.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/podcast/brussels-playbook-podcast/what-does-europe-want-from-andy-burnhams-reconciliation-bid/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that negotiators completed a final squeeze ahead of the EU-UK reset summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/as-burnham-heads-to-brussels-are-new-brexit-wars-about-to-begin?traffic_source=rss) reported that the UK premier is heading to Brussels for the second round of EU talks aimed at deepening post-Brexit cooperation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/19/zombie-nation-burnhams-britain-ponders-its-brexit-woes-as-eu-uk-summit-set-to-begin/) reported that senior EU officials remain unsure whether the UK premier's positive rhetoric is backed by entrenched belief or is a warm-up act ahead of talks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/andy-burnham-will-sign-a-brexit-reset-deal-tomorrow-the-real-battle-comes-next/) reported that Brussels remains wary of letting Britain cherry-pick the benefits of EU membership from outside the club as Andy Burnham prepares to sign a Brexit reset deal.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/invest-international-rail-services-boost-uk-eu-reset-andy-burnham) reported that campaigners urged investments in international rail services to boost the UK-EU reset.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ukeu-reset-will-take-time-any-decisions-to-follow-next-elections-says-british-pm-andy-burnham-101794902431647.html) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated any UK-EU relationship changes will take time and follow the next election.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/17/burnham-says-brexit-has-dramatically-diminished-britains-global-standing), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/britain-lost-more-than-it-gained-since-brexit-pm-burnham-says-3725664) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated at the Lord Mayor's Banquet that Britain has lost more than it gained from Brexit and that global standing has diminished.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOZGVhQnh3ZDFYZ0JqbnFKazRlM2RDblBURFRPZ2VLZTJSeUY5RmpreVJ5Sk14Qk5wWDJsaWZ0N3JSVVJvV1pCOXV4YVoxUDM4UFpLY2t1RWYwVmhNUHJuTXdraDNWbDAtN0otbXZXakg2bE5SNHpFRnZKNkUwVFJlVFBHLVd1akIxb2w4YmJ0VXF4dm9FWUdlZmlQSHpVNmxETWJhYTRlRjA?oc=5), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/uk-leader-andy-burnham-says-brexit-hasnt-worked-ahead-of-reset-summit-with-eu) reported that UK political figure Andy Burnham stated that Brexit has not worked and failed to deliver on promises to take back control of borders, laws, and the economy ahead of an EU reset summit.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uk/2026/11/17/britain-lost-its-moral-compass-over-gaza-says-burnham/) reported that Andy Burnham stated Britain lost its moral compass over Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/16/brexit-share-your-thoughts-on-andy-burnhams-plan-for-a-new-eu-deal) reported that The Guardian invited public thoughts on Andy Burnham's plan to reopen the Brexit debate and sign a new deal with the EU.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/16/andy-burnham-brexit-has-not-worked-sign-new-deal-with-eu) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated Brexit has not worked and announced plans to sign a new deal with the EU.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/16/uk-lost-more-than-it-gained-from-brexit-andy-burnham-to-say-ahead-of-eu-summit/) reported that Andy Burnham compared the Brexit deal to the emperor's new clothes and stated Britain lost more than it gained.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915021) reported that UK Prime Minister Burnham stated Britain lost more than it gained from Brexit and seeks an EU reset.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm3vgw1xevvwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that 111 students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam in South Korea.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119010100315) reported that 98 test-takers were caught cheating on the college entrance exam, including 5 using smart devices.

On 19 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/south-korea-tightens-security-for-national-exam-over-ai-cheating-scandal) reported that over 550,000 candidates sat South Korea's Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security following an AI cheating scandal.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/19/asia-pacific/society/south-korea-college-exam-cheating/) reported that South Korea held its annual nine-hour college entrance exam with strict curbs following a cheating scandal.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/glasses-worn-by-exam-candidates-come-under-scanner-in-south-korea-after-ai-cheating-scandal-101794803535654.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/south-korea-national-exam-ai-cheating-scandal-6554101) reported that South Korea's Education Minister announced the ministry will inspect all glasses worn by candidates in the college entrance exam following an AI cheating scandal.

On 16 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3374538/south-korea-cracks-down-online-exam-pill-sales-ahead-national-college-exam) reported that South Korea's drug safety agency flagged online posts illegally selling prescription drugs under study-enhancing labels.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261116005500315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10938746) reported that South Korea is scrambling to crack down on AI-assisted cheating ahead of the national college entrance exam.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPVjJtaVF1ZGdVTmRVNlB2Mk5GeEVtaTk2UHIxbW16RHU2M0hNQ1hTZW1XTkVPTzlYQnNYV2FDMlZGQjZpMXdySHZhMDFUMDkxOWJybnE4ekV6LVRuV3p5bHZiU3dTVWsyNkpOTkdaV3gxR3plNTF1TTdyVDlIUklCekFkNG5yaFdQZ3lQVjhyQXNxX09UQnVuYlhLMjNoMVVDZFk4R2xhQVd4T2xjaWNfdVZFZW4?oc=5), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581863/south-korea-investigates-top-exam-scorer-over-ai-cheating/) reported that South Korean police launched an investigation after the top scorer confessed to cheating with AI.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/15/ai-cheating-south-korea-college-entrance-exam), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10937594) reported that the top scorer admitted to using a miniature camera and AI tool to cheat on the examination.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10937538) reported that the top scorer on South Korea's state-administered tax accountant examination admitted to using artificial intelligence to cheat.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/asia-pacific/south-korea-ai-test-cheating/) reported that the candidate scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round with only one wrong answer out of 160 questions.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10937374) reported that the top scorer in South Korea's tax accountant qualification exam turned himself in to the police and admitted to cheating using AI-powered smart glasses.

stories.title: Russia Accuses Estonia of Erecting New Iron Curtain With Border Closure, Says It Will Respond
stories.label: Estonia border closure and sabotage

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/russia-complains-of-new-iron-curtain-as-estonia-shuts-its-borders?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russia complained of a new Iron Curtain after Estonia shut road border crossings following an attack on a drone manufacturer.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/estonia-to-close-all-road-crossings-with-russia) reported that Estonia's government decided to temporarily close its road border crossings with Russia starting December 1 citing national security.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/estonia-to-shut-border-with-russia-over-gru-linked-sabotage-attack) reported that Estonia will close five checkpoints on the border with Russia from 1 December with a possible review in six months after an attempted arson at a defence facility near Tallinn.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-moscow-decries-new-iron-curtain/article71725791.ece) reported that Estonia accused Russian security services of staging an attempted arson attack on an Estonian defense company prior to closing its border.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/narva-mayor-calls-for-humanitarian-corridors-for-emergency-trips-to-russia-as-estonia-prepares-to-close-the-border-december-1) reported that Narva's mayor called for humanitarian corridors for emergency trips to Russia as Estonia prepares to close the border.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915583) reported that Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova accused Estonia of planning to erect a new Iron Curtain and stated Moscow would respond.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/estonia/estonia-to-close-all-land-border-crossings-with-russia-epak7xr) reported that Estonia will close all land border crossings with Russia from December 1, citing security threats and Russian-linked sabotage attacks.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-estonia-iron-curtain-border-closure-b3088663.html) reported that Moscow accused Estonia of erecting a new Iron Curtain after Tallinn announced plans to close road crossings with Russia.

On 20 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375264/estonia-close-border-russia-least-6-months-over-foiled-sabotage) reported that Estonia will close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds from December 1.

On 20 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222377), a Russian state outlet, reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal noted the government will be able to reassess the situation and decide on further actions regarding the border closure in six months.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185798-moldova-temporarily-closes-six-border-crossing-points-with-ukraine-following-russian-drone-attack.html) reported that Moldova temporarily closed six border crossing points with Ukraine following a Russian drone attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/estonia-s-president-urges-government-to-weigh-consequences-of-closing-russian-border) reported that Estonian President Ülle Madise urged the government to weigh the consequences of closing the border with Russia and avoid letting emotions drive the decision.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261117-estonia-closes-its-border-with-russia-but-can-it-keep-moscow-out), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87486196) reported that Estonia will close border crossing points with Russia starting December 1 for national security reasons.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87330337) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia on December 1 and that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda warned Lithuania is not ruling out similar measures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-estonia-to-close-russian-border-crossings-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/estonia-is-closing-its-border-with-russia-after-an-alleged-sabotage-attempt-and-preparing-to-move-government-services-to-the-cloud-in-case-of-invasion) reported that Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia starting December 1 following a suspected sabotage attack at Threod Systems.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063116/) reported that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda stated Lithuania may consider closing all border crossings with Russia if destabilisation efforts continue.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/estonia-to-close-russia-border-after-sabotage-bid-on-drone-maker-foreign-minister-says), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90202) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated the GRU ordered a sabotage attempt at defense company Threod Systems.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063038/) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha praised Estonian security services for thwarting the attack.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/estonia-russia-border-sabotage-bid/) reported that Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia marked an escalation in regional tensions linked to Moscow's war against Ukraine.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-crime/4184944-eight-people-detained-in-estonia-over-attempted-arson-attack-on-defense-industry-plant-allegedly-commissioned-by-russia.html) reported that the Estonian Prosecutor General's Office stated eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on a Threod defense industry building in Viimsi commissioned by Russia.

On 15 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218361) reported that Interior Minister Igor Taro stated Estonia will decide on closing its border with Russia next week on a temporary or permanent basis.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOVkhQYlBYSGp1OG16aUlIS0JBcWpXQnpYbDlDaVFqb0V4cG04dm9wbnptbW1WRnI1bmh2ck0tTmM2Vl9pYVN2dG5NVmpTM2liUG9JWDNkVTZPVUxQc0swQ3FuN3UyZ2tyanRHVENpeUQtbTl0Z3RYSlIzVFB3QnFtdzVvWURCWDlCVjhlclpUTlpWaVhxektwaEFtY2Z2ZGRUYmJ1Z0ozUW9jY0lSOURycDkxSktlRnc?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/estonia-to-close-border-crossings-with-russia-after-alleged-arson-attack?traffic_source=rss), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-after-moscow-linked-sabotage-attempt-on-drone-maker/) reported that Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged or attempted arson attack on a drone manufacturer.

On 15 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218399), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian diplomat Maria Zakharova stated Moscow will check information about Estonia's plans and view it as Russophobia if confirmed.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/estonian-drone-maker-targeted-by-gru-ordered-sabotage-attempt-pm-says) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia was preparing to potentially close its border with Russia.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-accuses-russia-of-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia after Tallinn's Internal Security Service stated an attempted arson attack on a defense firm was commissioned by Russia's GRU military intelligence agency.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90184) reported that Estonian security authorities thwarted an attempted explosion and arson attack against drone manufacturer Threod Systems and detained suspects.

On 15 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218363), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of December 1.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/20/4982175_poslednite_dva_udareni_koraba_v_bulgarskata/?ref=rss) reported that the last two ships struck in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea have not yet sunk, according to specialized publication Maritime.

On 19 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23958440) reported that Bulgarian President Rumen Radev stated the Black Sea must become a zone of shared security, noting its importance as a transport, energy, and digital corridor.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/lpg-tanker-that-sank-off-bulgaria-was-hit-by-projectiles-official/article71715541.ece) reported that an official stated the LPG tanker Gas Husky that sank off Bulgaria was hit by projectiles.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOU1RDM185endranZkZ1d1eF83NmxqSnNad2RzWGlrZU9UazRUaE83TlNpUjZ1SHowbURaWkpUSGJKeWhZQTFUV3c1NnNYSjNPaDlaaFFUaWdMN1BiOEpoMk5pYWtoN3ZhNTlnZzlpWmFpLXMtdDFlaWJFakRURVV4RFIta01EeWtMVDB2MHZEN3ljVWVWdUtEdVFZc3oyREFXMmZEWERUblo1VDg?oc=5) reported that a merchant ship sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast for a second consecutive day.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/19-people-rescued-after-gas-carrier-struck-in-black-sea) reported that 19 people were rescued after a gas carrier was struck in the Black Sea in an incident linked to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/drones-have-hit-15-ships-in-natos-black-sea-waters-since-october/) reported that Russian drones have struck 15 merchant ships in the Black Sea off NATO members Romania and Bulgaria since October 5 according to a tally by The Defence Blog.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90372) reported that the cargo ship BETUL 8 sank in the Black Sea off Bulgaria after an attack by two naval drones, according to a Bulgarian maritime outlet.

On 17 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009860/lpg-tanker-reported-to-have-sunk-off-bulgaria-s-black-sea-coast/story/) reported that a liquefied petroleum gas tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast a few dozen miles from a previous incident, according to the country's defense ministry.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/second-tanker-in-two-days-sinks-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast-search-operation-under-way) reported that a second tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/17/4980766_gazovoz_potuna_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska_zona_na/?ref=rss) reported that the tanker Gas Husky sank following a drone attack in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/leinster/2026/1117/1599491-vessel-wexford/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/17/six-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-vessel-ran-aground-off-coast-of-wexford/) reported that six crew members were rescued after an 88-metre cargo vessel ran aground off Roney Point on the Wexford coast.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast?traffic_source=rss) reported that all 12 crew members of a cargo ship that capsized off Bulgaria were rescued.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/cargo-ship-sinks-in-bulgarias-black-sea-after-reported-drone-attack-all-12-crew-rescued/) reported that authorities suspected a drone strike caused the vessel to capsize.

On 16 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/) reported that the ship was carrying 3,000 metric tons of wheat.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/16/4980351_turgovski_korab_potuva_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska/?ref=rss) reported that a merchant ship was sinking in the Bulgarian economic zone in the Black Sea near Kaliakra, according to the Ministry of Transport.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/15/4980175_dronove_udariha_tri_koraba_v_rumunski_vodi_v_cherno/?ref=rss) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial vessels in Romanian waters in the Black Sea near the Sulina canal.
On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90153) reported that an unidentified drone attacked the Palau-flagged commercial vessel Larissa 1 inside Romanian territorial waters.
On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90181) reported that Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu condemned the drone attack on three commercial vessels near the Danube Delta.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/three-commercial-vessels-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-pm-says) reported that Romania's Prime Minister called the drone strikes on three commercial vessels near Romania's Black Sea unacceptable and a violation of international law.

On 15 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009606/3-ships-struck-by-drones-in-black-sea-near-romanian-shipping-canal/story/) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial ships in the Black Sea near Romania's Sulina canal and armed forces scrambled aircraft.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/romanian-pm-condemns-unacceptable-drone-strikes-black-sea-ships/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/three-commercial-ships-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-coast-over-two-days/) reported that Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the strikes on three commercial vessels near Constanța.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/avion-iz-hong-konga-prinudno-sleteo-na-filipine-zbog-pozara-na-motoru/c9fw4ph), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1089783/video-drama-na-letu-iz-hong-konga-avion-sletio-na-filipinima-putnici-evakuisani-toboganima) reported that an Air Niugini flight carrying 146 passengers and crew from Hong Kong to Papua New Guinea made an emergency landing in Davao due to an engine fire, with passengers evacuated using slides.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/energy-fire-possibility-prompts-plane-landing-in-philippines-all-crew-and-passengers-safe-hong-kong-papua-new-guinea-101795234983204.html) reported that pilots detected possible sparks or fire in the right engine of an Air Niugini plane before an emergency landing in the Philippines.

On 21 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/1010279/air-niugini-aircraft-makes-emergency-landing-at-davao-airport-caap/story/) reported that an Air Niugini Boeing 767-383ER bound for Port Moresby made an emergency landing at Davao International Airport.

On 21 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/air-niugini-boeing-emergency-landing-philippines-6571121) reported that all 146 passengers and crew were safe after pilots detected possible sparks or fire in the right engine.

stories.title: Trump Claims Putin Wants Peace as Moscow Rejects NATO-Style Guarantees for Ukraine
stories.label: Proposed trilateral summit in China

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063962/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine needs security guarantees for decades rather than just for Donald Trump's term.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063891/) reported that US President Donald Trump declined to outline security guarantees for Kyiv, stating an agreement must come first.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Jamaica Gleaner](http://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/world-news/20261121/takeaways-historic-summit-among-trump-xi-and-putin) reported that United States President Donald Trump, China's Xi Jinping, and Russia's Vladimir Putin held their first-ever meeting in Shenzhen.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-claims-friend-putin-told-him-ukraine-war-wouldnt-have-started-if-he-were-potus-then-101795198522163.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90774) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed Vladimir Putin told him the Ukraine war would not have started if he were president and expressed a desire for peace.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-cites-good-talks-putin-ukraine-holds-back-security-guarantees) reported that US President Donald Trump said he and Russian leader Vladimir Putin held very good talks on Ukraine but held back on security guarantees.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90735) reported that Russia has rejected proposals for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine, calling arrangements resembling membership unacceptable.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-says-russia-open-to-nato-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated Russia appears willing to accept NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine after the war.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90681) reported that Jared Kushner stated Russia is becoming comfortable with security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective defense clause.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063771/), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/russia-pushes-back-against-us-idea-of-nato-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-a94326) reported that Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov called US ideas for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine unacceptable and demanded acknowledgment that Ukraine will not join the alliance, while confirming discussions on a potential visit to Moscow by British, German, and French representatives.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063712/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner, and European advisers to discuss security guarantees.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89357897) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated the United States is willing to offer Ukraine NATO-style security guarantees.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kushner-trump-open-to-nato-like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine?traffic_source=rss) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated President Donald Trump is open to offering NATO-like security guarantees to Ukraine.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/european-leaders-unite-in-berlin-to-reaffirm-support-for-ukraine?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed to retaliate for Kerch Bridge strikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/ukraine-war-briefing-trump-open-to-kyiv-getting-nato-like-mutual-defence-guarantee-says-kushner) reported that France called for a fresh look at Ukraine joining NATO.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249555/Shenzhen-summit-proved-US-can-no-longer-rally-states-on-Iran), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86327535/Shenzhen-summit-proved-US-no-longer-able-to-forge-alliance-against), state-media outlets, reported that senior Iranian leader adviser Mohammad Mokhber stated the Shenzhen summit proved the US is no longer able to forge an alliance or rally states against Iran.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/trump-admite-que-reducir-arsenal-nuclear-sumamente-dificil-pese-acuerdo-rusia-china_202611206b00990c5cb1082f89b0ff45.html) reported that US President Trump described his relationship with the leaders of China and Russia as fantastic following the first trilateral meeting between the three powers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/world/europe/trump-xi-putin-nuclear-weapons-ukraine.html) reported that after their summit, the leaders of Russia, the United States, and China agreed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNdERQSHBUWVRvbktIZEo4ZDFTS2FKNzZjRUwzamQ5VjkwUE9RQl9KSkoxdmJ2QmNnT2tzNkdKc2dYNjNNQ2Q3RVNERlB3X1NOa3FUTU5XdmNocGtRdWdSSzIyelZhd3Mwc0JEd0t6dXhicEd4TVRPclNPcy1TTkQwcFE5OVV1WFBrUmNEcWFRenA0TGJYMDh2OWMtaV9PZmd1LXJWa0hUMWU1bE5JSjcwTw?oc=5), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045885/trumps-personalised-diplomacy-hits-its-limits-with-3-way-summit) reported that US President Donald Trump's personalized diplomacy has hit its limits with a 3-way summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/f493945e3c26) reported that President Trump stated a deal with Xi and Putin to limit nuclear weapons will be difficult but he will keep pushing, and that President Xi agreed on limiting nuclear weapons.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPX3RYQ05XU192RjlmR2lPUTdzYTEwVHdETC0xdklDNF9kUm5VYzl6ckgzMHN6SHU1RlJPOUFqNUxBQWZYajJvbTFDX0ZSX3NHZllNSVBhLUtEbER2OU40WWpHZzcwajh4eEdFbEl1VGk4djZkR3MzWDU2LUM0WjBFU2tSbEZzaHZBMkJSVmIySURqMjhLM0M1ZmxoT01KSjl0RF9R?oc=5), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584282/trump-xi-and-putin-sign-symbolic-peace-declaration-at-unprecedented-shenzhen-summit/) reported that China published a 4-point peace declaration after the meeting between Xi, Putin, and Trump.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/xi-jinping-calls-for-total-elimination-of-nuclear-weapons-at-meeting-with-trump-and-putin) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping called for nuclear weapons to be banned and destroyed entirely during a meeting with Trump and Putin.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-xi-putin-peace-declaration-unprecedented-summit/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/trump-xi-putin-hold-historic-3-way-summit-pledge-peaceful-use-of-nuclear-weapons/) reported that China, the U.S., and Russia issued a symbolic peace declaration emphasizing that nuclear war should never be fought.
On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221925), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vladimir Putin stated Russia did not start the war in Ukraine and is trying to end it.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/u-s-warns-russia-it-should-make-peace-with-ukraine-now-while-trump-still-has-room-to-negotiate-the-kyiv-independent-reports) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner told Russian and Ukrainian negotiators that current talks may be the last chance.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90606) reported that after a trilateral meeting in China, Vladimir Putin claimed Russia did not start the war and accused Kyiv of blocking peace.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186570-kushner-reports-progress-on-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-and-postwar-reconstruction.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner said talks with Ukraine and European partners made progress on future security guarantees and postwar reconstruction.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/zelensky-questions-whether-kyiv-and-washington-mean-the-same-thing-by-nato-style-guarantees-and-reiterates-that-postwar-ukraine-would-need-foreign-troops-on-its-soil) reported that Jared Kushner stated the United States persuaded Russia to accept security guarantees for Ukraine based on Article 5 of NATO.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186578-kushner-confirms-us-considering-nato-article-5like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine.html) reported that the United States is prepared to consider providing Ukraine with security guarantees modeled on Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty if they serve U.S. interests.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063690/) Ukrainska Pravda reported that US special envoy Jared Kushner stated Washington is convincing Russia of the need for Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222081) TASS, a Russian state outlet, reported that Jared Kushner stated Russia was on board with the approach that security guarantees for Ukraine should be part of broader agreements.

On 19 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/kushner-says-trump-open-to-extend-nato-mutual-defense-type-clause-to-ukraine) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner said President Donald Trump was open to extending a security guarantee similar to NATO's mutual defense clause to Ukraine.
On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222077) reported that Jared Kushner stated Donald Trump is ready to appeal to the US Congress to ensure security guarantees to Kyiv.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/video-putins-nuclear-briefcase-caught-on-camera-in-china/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin's nuclear briefcase was caught on camera in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC summit, where a Russian officer confirmed it is the Cheget.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/donald-trump-presses-european-leaders-about-ukraine-aid-after-vladimir-putin-summit/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the U.S. president followed up his meeting with Russian and Chinese leaders with a surprise call to Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/trump-questions-europes-billions-in-ukraine-aid-during-surprise-call) reported that US President Donald Trump questioned Europe's billions in Ukraine aid during an unscheduled call to European allies from Air Force One after talks with Putin and Xi.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90642) reported that US President Donald Trump questioned European allies' continued military aid to Ukraine during an unscheduled telephone call to the Coalition of the Willing summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-says-nuclear-powers-need-only-about-10-weapons-before-xi-putin-summit-3725765) reported that US President Donald Trump told Fox News that nuclear powers need only 'about 10' weapons.

On 19 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-we-are-making-history-says-trump-at-historic-trilateral-with-xi-and-putin) reported that US President Donald Trump stated "We are really making history" at the first meeting in history between US, Chinese and Russian leaders in Shenzhen, China.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/we-are-making-history-what-did-trump-putin-and-xi-discuss-in-china-cpngnxj) reported that Trump, Putin and Xi held trilateral talks in China on Ukraine, nuclear weapons and global security, issuing a joint declaration on international cooperation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/trump-meets-putin-and-xi-ahead-of-us-russia-china-trilateral-talks?traffic_source=rss), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/china-calls-for-greater-trade-cooperation-as-apec-leaders-gather-in-shenzhen/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific economies to remove investment barriers and strengthen trade ties at the APEC gathering in Shenzhen.
