reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/21-11-sv-us-sikh-separatist-pannun-assassination-plot?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Indian national was sentenced to more than 19 years in a US prison for plotting to assassinate a Sikh separatist.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/telangana-man-killed-in-new-york-after-car-hits-deer-triggers-multi-vehicle-crash-101795255459233.html) reported that a man from Telangana was killed in New York after a car hit a deer and triggered a multi-vehicle crash.

On 21 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-judge-jails-indian-national-in-foiled-sikh-separatist-murder-plot/live-80008104?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a US judge jailed an Indian national in a foiled Sikh separatist murder plot, while New Delhi denied any role and over 200 people were hospitalized after a separate incident.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-court-sentences-nikhil-gupta-to-235-months-in-pannun-murder-for-hire-plot-101795223985520.html) reported that a US court sentenced Nikhil Gupta to 235 months in the Pannun murder-for-hire plot after he pleaded guilty to three charges.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pannun-murder-plot-us-court-sentences-nikhil-gupta-to-over-19-year-prison-term-for-bid-to-kill-sikh-extremist-101795192152550.html) reported that Indian national Nikhil Gupta was sentenced to 235 months in prison in a murder-for-hire plot against Sikh extremist Pannun.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/sikh-nikhil-gupta-hitman-b3088957.html), [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/20/man-sentenced-19-12-years-prison-plot-kill-sikh-separatist-leader-new/) reported that an Indian man was sentenced to just over 19 and a half years in prison in a murder-for-hire plot targeting a Sikh separatist leader in New York.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/sikh-nikhil-gupta-hitman-b3088957.html) reported that the judge stated the man faces deportation to India after completing his sentence.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/india-narendra-modi-punjab-new-york-sikh-b3088903.html), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/indian-man-sentenced-prison-murder-plot-sikh-separatist), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq702ez8d4lwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Nikhil Gupta was sentenced to just over 19 and a half years in prison in a murder-for-hire plot targeting a Sikh separatist leader in New York.

On 18 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm15ezz8n394o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Asif Merchant was sentenced to 27 years after being found guilty in March of trying to hire undercover FBI agents to assassinate US officials.

On 18 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/pakistani-man-gets-27-years-for-foiled-plot-to-kill-trump-biden/a-79976086?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a Pakistani man with ties to Iran's government received a sentence of more than 27 years in prison for plotting to kill US politicians.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistani-national-gets-over-27-years-in-us-prison-over-iran-backed-plot-to-assassinate-trump-101794972136328.html) reported that US District Judge Eric Komitee issued a 330-month prison term in Brooklyn, New York.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/17/pakistani-man-jailed-trump-murder-plot) reported that Asif Merchant, a Pakistani man allegedly linked to Iran, was sentenced to 27 years in a US prison over a plot to assassinate Donald Trump in retaliation for the death of Qassem Suleimani.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/pakistani-man-gets-27-years-in-us-jail-for-iran-backed-plot-to-kill-trump/articleshow/135945000.cms) reported that Asif Merchant was sentenced to 330 months in prison.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-man-sentenced-to-over-27-years-in-us-prison-over-alleged-iran-linked-assassination-plot/) reported that a Pakistani businessman was sentenced to more than 27 years in a US prison for plotting to assassinate a prominent American political figure.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQcDI2eEdMQzBuWElTakJTMzAxa1BMY3k5aVRYS3JpZEZ0cmE2b1Y4SGlRYnZFX19oYVVGQWhWT2JXcUdUbXEyMW5vSnVBeXhWcXMyNnNLR0Z0S2ROTTJOVHlWbXB1NjkyMy1saGFFdDB4YzY5TUU4a3BkMzRDMkFZN1cxdC05dXdic3ZYZGQ1RmdYVzE0eERjME1qeUg2dGp4MzFXZUFMN2xSMVVkZV9PMHIzaG1xd2s1cl9TMjM3WEhQVWpK?oc=5) reported that North Macedonia and Greece uncovered an Iran-linked assassination plot.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/north-macedonia-prevents-terrorist-assassination-plot-targeting-person-in-greece) reported that authorities seized guns and location sketches during the operation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915213) reported that five suspects linked to Iranian-linked drug lord Naji Sharifi Zindashti were arrested and a sixth remains at large.

stories.label: Mexico migration caravans and US tariff threats

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/migrants-caravan-in-mexico-walks-towards-us-border?traffic_source=rss) reported that around 300 migrants crossed from Guatemala into Mexico heading towards the United States.

On 21 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/21/politica/009n1pol?partner=rss) reported that US President Donald Trump reiterated that cartels control Mexico prior to nearly closing a commercial agreement.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641502/new-caravan-of-about-300-migrants-crosses-into-southern-mexico) reported that a new caravan of about 300 migrants crossed into southern Mexico heading north.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/trump-ve-cerca-un-acuerdo-comercial-pero-reitera-preocupacion-por-control-de-los-carteles-en-mexico-33232686) reported that Donald Trump stated during his meeting with Claudia Sheinbaum that cartels run Mexico.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/eu-y-mexico-estan-cerca-de-un-acuerdo-comercial-afirma-trump-la-relacion-entre-ambos-se-habia-salido-de-control-dice/) reported that Donald Trump stated the US and Mexico are close to a commercial agreement and reiterated that cartels control the country.

On 20 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1PX181a2VzcS1HYmlhcXY3WURINWZ1OTNxR0JZQmdFR21oVVdGYnlPVlhpRWVrT0RMbVA4c0hySk4yaWxMblZSQ0N0ZjBzbFNRQ3RORzNQeG9qZTNzelgyX1dZbXJWVnRNR0pRUjFzU0U0ZVFVM0E?oc=5) reported that a migrant caravan is making its way through Mexico to the U.S. after Democrats won midterms.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/17/economia/017n3eco?partner=rss) reported that US President Donald Trump renewed threats to impose heavy tariffs on Mexico if Claudia Sheinbaum's government does not stop the advance of undocumented migrants.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/trump-reitera-a-mexico-amenaza-de-imponer-fuertes-aranceles-por-avance-de-caravana-migrante-33160498) reported that Donald Trump reiterated tariff threats against Mexico over migrant caravans, while Claudia Sheinbaum's government stated no caravans have reached the border.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/14/migrant-caravan-heads-to-us-from-mexico-after-democrats-midterm-win?traffic_source=rss) reported that a migrant caravan of more than a thousand people is heading towards the U.S. border from southern Mexico.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-14/the-migrant-caravan-crossing-mexico-that-has-triggered-trumps-new-tariff-threat-our-fear-is-that-the-mexican-president-will-send-us-back.html) reported that about 1,500 people are walking from the south of Mexico toward the United States, prompting Donald Trump to threaten Claudia Sheinbaum with doubling trade tariffs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPUmR4MUpicDNxbGdzTmVfWG5fWTQ0bjF1dlljUHF3RnRiNVZJb2JRdEF4Q0Q5Y01QZFV5T3lkODFNR3BXQmc4Q1Q0b1ZFeHBxWEVKZlE5ZV9LTnhoRzVMeGNpenBqMUNsTlJ1Z0JaRmpLZzZQX2YtUGlZbUhWVFM0b0V1Tk5NdUlZZElDUU0wR0VFYkp4dHF1NUdRQnBTaElFbUhQUg?oc=5) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum stated a migrant caravan is not moving toward the US now as Trump threatens tariffs.

On 12 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/trump-threatens-double-tariffs-on-mexico/), a state-media outlet, reported that US President Donald Trump warned he will immediately double tariffs on Mexico over migrant caravans.

On 13 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/13/apos-trump-ameacar-com-tarifas-sheinbaum-afirma-que-nao-ha-nenhuma-caravana-de-migrantes-a-caminho-dos-eua.ghtml) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum stated that there are no migrant caravans traveling toward the United States following Donald Trump's tariff threat.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQdWdSaDA1Z1ZyaFBzb2lWR1VzcEs5OGlsZzJhX2tNNXRia3NBcElYZzB2OTR3NW4wV09fY29NZ2JjRUFrazRwY3BkUllCX0FWWkFoNkhienpZMXFEOG9jLW02NWtubXpHZDRiRHFKeENZVlpORjFOMXE3UEkxUnA3aWFnX2QxQldMd2VVNDdwVmwxSUE3eVlEMzN2d0NnanBFbkFVY3pKRkY3bjdneVFyWEV0VjM2Y29qdnNXV0tB?oc=5), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/soy-optimista-en-alcanzar-acuerdos-comerciales-con-canada-y-mexico-dice-bessent-secretario-del-tesoro-no-habla-sobre-amenazas-de-trump-de-aranceles/) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent expressed optimism regarding trade deals with Canada and Mexico.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/mexico/2026-11-13/la-caravana-migrante-que-cruza-mexico-nuestro-terror-es-que-la-presidenta-diga-no-me-conviene-que-suban-los-aranceles-y-nos-regrese.html) reported that around 1,500 people are walking from southern Mexico toward the United States, prompting Trump to threaten to double trade taxes.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/13/politica/007n1pol?partner=rss), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-enfurece-por-caravanas-migrantes-responde-claudia-sheinbaum/) reported that in response to Donald Trump's threat to double tariffs on Mexico over migration caravans, President Claudia Sheinbaum stated that no group has reached the north and highlighted support from the INM.

stories.title: At COP31, conflict over climate science slows action on global warming
stories.label: COP31 climate summit protests in Antalya

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/cop31-in-antalya-hosts-joint-declaration-press-conference-3725812) reported that ministers and officials from multiple countries attended a joint declaration press conference at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/20/turkey-activists-chant-shame-as-cop31-negotiations-falter) reported that climate activists denounced the proposed outcome of COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, accusing governments of failing to deliver meaningful measures.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/at-cop31-conflict-over-climate-science-slows-action-on-global-warming/a-80004894?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that attacks on climate science and disinformation risk delaying key measures at COP31 in Antalya.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/cop31-global-climate-challenge-imperative-of-intl-action/) reported that the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference is being held in Antalya, Turkiye, from 9 to 20 November 2026.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/20/african-negotiators-at-cop31-demand-concrete-measures-on-climate-justice/) reported that the African Group of Negotiators called for concrete measures on climate justice at COP31 as UN climate talks went into overtime.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cop31-african-workers-declare-no-more-empty-promises-as-unions-demand-climate-justice-decent-jobs-2/) reported that ITUC-Africa represented 18 million organized workers across 52 African countries at the COP31 summit to demand climate justice and decent jobs.

stories.title: Ukraine Strikes Afipsky, Ilsky Refineries Again as Russian Fuel Crisis Deepens
stories.label: Russian strikes on Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186809-general-staff-confirms-three-oil-tanks-hit-at-pumping-station-in-russias-tatarstan.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-strikes-key-druzhba-oil-pipeline-station-in-russias-tatarstan-general-staff-confirms/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff confirmed Ukrainian defense forces struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk in Russia's Republic of Tatarstan, hitting three oil tanks on the Druzhba pipeline more than 1,000 kilometers from the front line.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063746/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186678-two-killed-four-injured-in-russian-attack-on-railway-station-in-lviv.html) reported that two people were killed and at least four others were injured in a Russian attack on a railway station in Lviv.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063598/) reported that a Russian strike hit an apartment building in Izium, injuring 14 people including children.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063495/) reported that a Russian attack damaged the Museum of Modern Art in Odesa.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/four-killed-as-russian-strikes-hit-ukraines-odesa?traffic_source=rss) reported that at least four people were killed and thirteen injured after Russian strikes hit Ukraine's port city of Odesa.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186044-general-staff-confirms-strikes-on-ilsky-and-afipsky-oil-refineries.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces attacked and hit the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Territory.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90455) reported that Ukraine struck the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Territory for the second time this month.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/ukrainian-drones-strike-two-oil-refineries-in-southern-russia), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185869-drones-attack-afipsky-and-ilsky-oil-refineries-in-russia-media-reports.html), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583328/ukrainian-drone-strikes-spark-fires-at-two-russian-oil-refineries/) reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar region, sparking fires and injuring four people in the Seversky district.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/18/ukrainian-drones-target-krasnodar-region-refineries-a94294) reported that Russia's Defense Ministry said it intercepted 183 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions overnight.

On 18 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-kyiv-targets-krasnodar-refineries-after-felling-kerch-bridge/live-79976877?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian strikes targeted two industrial facilities overnight in Krasnodar following action against the Kerch bridge.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/why-ukraine-keeps-targeting-the-kerch-bridge/article71714957.ece) reported that Ukraine has targeted the Kerch Bridge multiple times, most recently on November 17, 2026.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90463), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063406/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-strikes-central-odesa-kills-3-injures-7/) reported that a Russian drone strike on a residential building in central Odesa killed three people and injured seven others.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185794-part-of-kyivs-livoberezhnyi-district-to-temporarily-lose-heating.html) reported that buildings in Kyiv's Livoberezhnyi residential district will temporarily lose heating due to repair work.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-crimea-bridge-trump-putin-zelensky-b3086877.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/2-russian-oil-refineries-reportedly-targeted-in-overnight-drone-attack-on-krasnodar-krai/) reported that two Russian oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai were targeted in overnight drone attacks.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063375/) reported that explosions and air defense responses occurred near the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063333/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185762-russian-strike-on-central-vinnytsia-injures-four.html) reported that four people were injured in a Russian attack on central Vinnytsia on Tuesday evening.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185409-317-buildings-in-kyivs-darnytskyi-district-left-without-heating-after-russian-attack.html) reported that 317 residential buildings in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district were left without heating after a Russian attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063226/) reported that a combined Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's industrial and energy infrastructure left two people dead and 18 injured.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185451-russian-attack-on-kyiv-kills-two-injures-one.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90324), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063228/) reported that a Russian attack on Kyiv's Obolonskyi district killed two people and injured another, damaging residential and non-residential buildings.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185465-russian-drone-strikes-parking-lot-in-vinnytsia-killing-one-woman-and-injuring-another.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063235/) reported that a Russian drone strike on a car park in Vinnytsia killed one woman and injured another.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063182/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185381-car-driver-killed-in-drone-attack-on-zaporizhzhia.html) reported that a driver was killed when an FPV drone hit a car in Zaporizhzhia during a Russian evening attack.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185324-russian-forces-attack-zaporizhzhia-woman-injured.html) reported that a woman was injured in a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90301) reported that Ukrainian rescuers freed a 51-year-old woman trapped beneath rubble after a Russian strike on an industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063085/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185147-russian-forces-strike-balakliia-in-kharkiv-region-killing-one-injuring-four.html) reported that a Russian strike on central Balakliia in Kharkiv Oblast killed one person, injured four others, and damaged a postal facility.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063149/) reported that Russian attacks on Dnipro have killed two people and injured eight others, causing the sixth blackout in two weeks and leaving almost half of the city without power.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185150-russian-forces-attack-two-industrial-facilities-in-chernihiv-killing-two-injuring-four.html) reported that a Russian attack on two industrial facilities in Chernihiv killed two people and injured four others.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185202-russian-forces-attack-food-processing-facility-in-kirovohrad-region-two-injured.html) reported that a Russian attack on a food processing facility in the Kirovohrad region left two people injured.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063033/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185025-russian-strike-on-dnipro-kills-one-injures-three.html) reported that a Russian attack on Dnipro killed one person and injured ten others.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063047/) reported that a woman was killed and two other people were injured in a Russian drone strike on Zaporizhzhia, and the Preobrazhenskyi Bridge was closed to traffic.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249475/Iran-Oman-FMs-discuss-regional-stability-in-Muscat) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran and Oman discussed bilateral relations and regional stability in Muscat.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323759/Araghchi-meets-Pakistan-s-Army-chief-to-discuss-regional-security), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249456/Araghchi-meets-Pakistan-s-Army-chief-to-discuss-reg-security) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Pakistan Army Chief Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir to discuss regional security.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249454/ECO-FMs-support-Iran-s-initiative-to-permanently-end-war), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532222/ECO-Backs-Iran-Plan-to-End-Imposed-War) reported that the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization concluded in Islamabad with the adoption of support for Iran's initiative to end the war.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323628/Iran-Russia-FMs-hold-phone-talks-to-discuss-regional-developments), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249452/Araghchi-Lavrov-hold-call-to-discuss-regional-developments) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a phone conversation to discuss regional developments.

On 15 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322588/Araghchi-set-to-visit-Pakistan-and-Oman-Foreign-Ministry) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will visit Pakistan and Oman.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drones Target Smolensk Region Fertilizer Plant
stories.label: Ukrainian drone attacks in Russia

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/ukrainian-drones-target-smolensk-region-fertilizer-plant-a94325) reported that Ukrainian drones targeted the Dorogobuzh chemical plant in the Smolensk region, a facility accounting for about 11% of Russia's ammonium nitrate production.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186683-drones-attack-chemical-plant-producing-components-for-explosives-in-russias-smolensk-region-media.html) reported that drones attacked the Dorogobuzh chemical plant producing explosive components in Russia's Smolensk region.
On 20 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2222287) reported that air defenses shot down 32 drones over the Smolensk region and damage occurred to an energy facility.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-strike-russian-chemical-plant/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/ukrainian-drones-hit-russian-fertilizer-plant-that-also-makes-components-for-explosives) reported that Ukrainian drones struck a chemical plant in Dorogobuzh in Russia's Smolensk region.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222021), a Russian state outlet, reported that the number of people injured in a Ukrainian attack on Kursk rose to 13 after three individuals were hospitalized with moderate injuries.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/19/damaged-buildings-and-debris-after-ukrainian-attack-on-russias-kursk) reported that at least 11 people were injured after a Ukrainian attack damaged residential buildings and public facilities in Kursk.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPUXY4SS1DQy01LTV4VDEwYTVCV2hCeThSemNINHhHNFk2Zk1ZNGpIWVk1MFlyMUJwWGFlS1otZGRYSHpYYUlqQlZOMjRrQURxU29GNlhkTmJVU1l3VE1TTkR1dWhCM2dJT2QyUnRkR0dlRVE5eHhiUHBVSUVaa0ppOFJDb0I1M081eHhNQUd4WXhlWnJ6d0RYTVhWamRONXVFZmpjVGFuYmtTeG5FYXVkcXRFaVY1RnhobzYzZjNB?oc=5) reported that local authorities said Russia repelled a Ukrainian drone attack on an oil facility in the Tatarstan region.

On 19 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649093-ukraine-kursk-drone-attack/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that 11 people, including a child, have been injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Kursk.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/19/kursk-daytime-ukrainian-attack-injures-11-in-kursk-a94309), [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221505) reported that a daytime Ukrainian drone attack in Kursk injured 11 people, including a 12-year-old child.
On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2221325) reported that Kursk regional governor stated eleven people including a child were injured in a Ukrainian attack.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/ukrainian-drone-attack-on-russia-s-kursk-injures-11-people) reported that Kursk Governor Alexander Khinshtein stated a Ukrainian drone attack on Kursk injured 11 people.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-target-oil-hub-in-russias-tatarstan/), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063575/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90575), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/ukrainian-drones-attack-oil-storage-tanks-in-russia-s-tatarstan), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186277-drone-attack-reported-on-kaleykino-oil-pumping-station-in-russias-tatarstan.html) reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station and oil storage tanks in Russia's Tatarstan Republic.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-strikes-cut-russian-oil-refinery-processing-by-45-reuters-reports/) reported that Ukrainian attacks over the past 20 days disrupted or stopped operations at 15 of Russia's 35 major refineries.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/ukrainian-drone-attacks-have-cut-the-amount-of-oil-russia-refines-by-45-since-late-october-reuters-reports) reported that according to two industry sources, Ukrainian drone attacks have cut the amount of oil Russian refineries process by 45% since late October.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062991/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184999-ukraine-disables-over-55-of-russias-oil-refining-capacity-zelensky.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that long-range strikes have halted or disabled more than 55 percent of Russia's oil refining capacity.

On 15 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648864-six-injured-ukrainian-drone-attack-russia-tatarstan/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that local authorities stated six people were injured in a Ukrainian drone raid on Nizhnekamsk in Russia's Tatarstan.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drone-attacks-neutralized-55-of-russias-oil-refining-capacity-zelensky-says/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky cited a report by Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi stating that Ukrainian drone attacks have neutralized more than 55% of Russia's oil refining capacity.

stories.title: Spain General Strike Over Housing Costs

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-18/cc-oo-acudira-a-los-tribunales-por-la-actuacion-policial-en-la-huelga-general-buena-parte-de-las-personas-golpeadas-son-de-nuestro-sindicato.html) reported that the Workers' Commissions union will go to court over police actions during the general strike, stating a good portion of the people beaten belonged to their union.

On 13 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/spain-workers-1-general-strike-14-years/) reported that Spain's unions and tenant groups united across more than 50 cities in a general strike to demand rent caps, higher wages, and price controls.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/spain/2026-11-12/spains-general-strike-draws-uneven-participation-and-large-street-protests.html) reported that demonstrations during Spain's general strike were overwhelmingly peaceful, although clashes were recorded in Madrid and Barcelona.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-housing-protests-madrid-barcelona-b3083749.html) reported that more than 3 million people took to the streets in Spain for housing protests, resulting in at least 115 arrests nationwide.

On 12 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/marlaska-ordena-ahora-investigar-actuacion-policial-huelga-general_202611126af5837403bbf30bb049669c.html) reported that the Interior Minister ordered an investigation into police actions during the general strike and instructed agents not to use tear gas in demonstrations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/ofensiva-marlaska-dentro-fuera-gobierno-cargas-policiales-huelga_202611126af589d09a31a65adcd96693.html) reported that Frente Amplio and Podemos demanded the dismissal of the Interior Minister after the police actions on 11-N, while Bolanos discarded his dismissal.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/world/europe/spain-general-strike.html) reported that workers in Spain staged a general strike to protest rising rents and stagnant wages.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-general-strike-protesters-riot-police-clash-b3083461.html) reported that millions of workers took to the streets during the general strike in Spain over housing costs.

On 11 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/spain-housing-crisis-prompts-general-strike-mass-nighttime-protests/a-79915208?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that hundreds of thousands of citizens hit the streets to protest Spain's housing crisis after millions of union workers staged a general strike.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/spain-holds-its-first-general-strike-in-14-years-amid-mass-protests-and-police-charges) reported that riot police clashed with masked protesters in Madrid and Barcelona during Spain's first general strike in 14 years, leaving more than 70 people arrested.

On 12 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648726-barcelona-protests-clashes-rally/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that masked rioters smashed windows, looted shops, and set fires after tens of thousands marched in Barcelona demanding affordable housing.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/11/police-clash-with-protesters-during-spains-general-strike-video) reported that clashes erupted in the streets of Barcelona and Madrid as millions of Spanish workers took part in the general strike.

On 11 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/spain-general-strike-over-housing-costs-before-national-election) reported that millions of Spanish workers shut down businesses and public transportation in a protest over housing costs.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/alexandros-paporakis-illinois-temple-attack-accused-pleads-not-guilty-101795148209003.html) reported that Alexandros Paporakis pleaded not guilty after being charged with making a terrorist threat and unlawful use of a weapon in connection with an alleged Hindu temple attack plot.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPdUtIQmxQQnlXMDhPWU9sb3lhekNHdmVFNlplRGkzdnF1SnVDaHJHSzNqckFRZDluM09JM1dpbm1rd1dpeXh2NXB2YnczLW9ZSUw1SE1VMTFkNmQwa2dSaWFvSWs2dnkwNnJReEFOdFJ6dHhXckUwOEhCdXlub19Nb0EwaW90TnpoS0RUNGZSVEZvSEQzNjVFN0lJT2RSMmNU?oc=5) reported that an Illinois man pleaded not guilty over a thwarted mass shooting at a Hindu temple.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/hindu-temple-attack-plot-illinois-man-indicted-on-multiple-terrorism-charges/articleshow/135978145.cms) reported that an Illinois man was indicted on multiple terrorism charges regarding a Hindu temple attack plot.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-man-accused-of-plotting-hindu-temple-shooting-in-illinois-faces-additional-terrorism-and-weapons-charges/articleshow/135970853.cms) reported that 19-year-old Alexandros Paporakis of Palatine faces terrorism and armed violence charges for allegedly planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/illinois-ethanol-plant-bomb-threat-charges) reported that 41-year-old Andrew M. Kozak pleaded not guilty in federal court to two charges connected to an explosive device found at an Illinois ethanol plant.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/peoria-illinois-bomb-threat-indictment.html) reported that a federal grand jury in Peoria charged a man, who may have worked at the BioUrja plant, with threatening to detonate an explosive device.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/andrew-kozak-alleged-peoria-illinois-bomb-plot-suspect-worked-at-biourja-renewables-ethanol-plant-he-tried-to-blow-up-report-101794899306014.html) reported that federal investigators alleged 41-year-old trainee Andrew Kodak planted an explosive device at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/unexploded-bomb-found-in-idaho-city-prompts-neighbourhood-evacuation-as-authorities-launch-probe-101794890698541.html) reported that Kootenai County officials said residents near Belmont and Appaloosa were evacuated after a suspected unexploded bomb was discovered in Idaho.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/illinois-bomb-ethanol-plant-suspect) reported that a suspect is in custody and the FBI is leading the investigation into an explosive device found at an Illinois ethanol plant.

On 16 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/us/peoria-bomb-threat-arrest.html) reported that authorities found and deactivated a bomb at an ethanol plant, leading to evacuations in significant portions of Peoria and East Peoria.

On 16 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Illinois-Ethanol-Plant-Bomb-Is-the-Latest-Threat-to-US-Energy-Sites.html) reported that authorities arrested a suspect in the investigation into the explosive device found at the Illinois ethanol plant.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/law-enforcement-searches-illinois-plant-after-credible-threat-of-explosive-device-101794688615104.html) reported that law enforcement searched an Illinois plant following a credible threat of an explosive device.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/police-lift-evacuation-after-bomb-found-near-ethanol-plant-in-central-illinois-101794688737536.html) reported that police lifted evacuations after a bomb was found near an ethanol plant in central Illinois.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/residents-evacuated-after-bomb-found-at-illinois-ethanol-plant-fbi-joins-probe/articleshow/135837352.cms), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/peoria-bomb-threat-police-continue-search-for-more-explosives-at-biourja-plant-as-evacuation-order-remains-101794674711354.html) reported that police and the FBI are continuing their search for explosives at the BioUrja plant in Illinois where a bomb was found, while residents remain evacuated.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/14/peoria-illinois-evacuation-bomb) reported that Peoria officials stated a bomb was found at BioUrja Renewables and later defused, and the FBI said it is investigating.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPSWRUeUVCV0dNLU1YTGo0NVF1QUVEZ0ZvRXhhcy1YX0wwTHpBUk4xTlpOaThuT3dURFY3MktkQ1oxajFpS3hlTHkwLTJubnlwd1JQSUIxUUdyTkM2Ymh3QWt1enJmb2FraVJXS3BOYmtNTExoT0lCR2N4QnpXRGVrYTIxdlhhNG1PUHJ6cDJVUQ?oc=5) reported that residents were evacuated after a bomb was found at an industrial plant in Illinois.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/bomb-ethanol-plant-peoria-illinois.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/east-peoria-orders-one-mile-evacuation-after-bomb-threat-at-biourja-renewables-plant-in-illinois-101794626785566.html) reported that a bomb threat and suspicious package were found at the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in East Peoria, Illinois, prompting authorities to order a one-mile radius evacuation.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/castilla-y-leon/papa-leon-xiv-nombra-arzobispo-vallisoletano-aurelio-garcia_202611216b01e337c0d5c85b96c4077e.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV named Aurelio García, secretary of the Dicastery for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments in Rome, as archbishop.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-alerta-sobre-riesgos-enormes-de-la-tecnologia-sin-regulacion-pide-proteger-el-espacio-ultraterrestre-de-usos-no-pacificos/), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-papa-leon-xiv-advierte-sobre-el-enorme-riesgo-para-la-humanidad-que-representa-el-desarrollo-tecnologico-sin-etica-3603007) reported that Pope Leo XIV warned against the enormous risks to humanity posed by unethically regulated technology.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/nelson-castro-respondio-a-las-criticas-que-recibio-por-su-cobertura-de-la-visita-del-papa-leon-xiv-a-nid20112026/) reported that journalist Nelson Castro responded to criticism he received regarding his coverage of Pope Leo XIV's visit to Peru.

On 17 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/17/leo-xiv-after-his-tour-there-is-no-need-to-hate-each-other-or-use-such-violent-language?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV criticized aggressive political debate and polarization.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/peru-to-investigate-technical-failures-at-pope-leo-xivs-mass-in-lima/) reported that Peru's Foreign Ministry announced an investigation into technical failures involving audio systems and giant screens during Pope Leo XIV's mass in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/17/pope-leo-xivs-visit-shines-global-spotlight-on-perus-afro-peruvian-heritage-and-cultural-d/) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited the town of Zaña during his tour of Peru.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/del-papacoptero-al-golpe-de-una-pulsera-en-el-ojo-los-momentos-insolitos-del-viaje-del-papa-por-suramerica-3601655) reported that Pope Leo XIV completed a 12-day tour visiting Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, which featured incidents including being struck in the eye by a rosary bracelet.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/17/video-shows-pope-leo-xiv-struck-in-the-face-by-rosary-bracelet) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the face by a rosary bracelet thrown from the crowd in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/cancilleria-de-peru-investiga-fallas-tecnicas-durante-la-ultima-misa-del-papa-leon-xiv-en-lima-empresas-contratistas-podrian-recibir-sanciones-3601533) reported that the Peruvian Chancellery is investigating technical failures during the Pope's final mass in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-papa-leon-xiv-no-levantara-las-restricciones-de-francisco-a-la-misa-en-el-antiguo-rito-en-latin-nid17112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV stated he will not lift restrictions on the old Latin mass during his flight back to the Vatican.

On 16 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009739/pope-leo-ends-south-america-tour-that-drew-millions-with-one-final-vast-crowd/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV wrapped up a 12-day South America trip by leading a farewell Mass in Peru, closing a three-nation tour that drew 13 million people.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/papa-leon-xiv-en-peru-en-vivo-las-ultimas-actividades-antes-del-fin-del-viaje-minuto-a-minuto-nid16112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV continued his agenda on the final day of his South American tour with a visit and a mass before departure from Cal Airdrome.

On 16 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/16/leo-xiv-rides-in-a-peruvian-military-helicopter-cockpit-and-reaches-cusco?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV shared the cockpit with Peruvian Air Force pilots during a helicopter journey to Cusco.

On 15 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/pope-leo-heads-to-the-amazon-on-the-final-leg-of-his-south-american-tour/a-79952884?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Pope Leo XIV headed to the Amazon on the final leg of his South American tour, where he warned that deforestation, illegal mining, and pollution threaten the Amazon and demanded justice for environmental defenders.

On 15 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/vaticano/notizie/2026/11/15/il-papa-a-cusco-langelus-a-3mila-metri-dopo-loperazione-_9a8adf03-7d7d-4158-b2d8-3ccd37cc5021.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Cusco and held the Angelus at 3,000 meters altitude.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/pope-leo-south-america-tour-amazon-rainforest-b3085327.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV demanded justice for environmental defenders killed while protecting the Amazon.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/kosciol/art45491531-leon-xiv-w-andach-papiez-zwrocil-sie-do-chorych-i-mieszkancow-peru) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Cusco, met with thousands of faithful, and prayed in front of the cathedral.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/games/2026/nov/21/a-new-record-for-entertainment-grand-theft-auto-vi-sales-hit-38bn-on-first-day-of-release-developer-says) reported that Rockstar Games announced Grand Theft Auto VI sales hit $3.8 billion on its first day of release.

On 19 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPSGpjVHIzQ0YyREdGTF85N0dBQmFfVHVuZEp3WGpibnRjdmtqak9RWTRCa1pxQVNzRW5nb2tKYVVTcUJld0NFWEN0MlFrN3VOclF3QmZBVEQ2N3FJbUJGcnY1eXY3R0VPTHBQNDY0SThHYlNSWDVnRHJHRVZGbXhjSXhPZDE?oc=5) reported that fans skipped work to play Grand Theft Auto VI.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/culture/2026/11/19/grand-theft-auto-vi-review-provocative-sweary-action-packed-imperfect-fun/) reported that Grand Theft Auto VI delivers provocative, action-packed fun.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/grand-theft-auto-vi-released-after-13-year-wait-selling-over-17-million-copies) reported that 'Grand Theft Auto VI' sold over 17 million copies after its release following a 13-year wait.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/saudi-gamers-hit-the-gas-as-grand-theft-auto-vi-finally-drops-3012775) reported that Grand Theft Auto VI launched after a 13-year anticipation and a $1 billion production cost.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-for-third-consecutive-term-office/) reported that Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to seek a third consecutive term as president of El Salvador in February 2027 following constitutional reform.

Bukele confirmed and celebrated that his troops had destroyed or demolished the home of a key Haitian gang leader known as Jeff.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941169) reported that thousands of people poured into the streets of Port-au-Prince and beyond to praise El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haiti Libre](https://www.haitilibre.com/article-48884-haiti-flash-l-armee-du-salvador-utilise-des-chiens-robots-de-combat-equipes-de-fusil-d-assaut.html) reported that a joint operation under a bilateral agreement allowed authorities to regain control using combat robot dogs equipped with assault rifles.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-ter-destruido-quartel-general-de-gangue-no-haiti-veja-video.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that Salvadoran military personnel in Haiti destroyed the headquarters of the 400 Mawozo gang.

stories.title: Moldova airspace violation by Russian missiles

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89816890) reported that a new jet-powered drone violated the airspace of the Republic of Moldova amidst Russian attacks on Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-three-airspace-violations_n_6b004317e4b0976dc4a2f08e) reported that Poland condemned three airspace violations by Russia as a provocation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-airspace-violations?traffic_source=rss) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after airspace violations during European troop exercises.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89556156) reported that Moldova's permanent representative to the OSCE strongly condemned violations of national airspace amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-20/ukraine-war-spills-over-into-eastern-poland.html) reported that residents of eastern Polish border regions live with SMS alerts about Russian attacks and the sound of fighter jets as the Ukraine war spills over.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186768-ukraine-cooperating-with-poland-in-probe-into-airspace-violation-fm-sybiha.html) reported that Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the airspace violation during Russia's massive attack.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-3-airspace-violations-a94331) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after three airspace violations.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/unidentified-object-falls-in-eastern-poland-amid-major-russian-attack-on-ukraine), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063740/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90676), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9f4712724be0), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-reports-airspace-violation-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine-investigates-debris-crash/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186756-poland-investigating-crash-of-unidentified-object-near-border-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that Poland is investigating a possible airspace violation or falling unidentified object during a Russian attack on Ukraine.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90692) reported that Poland evacuated its Rzeszow Airport control tower for the first time during the attack.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89347044) reported that Germany reaffirmed its defense commitments to Moldova and prioritized airspace protection following repeated Russian drone incursions.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89297987) reported that an unidentified drone entered Moldovan airspace from Ukraine, traveling for nine minutes from the Vinnytsia region.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88193791) reported that fragments of a Gerbera-2 drone were discovered near the village of Cuhureștii de Sus following a November 17 incursion.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185880-debris-of-russian-gerbera2-drone-found-in-moldova.html) reported that drone debris was also found near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hungary Today](https://hungarytoday.hu/hungarian-conservatives-condemn-russian-drone-attack-on-ukraines-transcarpathia/) reported that several Russian drones struck Ukraine’s Transcarpathian region, targeting areas around Mukachevo.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88197893) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha condemned the incursion of Russian drones into Moldovan airspace.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88020919) reported that police located aircraft fragments near the village of Pohrebeni in the Orhei district following airspace violations.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87567475) reported that Moldovan Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister Mihai Popsoi condemned the violation of national airspace by a Shahed-type drone.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/84002601) reported that the Moldovan Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the violation of national airspace by two Banderol cruise missiles.

stories.title: Oil Prices Extend Weekly Losses Despite Middle East Tensions
stories.label: International Energy Agency global oil supply and diesel prices report

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Oil-Prices-Caught-Between-a-Looming-Glut-and-Middle-East-Turmoil.html) reported that oil prices traded in a narrow range as forecasts of a supply surplus collided with attacks and stalled diplomacy in the Middle East.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-blockade-oil-revenue-war/33902633.html) reported that with Iran's oil revenue set to hit zero by mid-December, IRGC-linked media and hard-liners are pushing for a tanker convoy to break the U.S. naval blockade.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/oil-prices-extend-weekly-losses-despite-middle-east-tensions/) reported that oil prices fell on Friday and headed for a third consecutive weekly decline.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/oil-heads-third-weekly-loss-iran-tests-us-blockade-crude-transfer) reported that Brent fell below $91 per barrel on Friday.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/oil-prices-rise-on-fresh-middle-east-supply-fears/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584378/oil-prices-rise-amid-fresh-middle-east-tensions/) reported that oil prices rose due to fresh Middle East supply concerns and security threats.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/20/oil-on-track-to-post-weekly-decline-despite-middle-east-tension/) reported that oil prices remain on track to post a third weekly decline despite Middle East tension.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-19/ty-article/report-nsa-hub-for-middle-east-intelligence-hit-by-network-outages/000001a1-f4b3-d175-abf5-feb72ea10000) reported that officials suspect security updates disrupted a National Security Agency classified internal network used for Middle East intelligence operations, prompting the agency to rely on backup systems.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/nsa-outage-georgia-middle-east-b3088077.html) reported that a facility monitoring cybersecurity in the Middle East is the latest impacted by an ongoing NSA outage.

On 19 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/world/asia/russia-china-united-states-oil-joint-statement.html) reported that the United States, China, and Russia agreed to boost the supply of refined petroleum products as oil prices spike due to the Iran war.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/nsa-outage-hits-key-facility-for-middle-east-intel-operations-as-agency-resorts-to-workarounds-sources-say/) reported that IT disruptions kept large swaths of the National Security Agency's workforce at home and impacted operations at a key facility for Middle East intelligence operations.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/nsa-outage-disrupts-us-intelligence-facility-supporting-middle-east-operations-report-101795056140128.html) reported that a technology outage disrupted the NSA's classified communications network at its Georgia facility, affecting coordination with personnel in the Middle East.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Profit by Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOQTdRRVdxQklZR3g3WHFTazQ4NGc2TXRCSzRHLWp6U2tkNURLWGtPQ0FmcWtwRXJQTm1iemc1SlE3aU1SX1k2Y1FEUi00THNWRm1KVUdOck43czAybDFabldWTVBKWUVHWTBSZUhpVmJydHhwLXJEd0d5SDRVREpnU0JlUGlEbFl3aUNkNGhVLUpWdXV0bmVJUHJmMzdnblVoX3pDMkhDemRPclFCTG8ybjZrSmw1dEQ0R3l5WXBXNXdpVkZB?oc=5), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045456/pakistans-mango-exports-fall-36pc-amid-us-iran-war-exporters-association) reported that Pakistan's mango exports fell 36 percent as Middle East tensions and the US-Iran war disrupted shipping routes and drove up freight costs.

On 18 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Crude-Oil/US-Oil-Inventories-On-the-Rise.html) reported that United States crude oil inventories increased by 3.4 million barrels during the week ending November 13.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640958/oil-prices-fall-as-higher-us-crude-stocks-temper-supply-risks) reported that US West Texas Intermediate futures fell 56 cents to $85.45 a barrel as higher US crude stocks tempered supply risks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-fall-2-as-us-crude-inventories-rise-5-28-million-barrels-us-iran-conflict-limits-losses-101795001932514.html) reported that oil prices fell 2% as US crude inventories rose 5.28 million barrels while US-Iran conflict limits losses.

On 17 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Slide-as-Global-Glut-Fears-Eclipse-Hormuz-Attacks.html) reported that crude oil prices extended a decline as reports about a global glut multiplied.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/oil-returns-surplus-gulf-exports-rebound-through-wartime-disruptions) reported that data from the International Energy Agency showed oil supplies overtook consumption by almost 2 million barrels per day in October as Gulf exports rebounded.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOcWtzQXhRVUlUbWQ0VVloOTVjekFCcC1XQlNXNWNRcERHNDFEbnBNTTFhZjV3Qjk5bGxCaDhoRFE1Yi1mdGNoR3JCVXY5MmQ0ODVnUWRabHowUDhYSUNKOXV5X0lLQzRBbWNabUFMTzVlMzBNOUUyWTgyeUg1cW5sRjJtUHo3TldPOEY4S19xOGwwYjlkemFibktTVTltVF94WUg5ekdJczcyUlBHOHZ0V3EtdWdjU0JOVkY4?oc=5), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/13/oil-market-to-return-to-surplus-for-first-time-since-start-of-iran-war-iea-says/) reported that the IEA stated the world oil market is returning to surplus as Gulf exports recover.
On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2217863) TASS reported that the IEA downgraded its outlook on global oil demand growth and projects a decline in 2026.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/european-diesel-prices-stay-high-as-global-oil-supply-overtakes-demand-iea-says) reported that the IEA stated European diesel prices remain 77 percent above pre-war levels while global oil supplies are expected to exceed demand in the fourth quarter.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/global-oil-supply-to-exceed-demand-in-q4-iea/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the International Energy Agency recorded a market surplus in October.

reports.text: On 19 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/biden-praised-netanyahus-courage-in-last-call-transcript-shows-3725767) reported that a published transcript of a January 15, 2025 call showed former US President Joe Biden telling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu he admired his courage.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/youre-a-good-man-i-admire-you-joe-bidens-last-call-with-netanyahu-as-us-president-contrasts-remarks-in-his-memoir-101794970047365.html) reported that Joe Biden's final telephone call as president with Benjamin Netanyahu contrasted with remarks in his forthcoming memoir.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90176) reported that former US President Joe Biden reveals in his upcoming memoir Promise Me, America that he refused a request from Donald Trump's transition team to authorize direct talks with Putin.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/biden-says-in-memoir-he-had-limited-trust-in-israels-netanyahu-3725605) reported that former U.S. President Joe Biden wrote in his memoir Promise Me, America that he had limited trust in Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/would-promise-then-kill-more-civilians-joe-biden-on-netanyahus-handling-of-war-in-gaza-in-new-memoir-israel-palestine-death-toll-101794739815345.html) reported that Joe Biden stated in his memoir 'Promise Me, America' that Benjamin Netanyahu ignored his pleas to limit civilian deaths in Gaza.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/biden-recounts-failed-pleas-to-netanyahu-to-spare-gaza-civilians-in-new-memoir/000001a1-d5f1-d59b-a1f3-ddf538180000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914840) reported that in excerpts from his memoir, former U.S. president Joe Biden accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of breaking promises and prioritizing political survival over Israel's long-term interests.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNck1uNjdmemxwdTVTTm1yS0pfMVY4bXdkZ0NMR3ZuN3c0Y0VaQ1EtSmV6WHFfLXI0SzQ5N1l6OXhkS1B0cXV1em1wOG9sYTBmaTZ6LVhvSjJpQ2xJQ1VPUHlWT3paZXJUU0pHQVhkNVRwVVhHOEhmZGpjTmJKbVdqUFBYWnpYamd2YzNQa3JsNlZScG8?oc=5), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/politics/joe-biden-new-memoir-takeaways.html) reported that Joe Biden's White House memoir is a defense of his four years in office and revisits his decision to run for re-election and the presidential debate.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/ukraine-trump-s-etonne-du-niveau-de-haine-entre-zelensky-et-poutine-mais-affirme-que-le-president-russe-veut-une-issue-diplomatique-a-la-guerre-20261120) reported that US President Donald Trump expressed astonishment at the level of hatred between Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin while stating the Russian president wants a diplomatic outcome to the war.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-les-europeens-iront-a-moscou-s-ils-ont-bien-desormais-toute-leur-place-dans-les-negociations-indique-l-elysee-20261120) reported that the Elysee stated European participation in negotiations regarding Ukraine is required if they go to Moscow, and providing Ukraine with Article 5-type protection amounts to bringing Kyiv into NATO.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-refuser-enverrait-un-signal-inapproprie-boris-pistorius-estime-que-l-invitation-de-vladimir-poutine-aux-europeens-est-acceptable-20261120) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius stated that Vladimir Putin's invitation to Europeans is acceptable and refusing it would send an inappropriate signal.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leaks-from-interior-ministry-to-far-right-national-rally), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/marine-le-pen-national-rally-party-alleged-interior-ministry-leaks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that France opened an investigation into suspicions that a senior civil servant at the interior ministry leaked confidential judicial information to the far-right National Rally party.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/guerre-en-ukraine-a-berlin-la-reunion-des-allies-de-kiev-miroir-inverse-de-la-rencontre-de-shenzhen-entre-xi-trump-et-poutine_6813557_3210.html) reported that allies of Kyiv met in Berlin to maintain support and honor promised aid for 2026.

stories.title: With focus on regional cooperation, Pakistan hosts ECO ministerial meeting today
stories.label: Pakistan to host ECO Council of Ministers meeting

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-excludes-afghanistan-from-eco-meeting-over-recognition-issue/) reported that Pakistan did not invite Afghanistan to the Economic Cooperation Organisation Council of Foreign Ministers meeting in Islamabad because of the recognition issue.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584474/pakistan-excludes-afghanistan-from-eco-ministerial-meeting/) reported that Pakistan did not invite Afghanistan to the Economic Cooperation Organisation ministerial meeting in Islamabad.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-receives-largest-ever-lpg-shipment-of-15000-metric-tons-at-port-qasim/) reported that Pakistan received its largest-ever liquefied petroleum gas shipment of 15,000 metric tons at Port Qasim.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640718/shehbaz-urges-collective-action-to-tackle-regional-security-threats) reported that Shehbaz Sharif urged collective action to tackle regional security threats and welcomed the adoption of the Islamabad Communique and Strategic Goals of Economic Cooperation 2026-2035.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323911/FM-Araghchi-arrives-in-Muscat-for-talks), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249468/Araghchi-in-Muscat-for-talks-with-Omani-officials) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Muscat to hold talks with senior Omani officials on bilateral relations and regional matters after visiting Pakistan.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOWi1LV2I4TlpUM3MtenlKS3JLaENWR1BIVE8zLV8xNWQ4Y1g3dHJRLXE3bXNYTTlGbXJDcnJzUWFRclNBRDg0VzgwMFZITHdRMVg4UnphaXYwRjVvRlF4cmRWSjI2aXZLVTR3bTAxcW43RUJWUDNpM3NndndOUUFWSW9Id29lRGlMcy1idEh6Y1lHUHlZRW9lS05UcjJ1YVVUSmRJbFA0aTItb1R2alVwaS1XZG1sYXV3YjdiVG1B?oc=5) reported that ECO ministers called for stronger regional connectivity and resilient supply chains.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQM1d4OTVKckVwdzIwekRpQ0YySVpsSnlzeEJ3TUU5d25zTHhvWjAwaWZtWFRpMEMycDRGTGNhSW5wb0lMZ3BJOVczZmJxTVM0UnlyUDNLWC1LTXNPS3BLUGowajUzRjdQdDVpOUw3N1BGYkZUZy1udzZTRGc0UjlYOU03enNBMDdHWGxqTG14ZmgyZENLTjZ2QWY4V3FOcWcyd2xsUjBOUi0yOFVUaU9tX3lmazB5a3c?oc=5) reported that Pakistan urged ECO nations to strengthen regional security and economic ties.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Shehbaz vowed stronger ECO trade and connectivity as Pakistan hosted the meeting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249439/30th-ECO-Summit-kicks-off-in-Islamabad), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322964/ECO-foreign-ministers-meeting-kicks-off-in-Islamabad-with-Iran-s) reported that the 30th meeting of foreign ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization began in Islamabad with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in attendance.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044898/at-eco-meeting-araghchi-calls-for-reliable-sustainable-regional-energy-mechanism) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called for a reliable and sustainable regional energy mechanism at the 30th meeting of the ECO.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581934/iranian-foreign-minister-abbas-araqchi-arrives-in-pakistan-for-eco-meeting/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi arrived in Pakistan to participate in the 30th Economic Cooperation Organization ministerial meeting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044898/eco-senior-officials-finalise-agenda-for-ministerial-meeting-in-islamabad) reported that senior officials of the Economic Cooperation Organisation finalized the agenda and draft Islamabad Communiqué ahead of the Council of Ministers meeting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/fm-dar-calls-for-stronger-regional-cooperation-as-pakistan-hosts-eco-ministerial-meeting/) reported that Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar called for stronger regional cooperation during the 30th ECO Council of Ministers meeting in Islamabad.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044691/islamabad-gears-up-for-eco-moot-as-turkish-azeri-kazakh-officials-arrive) reported that foreign dignitaries continued to arrive in Islamabad for the 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation Council of Ministers.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581816/eco-foreign-ministers-meet-in-islamabad-to-strengthen-regional-ties/) reported that the ECO foreign ministers' meeting opened in Islamabad on Sunday to discuss regional cooperation.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/foreign-delegates-arrive-in-islamabad-for-eco-ministerial-meeting/) reported that delegates from regional and friendly countries arrived in Islamabad for the 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640424/officials-from-azerbaijan-kazakhstan-turkiye-arrive-in-islamabad-for-30th-eco-ministerial-meeting) reported that officials from Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, and Turkiye arrived in Islamabad for the 30th ECO ministerial meeting chaired by Foreign Minister Dar.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640261/pakistan-to-host-30th-eco-council-of-foreign-ministers-meeting-on-nov-15-16), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044472/pakistan-to-host-30th-eco-council-of-ministers-meeting-on-nov-15-16) reported that Pakistan will host the 30th Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO) Council of Ministers meeting in Islamabad on November 15 and 16.

stories.title: Malaysia: Najib Razak House Arrest and Ministerial Resignation

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3374928/malaysias-pardons-board-minutes-expose-legal-rift-over-najibs-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's attorney general objected to former prime minister Najib Razak's house arrest on the grounds that it had no legal basis, though the king approved the arrangement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/najib-razak-house-arrest-declassified-minutes-attorney-general-hannah-yeoh-6561556) reported that Pardons Board minutes showed Malaysia's AG warned that Najib's house arrest could affect political stability and the country's image, and that Federal Territories Minister Hannah Yeoh also opposed the move.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/article/3374689/foreigners-lose-homes-thailand-malaysias-melaka-elections-7-asia-highlights) reported on seven selected stories from coverage of Asia over the past week, including foreigners losing homes in Thailand and Malaysia's Melaka elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-poll-results-analysis-malaysia-general-election-challenges-6552746) reported that a BN-PN alliance achieved a landslide victory in Melaka.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-election-2026-bn-landslide-anwar-ph-pn-6551571) reported that the Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional alliance won 24 seats in the Melaka polls.

On 15 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374453/malaysias-melaka-poll-shows-ethnic-lines-firming-can-anwar-turn-malay-nationalist-tide) reported that identity politics could decide the outcome of Malaysia's next national election.

On 14 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374416/malaysias-melaka-election-begins-anwars-ph-seeks-counter-resurgent-umno) reported that voters began casting ballots on Saturday morning to decide who will govern the southern Malaysian state of Melaka over the next five years.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-melaka-state-election-bn-pn-najib-razak-6545381) reported that former Prime Minister Najib Razak's conditional pardon sparked concerns over preferential treatment among some voters.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/former-malaysia-pm-najib-razak-house-arrest-sentence-6545056) reported that Najib Razak had submitted a written request for a second residence to be included in his house arrest arrangements, but this was not approved.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/malaysias-ex-pm-transferred-to-house-arrest-for-1mdb-graft-sentence?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak was transferred from prison to his Kuala Lumpur home for house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/former-malaysian-leader-najib-razak-returns-home-under-royal-pardon-but-faces-a-separate-15-year-prison-sentence/a-79913437?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Najib Razak returned home under a royal pardon but still faces a separate 15-year prison sentence.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-najib-razak-house-arrest-anwar-ibrahim-umno-6542426) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's anti-corruption agenda has taken a perceived hit despite him not having the final say in former premier Najib Razak's house arrest.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374042/taiwan-pauses-malaysia-investment-talks-after-anwar-remarks-spark-fury-taipei) reported that Malaysia is seeking to reassure Taiwanese investors that it remains a reliable destination for hi-tech manufacturing after Taipei suspended bilateral investment talks.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/malaysian-court-clears-former-pm-najib-razak-for-house-arrest-transfer?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Malaysian court cleared former PM Najib Razak for a house arrest transfer.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxORXB4UWVtZXBzZXM1eGhQa0tGX21hamxBcVpnR2lfMUUxV1dyc0RvdXZGQk9KSGxNQ2ZrNjJZSmJrcjNJSjVlZXRkZkVSUjk0NERGWTZSN3RzWFNYWENwdERHZDlQS1lRaF9PaG0tRmNfMW5yeGYyYzI3ZEx0d3Mxb25jeWlMQXF5SzNkdDNLZEl4N05JdmlGVjNBSWxLUms5OWNkYkUyUkNXVEl3cm9iOV84eG0wQlVodHhabkVLR0s0TFdsTTRMeFJR?oc=5) reported that a Malaysia court cleared the way for ex-PM Najib to start house arrest, according to Bernama.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/malaysian-court-clears-final-hurdle-for-former-pm-najib-razaks-transfer-to-house-arrest/article71686082.ece) reported that a Malaysian court cleared the final hurdle for former Prime Minister Najib Razak's transfer to house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-transport-minister-anthony-loke-resignation-take-effect-immediately-najib-house-arrest-6538901) reported that Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke's resignation takes effect immediately after the court granted Najib house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3373950/malaysia-court-clears-najib-begin-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's former prime minister Najib Razak arrived home after the High Court cleared the way for him to serve the remainder of his prison term under house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-ex-pm-najib-razak-released-prison-house-arrest-royal-pardon-6538231) reported that Najib Razak arrived home in Kuala Lumpur to serve the remainder of his jail term under house arrest after being released from Kajang Prison.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/turkiye-ready-to-share-defense-ecosystem-production-capacity-with-nato-3725703) reported that Haluk Gorgun, head of the Turkish Defense Industries Secretariat, stated Türkiye wants to share its defense ecosystem and production capacity at the NATO Edge 26 conference.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/turkish-air-force-chief-all-praise-for-pafs-battle-tested-capabilities-in-meeting-with-cas-sidhu/) reported that the Turkish Air Force Chief praised the Pakistan Air Force's combat experience, operational excellence, and growing indigenous aerospace capabilities.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/turkish-air-chief-discusses-expanded-military-ties-with-pakistan-in-meeting-with-field-marshal/) reported that the Turkish Air Force leadership and Pakistani officials discussed expanded military ties.

On 17 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324310/Pakistan-Tehran-Islamabad-stress-promoting-regional-peace-and), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-iran-stress-sustained-engagement-coordination-for-regional-stability/article71711296.ece) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir emphasized promoting regional peace and stability during a meeting in Rawalpindi.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/iran-fm-calls-on-field-marshal-asim-munir-lauds-pakistans-role-in-promoting-regional-peace/) reported that an Iranian delegation led by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called on Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxOMUNCUmdzUkJPNDFRNGNFOE9KUmJBMWlyTDBXc3RSOXNKdUN6R2Q5dmMwTm43YmdLZEdqZlZDZ3ZRT0hjMzdaQmF1TUhQbi16TThVYktOc2lxN0VsMlpYWE9ISF9ybmtYX0V5LWR4dzBWRXdXekRnWmJhekFHRjJUNTdvTmw2blJCNU1DNmIwNEtBa3VweGtrRFhkZGNuTmRyRU9Nb0tBMF8yamtXWkZlcjRyQzNneTNCU2xYeE1kc3Q?oc=5) reported that Pakistan and Uzbekistan moved to deepen defense ties and expand joint military exercises.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640304/pakistan-uzbekistan-reaffirm-commitment-to-expanding-defence-cooperation-during-air-chiefs-visit) reported that Lieutenant General Bahromovich lauded the professionalism, operational prowess, and combat capabilities of the Pakistan Air Force.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581458/pakistan-uzbekistan-discuss-stronger-military-cooperation/) reported that Pakistan and Uzbekistan agreed to strengthen defense cooperation through greater military engagement and technology sharing.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/defense/turkiye-ready-to-deepen-defense-co-op-with-saudi-arabia-official) reported that Türkiye is ready to broaden its defense industry cooperation with Saudi Arabia.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/turkiye-saudi-arabia-ready-to-deepen-defense-ties-expand-joint-production-3725492), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261112-turkiye-saudi-arabia-ready-to-deepen-defense-ties-expand-joint-production/) reported that the cooperation is backed by over 1,400 projects and a $120 billion portfolio.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/field-marshal-asim-munir-vows-maximum-security-to-global-investors-as-pakistan-eyes-mining-boom/) reported that Field Marshal Asim Munir pledged maximum security to global investors as Pakistan moves to unlock mineral wealth.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580980/field-marshal-urges-pakistan-to-unlock-mineral-wealth/) reported that Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir called for turning mineral wealth into economic opportunities as a shared national goal.

stories.label: Poland: FSB Arrests Alleged Polish Spies

reports.text: On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648919-moscow-car-bombing-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a woman suspected of acting on orders from Kyiv's intelligence services was detained over the car bombing of an ex-Ukrainian prime minister's aide.

On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/society/2218515), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Ukrainian agent was detained in Crimea while retrieving a package from a cache in Simferopol and confessed to passing data on air defenses and combat ships.
