stories.title: Peru earthquake

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/entregan-primer-balance-de-danos-tras-el-sismo-de-6-7-de-magnitud-en-peru-reportan-15-heridos-cuatro-casas-inhabitables-y-otras-127-afectadas-3603011) reported that an initial damage balance following the 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru noted 15 injuries, 4 uninhabitable houses, and 127 affected homes.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/sismo-de-magnitud-67-en-peru-deja-un-saldo-de-15-heridos) reported that the Geophysical Institute of Peru stated two other earthquakes occurred in Junín.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-al-menos-15-heridos-tras-sismo-de-67-en-peru-hay-decenas-de-viviendas-y-edificios-afectados/) reported that at least 15 injuries were reported following a 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru, with dozens of homes and buildings affected.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/menos-mujer-herida-39-viviendas-afectadas-sismo-magnitud-6-7-peru_1795260503) reported that at least one woman was injured and 39 homes were affected by a 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru, with some collapses in Lima's Independencia district and the Costa Verde.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/reportan-nuevo-temblor-de-magnitud-5-0-en-peru-este-sabado-21-de-noviembre-horas-despues-del-fuerte-sismo-de-6-9-profundidad-epicentro-y-detalles-3602958) reported that the Colombian Geological Service published a bulletin on a 5.0 magnitude earthquake registered in Peru.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/videos-del-fuerte-temblor-de-6-9-en-peru-la-noche-de-este-20-de-noviembre-que-se-sintio-en-bogota-y-varias-ciudades-de-colombia-asi-se-vivio-el-sismo-3602909) reported that Colombia's Ungrd discarded a tsunami threat after the strong movement.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/sismo-de-6-7-de-magnitud-sacude-a-peru-sin-danos-por-el-momento-33237290), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/sismo-de-magnitud-67-con-epicentro-en-junin-sacudio-peru-este-viernes), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/sismo-6-7-sacude-centro-peru-siente-lima-danos-momento_1795221277) reported that a 6.7 magnitude earthquake struck Peru with an epicenter 30 kilometers northwest of Junin and a depth of 127 kilometers, with no immediate damages reported.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/se-registra-sismo-de-69-en-los-andes-peru-no-se-reportan-danos-o-victimas-al-momento/) reported that a 6.9 magnitude earthquake was registered in the Andes with no immediate casualties.

stories.title: At SCO moot in India, Musadik Malik declares climate change ‘enemy’ of civilisations
stories.label: Pakistan official to attend SCO meeting in India

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641524/malik-warns-of-climate-threat-to-civilisation-heritage-at-sco-forum-in-new-delhi) reported that Musadik Malik warned of climate threats at the SCO forum in New Delhi and met Tajik and Iranian officials.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-calls-for-dialogue-to-resolve-issues-during-india-visit/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584860/musadik-malik-urges-evidence-based-solutions-in-delhi/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr Musadik Malik called for resolving regional issues through evidence-based solutions rather than mutual accusations during his visit to India.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/no-cultural-diplomacy-in-india-as-pakistani-minister-malik-blocked-from-visiting-historic-sites/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Musadik Malik was blocked from visiting historic sites in New Delhi.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-to-promote-shared-heritage-through-sco-civilisational-dialogue/) reported that Pakistan's participation in the SCO Civilizational Dialogue in New Delhi offers an opportunity to promote shared heritage.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584347/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-for-sco-dialogue/) reported that Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-pakistani-minister-visits-delhi-for-sco-forum-amid-frozen-ties/live-79999264?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/776aabd4c635) reported that Pakistan Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first high-level visit since 2023.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641334/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-lead-pakistan-delegation-at-sco-forum), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045878/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-attend-sco-dialogue-forum), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-to-lead-pakistans-delegation-at-sco-forum/) reported that Pakistan's Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi to lead a delegation at the SCO forum.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584154/musadik-to-lead-delelgation-for-sco-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead the Pakistan delegation to the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation forum in India.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583771/pakistani-delegation-led-by-musadik-malik-to-attend-sco-civilizations-dialogue-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead a Pakistani delegation to India for the SCO Civilizations Dialogue Forum.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641093/musadik-malik-set-for-delhi-visit) reported that Musadik Malik's visit to Delhi will be the first by a Pakistani federal minister to India since May 2023.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-confirms-first-federal-ministerial-visit-to-india-in-over-three-years-for-sco-moot/) reported that Federal Minister Dr. Musadik Malik will visit New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first ministerial visit in over three years.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640294/musadik-malik-to-represent-pakistan-at-new-delhi-sco-dialogue-fo), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044492/fo-says-climate-minister-musadik-malik-nominated-to-represent-pakistan-at-sco-moot-in-new-delhi) reported that Pakistan's Foreign Office announced that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik has been nominated to represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation dialogue in New Delhi.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581453/pakistan-to-attend-sco-meeting-in-india/) reported that Pakistan has decided to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting in New Delhi.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-climate-minister-sco-summit-india-visit-new-delhi/article71701699.ece) reported that the upcoming visit marks the first high-level visit by a Pakistani minister to India in three years.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-fountain-of-life-trustees-over-church-dispute/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-odukoya-drags-sister-others-to-court-over-removal-as-senior-pastor/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya instituted a court action against his sister and Fountain of Life Church trustees over his removal as senior pastor.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742636-breaking-jimmy-odukoya-drags-sister-pastors-court-1-demand/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya dragged his sister and pastors to court making one demand.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-pastors-asks-court-to-declare-removal-illegal/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya approached the Federal High Court in Lagos to challenge his removal from office and ask the court to declare his removal illegal.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/fountain-of-life-church-denies-being-sealed-announces-sunday-service/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-denies-closure-amid-leadership-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-debunks-closure-rumours-asks-worshippers-to-attend-sunday-service/) reported that The Fountain of Life Church dismissed reports that its premises had been sealed and invited members to attend Sunday service.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-dismisses-closure-claims-announces-sunday-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that The Fountain of Life Church stated it is not sealed and invited worshippers to a Sunday service.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-sealed-by-police-as-leadership-crisis-deepens/) reported that police officers sealed The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, as the leadership crisis deepened.

On 20 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/fountain-of-life-succession-crisis-court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-as-leadership-dispute-deepens/) reported that the Lagos State High Court restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head of the Fountain of Life Church.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-postpones-thanksgiving-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Fountain of Life Church postponed its 2026 Thanksgiving service amid a leadership dispute without providing a new date.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/keeping-my-fathers-succession-video-was-a-mistake-jimmy-odukoya/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/i-disobeyed-fathers-order-to-delete-succession-video-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya admitted that keeping his late father's succession video was a mistake and that he disobeyed his father's order.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jimmy-odukoya-inside-the-fountain-of-life-leadership-crisis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that two groups within The Fountain of Life Church are making competing claims over the leadership of the Lagos-based ministry following an announcement.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-board-accuses-jimmy-odukoya-of-hijacking-churchs-social-media-accounts/) reported that the Board of Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church accused Pastor Jimmy Odukoya of hijacking the church's social media accounts.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/fountain-of-life-church-in-fresh-dispute-over-jimmy-odukoyas-removal/) reported that a statement was posted on the Fountain of Life Church's platform hours after the announcement regarding Pastor Jimmy Odukoya's removal as Senior Pastor.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/jimmy-odukoya-removed-as-senior-pastor-of-fountain-of-life-church/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/just-in-fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741750-breaking-fountain-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-senior-pastor/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/fountain-of-life-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Board of Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church in Lagos removed Pastor Jimmy Odukoya as its senior pastor, citing the late founder Taiwo Odukoya's recorded instructions and succession arrangements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cmqlq5xn3yl5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Punch](https://punchng.com/jimmy-odukoyas-removal-invalid-says-fountain-of-life-church/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-rejects-jimmy-odukoyas-removal/) reported that the Fountain of Life Church rejected reports alleging that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya had been removed as its senior pastor, describing the decision as invalid.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-count-us-out-of-opposition-summit-says-pdp/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party disassociated itself from the Summit of Opposition political parties under the Coalition for Democracy.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-were-not-joining-your-opposition-coalition-pdp-tells-lukman/) reported that the PDP stated it is not joining the opposition coalition.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/wike-led-pdp-disowns-november-30-coalition-summit/) reported that the Wike-led PDP distanced itself from the November 30 coalition summit.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926715-2027-sule-lamido-rejects-rainbow-coalition-says-pdp-will-win-jigawa-in-presidential-poll.html) reported that former Jigawa State Governor Sule Lamido stated President Bola Tinubu and APC governors have failed across Nigeria.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-pdp-apc-clash-over-dancing-at-campaign-rallies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jigawa PDP chairman Babandi Gumel stated APC leaders' dancing at campaign rallies is insensitive to hardship, while the APC stated it reflects joy and public acceptance.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926451-2027-sule-lamido-berates-vice-president-shettima-as-jigawa-pdp-begins-campaign.html) reported that Sule Lamido criticized Vice President Shettima as the Jigawa PDP began its campaign.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-yayi-realised-his-looming-defeat-the-day-adebutu-returned-to-the-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-yayi-jittery-over-adebutus-return-to-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu claimed that Ogun APC members joined the PDP and stated opponents are jittery over Adebutu's return.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ogun-2027-pdp-presents-governorship-flag-to-adebutu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu presented the party's governorship flag to Ladi Adebutu at Ake Palace.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/abia-pdp-guber-candidate-anosike-promises-to-tackle-water-borne-diseases/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate in Abia State, Dr. Kelechi Anosike, promised to build 552 solar-powered boreholes to tackle water-borne diseases.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-ekiti-deputy-gov-mobilises-traditional-rulers-politicians-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that Ekiti State Deputy Governor Monisade Afuye rallied traditional rulers across the state to support President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s re-election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ekiti-deputy-gov-mobilises-monarchs-pdp-members-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ekiti State Deputy Governor Monisade Afuye intensified mobilization efforts seeking support from traditional rulers and PDP members for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-pdp-may-not-win-single-ward-ogun-apc/) reported that the Ogun State chapter of the All Progressives Congress dismissed claims by the Peoples Democratic Party that it would win every ward.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-pdp-apc-clash-over-adebutus-chances/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party and the All Progressives Congress in Ogun State exchanged words over the 2027 gubernatorial chances.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ekiti-pdp-seeks-probe-of-attack-on-ex-dep-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party in Ekiti State called on police and security agencies to investigate an alleged attack on its 2026 deputy governorship candidate.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-needs-a-listening-leader-says-pdp-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Jigawa, Mustapha Sule Lamido, stated the state needs a listening leader rather than a furious one ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adebutu-ogun-apc-guber-aspirant-hails-court-judgment/) reported that Ogun State All Progressives Congress governorship aspirant Abayomi Hunye congratulated the Peoples Democratic Party's governorship candidate following a court judgment.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/gov-oyebanji-rallies-apc-candidates-promises-campaign-support-assures-members-of-political-inclusion/) reported that Ekiti State Governor Biodun Oyebanji reaffirmed his commitment to strengthening the APC and promised full logistical support for upcoming elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-katsina-gov-promises-more-development-seeks-apc-victory/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda urged residents to support the APC in the 2027 elections and promised more development projects.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-hunye-hails-court-judgment-says-its-victory-for-democracy/) reported that Hunye described a court judgment regarding Adebutu as a victory for democracy and justice for Ogun State.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/pdp-celebrates-as-adebutu-floors-inec/) reported that a court ordered the Independent National Electoral Commission to publish Oladipupo Adebutu as the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-katsina-pdp-gov-candidate-promises-free-medical-treatment-for-residents/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Katsina, Yakubu Lado Danmarke, promised to introduce free healthcare services for residents if elected in 2027.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130470.html) reported that following a boost to Ladi Adebutu's candidacy, the Peoples Democratic Party vowed to reclaim Ogun State in the 2027 gubernatorial election.

On 14 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutu-as-pdp-candidate-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-disqualify-him/) reported that Justice Peter Lifu of the Federal High Court ordered INEC to publish Adebutu as the PDP candidate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-im-voting-pdp-at-all-levels-sule-lamido-declares/) reported that former Jigawa State Governor Sule Lamido declared his commitment to the Peoples Democratic Party and stated he will vote for the party's candidate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ogun-guber-pdp-celebrates-court-judgment-reinstating-adebutu/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/pdp-seeks-inec-compliance-as-court-reinstates-adebutu-as-ogun-governorship-candidate/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925024-2027-pdp-reacts-to-court-ruling-reinstating-adebutu-as-ogun-gov-candidate-urges-inec-to-comply.html) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party welcomed the Federal High Court judgment reinstating Adebutu as its Ogun governorship candidate and urged INEC to comply.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-chairman-amupitan-denies-operating-pro-tinubu-x-account/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan denied operating an X account allegedly used to express support for Tinubu.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/inec-to-obey-court-on-atikus-adc-candidacy-amupitan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-will-obey-court-ruling-on-atikus-candidacy-amupitan/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan stated the commission will abide by the final court decision on Atiku Abubakar's presidential candidacy under the ADC.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741071-will-atiku-participate-2027-election-inec-chairman-speaks-out/) reported that Amupitan explained what happens to Atiku's 2027 bid if he loses his court battle.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-unilaterally-remove-candidates/) The Sun reported that the Federal High Court ruled that INEC has no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate and ordered it to publish Adebutu's name.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-pdp-celebrates-adebutu-ruling-vows-to-reclaim-state/) reported that the PDP in Ogun State celebrated the Adebutu ruling and vowed to reclaim the state.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/driver-absconds-with-employers-n45m-suv-caught-within-hours-in-ogun/) reported that a driver who allegedly absconded with his employer's Lexus 460 SUV in Ogun was caught within hours.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-orders-inec-to-reinstate-adebutu-as-ogun-pdp-guber-candidate-within-24-hours/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to publish Oladipupo Adebutu's name as the PDP governorship candidate within 24 hours.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name/) reported that the Federal High Court ruled that INEC had no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate from contesting.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/money-cant-buy-peoples-conscience-says-sowunmi-kolapo/) reported that Ogun State PDP deputy governorship candidate Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo stated money cannot buy people's conscience.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-knows-fate-today-as-court-gives-judgment-on-his-exclusion-from-inec-list/) reported that the Federal High Court fixed Friday to deliver judgment in the suit filed by the PDP.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/imo-east-senatorial-candidacy-court-orders-ndc-to-submit-uche-nwoles-name-to-inec/) reported that Justice Mohammed Umar of the Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the Nigeria Democratic Congress to submit Uche Nwole's name to INEC for the Imo East senatorial candidacy.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-money-cant-buy-ogun-voters-says-pdp-deputy-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP deputy governorship candidate Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo stated money politics will not suppress voter will in the 2027 election.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/just-in-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name-as-ogun-pdp-gov-candidate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-court-orders-inec-to-reinstate-adebutu-as-ogun-pdp-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to reinstate Ladi Adebutu as the PDP governorship candidate for Ogun State within 24 hours.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nema-recovers-24-bodies-from-bayelsa-boat-mishap/) reported that the National Emergency Management Agency recovered 24 bodies from the Bayelsa boat mishap.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-shettima-soludo-lead-tinubus-2027-campaign-rally-in-anambra/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Vice-President Kashim Shettima and Governor Chukwuma Soludo led the APC-APGA SoluTinubu 2027 campaign rally for Tinubu's re-election at Alex Ekwueme Square in Awka.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/police-tighten-security-ahead-of-tinubu-rally-obis-anambra-visit/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Anambra State Police Command intensified security operations across the state ahead of a campaign rally for President Bola Tinubu and Peter Obi's visit.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222869) reported that Russian forces struck a gathering of Ukrainian army commanders and representatives of the military-industrial complex.

On 21 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222871) reported that Russia's top brass stated Kiev lost 1,185 troops along the engagement line in the past day, including roughly 260 troops in the responsibility area of Battlegroup North.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187055-air-defense-neutralizes-117-of-148-russian-drones-launched-against-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that air defense forces neutralized 117 of 148 drones launched by Russian forces overnight.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186648-russia-loses-another-2150-troops-in-war-against-ukraine.html) reported that Russia's total combat losses from February 24, 2022, to November 20, 2026, reached approximately 1,633,130 personnel, including 2,150 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063370/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185843-russia-loses-1970-troops-over-past-day-in-war-against-ukraine.html) reported that Ukraine's General Staff updated Russian combat losses by 1,970 soldiers over the past day.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062912/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated Russia lost 2,230 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

On 11 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/uk-authorities-arrests-us-soldier-suspected-of-spying-for-russia) reported that UK authorities arrested a US soldier suspected of spying for Russia.

On 10 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/british-counterterrorism-police-arrest-us-soldier-accused-of-spying-on-behalf-of-russia/a-79913240?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that British counterterrorism police arrested a US soldier near Gloucester in England who was suspected of espionage activity in connection with Russia.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/us/1740733-us-restricts-entries-travellers-1-african-country-reason/) reported that the United States announced a restriction and warning for travellers from a major African country.

stories.label: Bangladesh: Sheikh Hasina Extradition and Return Pledge

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/bangladesh-minister-vows-action-against-those-behind-arson-blames-awami-league-linked-groups-reports-101795247826142.html) reported that a Bangladesh minister vowed action against those behind arson and blamed Awami League-linked groups.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-minister-vows-action-against-those-behind-arson-blames-awami-league-linked-groups-says-reports/article71727826.ece) reported that Humaiun Kobir stated law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-hit-by-fresh-arson-attacks-in-political-unrest/article71725621.ece) reported that police stated 124 people linked to the Awami League had been arrested in Dhaka over the previous 24 hours.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/3-killed-as-violence-grips-bangladesh-amid-hasinas-return-buzz-120-linked-to-her-party-arrested-101795182684277.html) reported that three people were killed in violence as hundreds of paramilitary troops were deployed amid unrest and over 120 people linked to Hasina's party were arrested.

On 19 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-bangladesh-hasina-supporters-vandalise-ruling-party-office) reported that hundreds of supporters of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina staged street protests and engaged in arson attacks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3375123/violence-rises-bangladesh-ex-pm-hasinas-supporters-escalate-protests) reported that fresh violence erupted in Bangladesh as supporters of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina tried to bring businesses and public transport to a halt.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/19/bangladesh-violent-protest-sheikh-hasina-planned-return) reported that the Awami League party called for nationwide protests and parts of Bangladesh were shut down following the government's rejection of Hasina's passport request.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/bangladesh-tightens-security-amid-tensions-over-sheikh-hasinas-possible-return/) reported that Bangladesh stepped up security measures amid tensions surrounding former prime minister Sheikh Hasina's possible return.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/muhammad-yunus-ancestral-home-set-on-fire-chattogram-bangladesh-lockdown-call-awami-league-sheikh-hasina-return-101795067374137.html) reported that the ancestral home of former interim government chief Muhammad Yunus was set on fire in Bangladesh amid protests.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045579/paramilitary-units-deployed-in-bangladesh-amid-hasina-unrest) reported that Bangladesh stepped up security, deployed paramilitary units, and reported a petrol bomb killing an activist in the former prime minister's hometown alongside arson attacks targeting Grameen Bank branches.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583366/hasinas-planned-return-sparks-violence-across-bangladesh/) reported that Bangladesh deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops as violence and tensions spread over the planned return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-deploys-paramilitary-as-unrest-grows-overhasinas-return/article71717353.ece) reported that police recorded dozens of crude bomb blasts and torched vehicles across at least 28 districts over 10 days.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/police-in-bangladesh-clash-with-garment-workers-demanding-higher-minimum-wages) reported that police in Bangladesh clashed with garment workers demanding a minimum monthly wage increase to 30,000 takas.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/india-cannot-dictate-terms-on-hasinas-return-to-bangladesh-pms-adviser/article71712874.ece) reported that an adviser to the Prime Minister of Bangladesh stated that India cannot dictate terms regarding Sheikh Hasina's return.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-with-police-in-fresh-protests-over-wages?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladeshi police clashed with garment workers who hurled bricks, torched vehicles, and blocked the highway between Dhaka and Mymensingh.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/fresh-protests-erupt-in-bangladesh-amid-garment-workers-wage-strike-tensions-over-sheikh-hasinas-possible-return-101794908401544.html) reported that workers demanded a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka, representing a 140 per cent increase over their current wage of 12,500 taka.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3374768/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-police-fresh-wage-protest) reported that police fired tear gas and stun grenades during clashes with thousands of garment workers protesting after a key wage board meeting.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fresh-unrest-in-bangladesh-as-garment-workers-protest-block-highway-for-higher-wages-101794900759373.html), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045168/bangladesh-garment-workers-police-clash-in-fresh-wage-protest) reported that Bangladeshi police used tear gas and stun grenades against garment workers protesting on highways for higher wages.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bangladesh-dismisses-reports-of-india-setting-conditions-for-sheikh-hasinas-return-she-ll-return-under-extradition-treaty-101794840686924.html) reported that Bangladesh minister Shama Obaed Islam stated Bangladesh will consider any formal conditions India may put forward regarding Hasina's return.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/ex-bangladesh-pm-hasina-return-home-despite-death-threat-6554771) reported that former Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina stated no threat of death will keep her away from her country as she plans a December return.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/ex-primeira-ministra-de-bangladesh-sheikh-hasina-diz-que-pretende-voltar-ao-pais-em-dezembro-apesar-de-condenacao-a-morte.ghtml) reported that 79-year-old former prime minister Sheikh Hasina stated she intends to return to Bangladesh in December despite her death sentence.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/sheikh-hasina-to-return-through-legal-means-what-india-does-is-up-to-them-bangladesh-minister-101794715954956.html) reported that a Bangladesh minister stated Sheikh Hasina will return through legal means and that Dhaka has completed its part of the legal process.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/sheikh-hasinas-return-to-bangladesh-india-wants-dhaka-to-fulfil-two-conditions-says-report/articleshow/135824475.cms) reported that India is seeking Sheikh Hasina's return to Bangladesh after more than two years in exile and has set two conditions for Tarique Rahman’s government.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uk-parliamentarians-appeal-to-foreign-secretary-for-sheikh-hasina-death-penalty-safeguards-101794387141548.html) reported that UK parliamentarians appealed to the Foreign Secretary for safeguards regarding Sheikh Hasina and the death penalty.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/10/bangladesh-prosecutor-warns-hasina-faces-execution-if-she-returns?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal said ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/10/disgraced-former-leader-sheikh-hasina-plans-return-to-bangladesh-after-two-years-in-exile) reported that disgraced former leader Sheikh Hasina plans a return to Bangladesh from exile and is confident she will return despite facing the death penalty.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043510/bangladesh-prosecutor-says-ex-pm-sheikh-hasina-will-be-executed-if-she-returns) reported that a Bangladeshi prosecutor said ousted leader Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladeshs-ousted-leader-sheikh-hasina-appeals-for-a-new-passport-to-return-from-exile/article71681436.ece) reported that Dhaka wants Sheikh Hasina extradited under a prisoner exchange, while Minister Humayun Kabir called her a terrorist and dismissed her request for a fresh passport.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203950/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AF%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B4%D8%A3%D8%A9-%D8%B5%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%AB%D8%B1-%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A/) reported that Bahrain's Ministry of Interior stated an Iranian attack targeted a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190666/%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B6%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%87%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%B2-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B0%D9%88%D9%81) reported that a fire broke out aboard an oil tanker crossing the Strait of Hormuz near Omani coasts after it was hit by an unknown projectile.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7188389) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated the memorandum of understanding with the American side is no longer on the table.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7184202), [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461480/) reported that an explosion sound was heard on Iran's Qeshm Island with the cause remaining unclear.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4412977) reported that Iranian state agency Fars stated an explosion was heard on Qeshm Island with the cause unclear.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461338/) reported that armed clashes broke out between the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and members of the opposition Kurdistan Free Life Party near the Iraq-Iran border.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7183762) reported that the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced an attack on an American radar station inside a military base in Bahrain in response to an alleged violation of airspace by American drones.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461315/) reported that the Iranian Navy announced that an oil tanker stopped navigating and caught fire after hitting mines east of the Strait of Hormuz.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203247/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AA%D8%A3%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A/) reported that the High Criminal Court in Bahrain convicted all detained and fugitive defendants in a case involving the establishment and management of a terrorist group linked to the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/france-to-present-evidence-of-alleged-iranian-cyberattack-on-supermarkets-seek-eu-sanctions-101794823204278.html) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot stated France would share details of an alleged Iranian cyberattack on supermarkets with European counterparts and seek EU sanctions.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7182230) reported that flames engulfed an oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz, according to an announcement by the Public Relations Department of the Navy of the Army.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190234/%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A86-%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA), a local outlet, reported that the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced the targeting of a U.S. air defense radar system at the Riffa helicopter base in Bahrain using 6 drones.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7180958) reported that the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps warned France about an alleged Israeli trap following accusations of cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigeration control systems.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190211/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B7-%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B2-mq-1), a local outlet, reported that the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced the downing of a U.S. MQ-1 drone in the airspace of Qشم island.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4409289) Al-Masry Al-Youm reported that Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Commander-in-Chief Major General Ahmad Vahidi stated that Iran will respond to the slightest aggression with devastating strikes.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/460976/) reported that the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps naval forces announced that a gas tanker was hit by an explosion and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190123/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B0%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%A8%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced the targeting and destruction of a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to an air raid on a communications tower in southern Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/belgian-ministers-odds-over-irans-alleged-role-refrigerator-cyberattacks) reported that Belgian Interior Minister Bernard Quintin said Iran was very likely behind recent refrigerator cyberattacks on European shops.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cyberattaque-contre-des-frigos-de-supermarches-l-iran-rejette-les-accusations-infondees-de-la-france-20261110) (state-media) reported that Tehran rejected unfounded accusations from France attributing an October cyberattack to an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps cyber unit.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/iran-denies-role-in-cyberattacks-on-supermarket-refrigerators/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Iran denied any role in cyberattacks on French supermarket refrigerators.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/varlden/frankrike-hotar-med-vedergallning-mot-iran-efter-cyberattacker-utesluter-ingenting/) reported that France threatened retaliation against Iran and called for tougher EU sanctions against the regime in Tehran.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%81%d8%b1%d9%86%d8%b3%d8%a7-%d8%aa%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%af%d8%b9%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%81%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%8a-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%ae%d9%84%d9%81%d9%8a) reported that France summoned the Iranian ambassador over cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems in hundreds of stores and warned of a response.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/france-blames-iran-for-unprecedented-supermarket-fridge-cyberattack/) reported that France blamed Iran for the supermarket refrigerator cyberattack that spoiled produce at around 700 retailers and vowed sanctions.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/france-rules-out-nothing-in-response-to-irgc-supermarket-cyberattack-3725390) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot stated Paris rules out nothing in response to the cyberattack.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/abascal-revuelve-apelar-voto-util-exige-respeto-vox_202611216b019868f6da642efef75848.html) reported that Vox leader Santiago Abascal criticized the People's Party over tactical voting and demanded respect for Vox.

stories.title: Bosnia Constitutional Court insignia ruling

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/kovacevic-o-odluci-ustavnog-suda-bi-h-ovo-je-napad-na-prava-srba/) reported that SNSD delegate Kovačević commented on a Constitutional Court decision concerning Bosnia and Herzegovina.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/nedim-ademovic-u-rs-u-su-odluke-ustavnog-suda-bih-samo-izgovor-za-blokadu-drzavnog-sistema/261121066) reported that constitutional law expert Nedim Ademovic considers that decisions of the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina are used only as an excuse for blockades of the state system in Republika Srpska.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/opozicija-u-rs-u-nazvala-odluku-ustavnog-suda-bih-provokacijom-traze-odlazak-stranih-sudija/261121004) reported that political leaders Draško Stanivuković and Ognjen Bodiroga described the Constitutional Court's decision as unacceptable.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/becirovic-entitetski-zakoni-ne-mogu-osporavati-upotrebu-obiljezja-armije-r-bi-h/) reported that BiH Presidency member Denis Bećirović stated that entity laws cannot challenge the use of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina insignia.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-zadovoljna-odlukom-ustavnog-suda-pod-ljiljanima-je-branjena-nasa-drzava/) reported that the SDA expressed satisfaction with the Constitutional Court's decision.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/hoce-li-komisija-za-ocuvanje-nacionalnih-spomenika-postati-prvi-test-za-buduce-odnose-u-predsjednistvu-bih/261120290) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina left the appointment of four members of the Commission to Preserve National Monuments in force.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/stanivukovic-tvrdi-da-odluka-o-zastavi-armije-r-bi-h-ponovo-otvara-ratne-rane/), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089646/odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-izazvala-reakciju-stanivukovica-ponovo-otvaraju-rane) reported that Stanivuković stated that the decision of the Constitutional Court of BiH regarding the Army of RBiH flag reopens war wounds and is unacceptable.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/snsd-krece-s-ucjenama-najavljena-potpuna-blokada-vijeca-ministara-zbog-odluke-ustavnog-suda-o-zastavama-armije-bih/261120261) reported that SNSD President Milorad Dodik stated no member of the BiH Council of Ministers from that party will make any decision until the Constitutional Court's decision is withdrawn.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089634/sda-pozdravila-odluku-ustavnog-suda-ljiljani-i-simboli-armije-rbih-predstavljaju-dio-historijskog-i-drzavnog-naslijedja-bih), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-potvrdila-da-ljiljani-i-simboli-armije-rbih-ne-mogu-biti-zabranjeni/261120312) reported that SDA welcomed the Constitutional Court's decision, stating that the lilies and symbols of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina represent part of the historical and state heritage of BiH.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089638/dodik-se-oglasio-i-na-drustvenim-mrezama-nakon-odluke-ustavnog-suda-danas-je-umrla-bosna-i-hercegovina) reported that Dodik posted on social media that Bosnia and Herzegovina died today.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ustavni-sud-srusio-veto-cvijanovic-komisija-za-zastitu-nacionalnih-spomenika-imenovana-u-skladu-sa-zakonom/261120219) reported that the Constitutional Court of BiH set aside Željka Cvijanović's statement on the vital interest of Republika Srpska and the National Assembly decision confirming it.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/zestoka-reakcija-iz-rs-nikada-ovdje-nece-postaviti-zastavu-armije-r-bi-h/) reported a fierce reaction from Republika Srpska regarding the Constitutional Court decision.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/dodik-da-dode-100-ustavnih-sudova-nece-postaviti-nijednu-zastavu-armije-rbih-u-rs-neka-probaju/261120242) reported that SNSD President Milorad Dodik reacted to the Constitutional Court of BiH ruling by stating that no flag of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina would be placed in Republika Srpska.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-zabrana-simbola-armije-rbih-je-neustavna/261120215), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089543/ustavni-sud-bih-ukinuo-zabranu-simbola-armije-rbih-u-rs-oboren-veto-zeljke-cvijanovic) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina ruled that the provision of the Republika Srpska Criminal Code punishing the display of Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina symbols is unconstitutional.

stories.title: Ukraine frontline combat engagements

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187253-war-update-116-clashes-on-front-line-russian-forces-pressing-hardest-in-pokrovsk-kostiantynivka-sectors.html) reported that 116 combat engagements took place along the front line, with Russian forces launching nearly 25 assaults in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-633-130-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that total Russian troop losses reached 1,633,130, including 2,150 casualties over the past day.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186670-war-update-278-clashes-on-front-line-over-past-day-pokrovsk-sector-hottest.html) reported that 278 combat engagements were recorded along the front line on November 19, with the highest number in the Pokrovsk sector.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186183-war-update-205-clashes-on-front-line-80-russian-troops-neutralized-on-pokrovsk-axis.html) reported that 205 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline on November 18, with 80 Russian troops neutralized on the Pokrovsk axis.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185400-war-update-135-combat-engagements-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 135 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces on November 16.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185350-war-update-133-combat-engagements-on-front-line.html) reported that 133 combat engagements were recorded along the front line, with Russian forces attacking Ukrainian positions 13 times in the Pokrovsk sector.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185037-war-update-141-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-kostiantynivka-axis-hottest.html) reported that 141 combat engagements were recorded on the front line, with the Kostiantynivka axis being the most active.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062929/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded 171 combat clashes on November 14, with the Pokrovsk front experiencing the highest number of attacks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184540-war-update-243-clashes-on-front-line-fiercest-fighting-in-pokrovsk-sector.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062835/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded hundreds of combat clashes along the front line over the past day, with the heaviest fighting in the Pokrovsk sector.

stories.title: Remedios de Escalada gas explosion

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/ponernos-de-pie-los-vecinos-de-lanus-marchan-para-pedir-justicia-a-una-semana-de-la-tragica-nid21112026/) reported that residents of Lanús marched to demand justice one week after the gas explosion, coinciding with the patronal feast of the Virgin of the Rosary.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/tragica-explosion-remedios-escalada-muertos-victimas-fatales_0_pAhLnCZKXm.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-y-muerte-fallecieron-otras-dos-personas-por-el-escape-de-gas-en-remedios-de-escalada-y-ya-nid21112026/) reported that two outsourced workers who were hospitalized following a gas pipe explosion in Remedios de Escalada died of their injuries, raising the death toll to four.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/entre-escombros-miedo-y-reclamos-asi-se-vive-a-una-semana-de-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-nid19112026/) reported that one week after the explosion in Remedios de Escalada, concerns persist regarding new leaks and suspended works.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/seis-dias-despues-de-la-explosion-el-adn-confirmo-que-la-primera-victima-fatal-es-el-operario-de-nid19112026/) reported that DNA testing confirmed that missing Metrogas worker Marcelo García was the first fatality in the Remedios de Escalada tragedy, alongside the death of another worker.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-murio-otro-operario-de-metrogas-y-ya-son-dos-las-victimas-fatales-nid19112026/) reported that a second Metrogas worker injured in the gas pipeline explosion in Remedios de Escalada died in a Buenos Aires clinic.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/metrogas-respondio-al-enojo-de-los-vecinos-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-y-defendio-el-trabajo-de-los-nid17112026/) reported that Metrogas responded to neighborhood anger following a gas explosion and defended the work of operators.

stories.title: Amid setbacks, Saudi Arabia braces for Yemen war to stretch into 2027: Report
stories.label: Yemen government forces and Houthi advance

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-coalition-launches-operation-houthis-vow-reprisals) reported that the Saudi-led coalition attacked the Red Sea port city of Hodeida and other targets in a special operation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemens-aden-divided-government-forces-prepare-houthi-assault) reported that inhabitants of Aden face a potential Houthi assault as government forces remain divided.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/conflict-in-yemen-could-stretch-for-months-us-withdraws-an-aircraft-carrier-and-other-mideast-news-101795039320695.html) reported that the conflict in Yemen could stretch for months as the US withdrew an aircraft carrier.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-arabia-appoints-new-yemen-commander-amid-setbacks) reported that Saudi Arabia appointed General Fayyad Al-Ruwaili as the new commander of coalition forces in Yemen amid Houthi advances.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/houthis-advance-on-aden-as-saudi-coalition-targets-military-sites?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Saudi-led coalition conducted precision strikes on 60 Houthi military sites as fierce battles took place in Taiz and Houthis advanced toward Aden.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/saudi-arabia-preparing-for-war-against-houthis-to-stretch-into-next-year-report-101795007702949.html), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/amid-setbacks-saudi-arabia-braces-yemen-war-stretch-2027-report) reported that Saudi Arabia is bracing for the Yemen war to stretch into next year amid Houthi advances.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/saudi-arabia-appoints-gen-ruwaili-oversee-yemen-war-after-setbacks-what-know) reported that Saudi Arabia appointed Gen. Fayyad Ruwaili to oversee the Yemen war following battlefield struggles by Saudi-backed forces.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOR2l1bWc4eTF3NXJ2NktEbGZGWnRzeUJyYzBaQmxBdnpnblVHeEVzaDVZR01ndG1UQVAzTkdtVGxaYlRZcEJ6S3BHRTJuVkRXVjFkZkpOb3lYcGlsc25UVW41QjA1QmgxY1hBaUp0ZWYxQjFZYXhyWklaZFdLMEVEcnFoOWRSR1poMEh4ZWN0ZXlETnlJWU5JdXUycEMtdkszeXAxZEtPa2gwS3MwcDQ0eDRFNUQ?oc=5) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen bolstered their defenses near Aden to deter Houthi forces.

On 16 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Houthi-Advance-Puts-Saudi-Crude-Exports-at-Risk.html) reported that Houthi fighters advanced to within 100 kilometers of Aden after government forces withdrew from positions.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-saudi-king-replaces-coalition-commander-as-houthis-advance-toward-yemens-aden/) reported that Saudi King Salman bin Abdulaziz replaced the commander of the Saudi-led military coalition.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/aden-houthis-iran-strait-of-hormuz-yemen-b3086340.html) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen deployed additional troops near the port city of Aden to counter a potential Houthi rebel advance.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-saudi-arabia-replaces-military-commander-after-yemen-setbacks) reported that Saudi Arabia replaced its military commander overseeing the coalition against the Houthis following setbacks.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249487/Aramco-is-our-prime-target-in-Saudi-Arabia-Yemeni-military) reported that the Yemeni military warned that Saudi oil giant Aramco and its facilities are prime targets for attacks.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/yemen-army-reports-661-attacks-on-houthis-amid-houthi-push-towards-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yemen's army recorded 661 attacks by Houthi forces and 173 Houthi fighters killed or wounded as government forces repositioned to defend Aden.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthis-advance-toward-aden-us-iran-deadlock-continues) reported that Houthi forces are advancing toward Aden while the US-Iran deadlock continues.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/saudi-arabia-challenged-yemeni-allies-ceding-ground-houthis) reported that Saudi Arabia was challenged by Yemeni allies over ceding ground to Houthis.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/lt-gen-fahd-bin-hamad-replaced-as-saudi-joint-forces-commander-amid-houthi-attacks/), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/saudi-arabia-replaces-joint-forces-commander-overseeing-fight-with-houthis/) reported that Saudi Arabia replaced Lt. Gen. Fahd bin Hamad as Joint Forces Commander overseeing operations in Yemen.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/houthis-retake-bab-al-mandeb-and-move-toward-aden.php) reported that Yemeni government-aligned forces redeployed from the west coast to focus on defending Aden as Houthi forces seized territory along Bab al Mandeb.

On 16 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/16/gli-houthi-padroni-a-bab-el-mandeb-dopo-la-ritirata-dei-filo-sauditi_850c3a05-2ef4-46b8-b2ed-b22483a90c37.html) reported that loyalists left the strait as the Saudi-led coalition's counteroffensive ended in a retreat.

On 16 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/yemen-government-forces-retreat-bab-el-mandeb-strait/107392710) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen retreated to defend the key port city of Aden.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemens-saudi-backed-forces-retreat-defend-aden-houthis-advance-what-know) reported that Saudi Arabia named a new commander of its military forces as its Yemeni allies cede ground.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/yemen/20261116-saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-of-anti-houthi-coalition-as-rebels-advance), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-of-coalition-forces-fighting-houthis?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-anti-houthi-coalition) reported that Saudi Arabia dismissed the commander of the coalition forces fighting the Houthis in Yemen as government forces withdraw from the Red Sea coast.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/houthis-edge-closer-to-aden-as-yemeni-forces-pull-out-of-bab-al-mandeb?traffic_source=rss), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-yemeni-forces-withdraw-from-area-near-bab-al-mandab-as-houthis-take-control/) reported that forces loyal to Yemen's internationally recognised government withdrew from positions near the Bab al-Mandab Strait as Houthis advanced.

On 16 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqvg2xgyvnjpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Saudi-backed Yemeni forces are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to defend the interim capital Aden, leaving Houthis in control of the waterway.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648876-houthis-tighten-grip-key-route/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Saudi-backed Yemeni forces withdrew from positions near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as Houthi advances threatened Aden.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/houthis-advance-in-yemen-as-government-forces-move-to-defend-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that an advance by the Houthi armed group in Yemen threatens one of the government's last strongholds.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/houthis-aden-govt-defences/) reported that Houthi forces advanced on Aden and seized the Red Sea coast in a lightning offensive while Saudi-backed forces bolstered defenses.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249422/Images-of-the-advances-of-the-Yemeni-armed-forces-in-Lahj) reported that the Yemeni Ansar Allah-led government's military released images of the advances of their forces in Lahj province.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/yemeni-government-forces-redeploy-from-bab-al-mandeb-to-defend-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that a spokesman for the Southern Armed Forces said the group is repositioning from Dhubab airport and areas around Bab al-Mandeb.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/anti-houthi-forces-retreat-yemen-iran-strikes-bahrain) reported that Saudi-backed forces retreated against the Houthis in Yemen while Iran and its allies increased pressure on the US and Gulf states.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemeni-government-force-retreats-strait-major-setback-war-against-houthis) reported that Yemeni government forces announced they were withdrawing from the area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on defending their main base in Aden.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemen-government-forces-withdraw-area-near-bab-el-mandeb-strait-houthis-control), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/southern-yemeni-forces-withdraw-from-area-near-bab-al-mandab/), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-914920) reported that Yemeni forces fighting for the internationally recognized government withdrew from an area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving the Houthis in control.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261115-yemen-houthis-advance-to-within-60-kilometres-of-aden-military-sources-say), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/yemen-bab-al-mandab-conflict/) reported that Houthi forces in Yemen advanced to within 60 kilometres of Aden and took the Kharaz base as government and pro-Saudi forces retreated.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/yemeni-government-forces-retreat-from-strait-in-major-setback-in-war-against-houthis/article71705608.ece) reported that Houthi gains in Yemen and attacks on Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping have strengthened Iran's position.

On 15 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/world/middleeast/saudi-houthis-yemen-red-sea.html) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen retreated from the Red Sea as Houthi forces advanced.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxPM1hhZ2pySkp3SHdfNllHQ2VsLUFteHIxRlFGVVR3QXFIbXJZX01HQkZ5Ml96SjBMSkJkOHh6TjNIakZkR3k5ME1WY0RyYTNBQkxvaF9qYTVtNm5GVEFqckVEalRReVdXUFJKZVhlSXEzcnotRFMyVVBMZllhdmJxUFBwRjByVExHbGhnR3luTDVqTlRxOG5TTjFVbmdBRmM?oc=5) reported that Yemen's Houthis stated they fired missiles at Saudi forces in Jazan.

On 14 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86321693/Yemen-s-armed-forces-say-they-struck-Saudi-backed-forces-in-Lahj), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249400/Yemen-military-says-it-struck-Saudi-backed-forces-in-Lahj) reported that Yemen's armed forces targeted gatherings of Saudi-backed forces in Lahj province.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532098/Yemeni-forces-complete-Aden-encirclement), a state outlet, reported that forces loyal to Yemen's Ansarallah movement completed the encirclement of Aden.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044365/yemeni-govt-forces-fortify-defences-in-aden) reported that Yemen's internationally recognized government is fortifying positions on the outskirts of Aden province as Houthi forces advance.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/yemen-govt-forces-fortify-aden-defences-houthis-advance) reported that Yemen's government forces are fortifying defenses around Aden as Houthi forces advance.

stories.title: Eisenkot calls for probe into alleged Netanyahu election interference
stories.label: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of 'racist and violent' campaign against Arab citizens

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/lieberman-says-ousting-netanyahu-remains-his-main-goal-3725826) reported that Yisrael Beytenu leader Avigdor Lieberman stated removing caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu remains his priority and ruled out any government that re-elects him.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261119-netanyahu-planned-to-accuse-arabs-of-stealing-elections-investigation-released-by-israeli-broadcaster-claims/) reported that an investigation by Israeli public broadcaster KAN claimed Benjamin Netanyahu and Likud devised a plan to accuse Arabs of stealing elections.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/eisenkot-netanyahu-must-leave-office/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot demanded Benjamin Netanyahu's immediate departure and an investigation into allegations that his aides were involved in a school scheme.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-may-have-to-oust-security-chiefs-over-netanyahus-stolen-election-drive/000001a1-e623-d3ad-a5e3-e7fb6aa10000) reported that reports claimed the prime minister's office pushed allegations that Arab parties stole the vote and the Shin Bet chief sought to wiretap Joint List lawmakers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045063/israeli-leaders-slam-netanyahus-attempted-election-coup) reported that Israeli leaders criticized Benjamin Netanyahu over reports that his office tried to frame Arab-Israeli party members ahead of polls.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/is-israels-opposition-less-right-wing-than-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli government without Prime Minister Netanyahu may be close, but a government without his politics is far less certain.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/joint-list-calls-criminal-probe-netanyahu-after-expose) reported that the Joint List called for a criminal probe into caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following allegations of attempting to falsely incriminate Arab officials ahead of the election.

On 16 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/benjamin-netanyahu-gadi-eisenkot-call-for-investigation/107392590) reported that Gadi Eisenkot demanded an investigation into the Israeli Prime Minister's Office over election fraud claims.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-lapid-accuses-netanyahu-of-attempted-coup-through-targeting-arab-parties-in-israel/) reported that Israeli opposition figure Yair Lapid accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of seeking to stage an attempted coup by targeting Arab parties.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/israel-party-chiefs-say-netanyahus-election-fraud-claims-a-coup-attempt/) reported that party chiefs stated Netanyahu's election fraud claims were a coup attempt, while his Likud party denied the claims.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/netanyahu-allies-open-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-3725611), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-netanyahu-allies-open-door-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-report/) reported that associates of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Gadi Eisenkot's team that Likud would accept a unity government without Itamar Ben-Gvir's party.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/tibi-seeks-criminal-probe-of-netanyahu-over-alleged-election-interference-3725628) reported that Ahmad Tibi called for an immediate police probe into Netanyahu and his office following a Channel 12 investigation.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/16/eisenkot-calls-for-inquiry-into-alleged-netanyahu-role-in-election-day-arrests-of-arab-israeli-activists/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-calls-for-probe-into-alleged-netanyahu-election-interference-3725614), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eisenkot-says-netanyahu-threatens-democracy-pledges-probe-into-pms-office-role-in-election/) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot called for an inquiry into Benjamin Netanyahu's alleged role in election-day arrests of Arab Israeli activists.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/la-corrupcion-en-el-ine-morena-y-su-prisa-por-deslindarse-de-taddei/) reported that presidential approval in Mexico has suffered from wear according to Polls MX data.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/oposicion-israeli-pide-investigar-presunta-manipulacion-electoral-por-oficina-de-netanyahu-33152148), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eisenkot-acuso-a-netanyahu-de-amenazar-la-democracia-y-pidio-investigar-una-presunta-maniobra-nid15112026/) reported that Israeli opposition figures, including Eisenkot, called for an investigation into alleged electoral manipulation by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office regarding the arrest of Arab activists during elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/pan-exige-investigar-presuntas-irregularidades-en-gestion-de-taddei-pide-un-ine-independiente-de-morena/) reported that the PAN party in Mexico presented a factual complaint to the FGR to investigate potential offenses related to public fund management under Taddei.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/oficina-netanyahu-planeo-detener-miembros-partidos-arabes-acusarlos-falsamente-fraude-electoral_202611166afabd97ea8d89799786fb0c.html) reported that a popular Israeli media outlet published information regarding a plan by Netanyahu's office to arrest Arab party members to falsely accuse them of electoral fraud.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-914926) reported that Naftali Bennett urged Gadi Eisenkot's bloc to pressure Haredi parties rather than beg them to join the government.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/netanyahu-ofrece-gobierno-unidad-iran-partidos-arabes-eisenkot-tacha-farol_202611146af8b8ccd3bddc0868b1f4c7.html) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot dismissed Benjamin Netanyahu's offer of a unity government without Arab parties as a bluff.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/netanyahu-pide-a-eisenkot-un-gobierno-de-unidad-ante-iran-que-excluya-a-los-arabes-llama-a-negociar-sin-condiciones/) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu asked Gadi Eisenkot to join a unity government that excludes Arab parties, while the opposition leader dismissed the offer as a bluff.
