stories.label: Paraguay political and banking crisis

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-contra-el-exfiscal-general-de-paraguay-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-33238340) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against former Attorney General Emiliano Rolón.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-exfiscal-general-paraguay-ueno-bank_1795221891) reported that the Paraguayan Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against the former attorney general regarding Ueno Bank, alongside the resignation and preventative detention of former Central Bank head Carlos Carvallo and three board directors.

On 19 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/19/ueno-bank-collapse-claims-paraguay-s-attorney-general-and-the-head-of-itaipu?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General Emiliano Rolón resigned and the Paraguayan director of the binational Itaipú dam departed following the Ueno Bank collapse.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-attorney-general-rolon-resigns/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay’s Attorney General Emiliano Rolon Fernandez resigned to stop an impeachment trial in the Chamber of Deputies.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-moved-to-military-prison/), a state-media outlet, reported that a criminal guarantees judge ordered the immediate transfer of former president Santiago Peña to the Viñas Cué military prison in Asuncion.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/paraguay-ex-president-moved-to-military-jail-amid-special-treatment-reports?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier in the month.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/santiago-pena-trasladado-carcel-militar-evitar-privilegios_1794875745) reported that Santiago Peña was transferred to a military jail to avoid privileges following an immediate transfer order by penal guarantee judge Osmar Legal.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-ex-president-pena-moved-vinas-cue-military-prison/) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña entered a military prison following a judge's transfer order in the Ueno Bank case.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/santiago-pena-ingresa-a-una-carcel-militar-en-paraguay-esposado-y-con-chaleco-antibalas-33164061) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed in preventive detention at a military prison.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-escandalo-por-los-privilegios-de-santiago-pena-en-prision-fuerza-su-traslado-a-otra-carcel-nid16112026/) reported that the scandal over Santiago Peña's privileges in prison forced his transfer to another military jail in Paraguay.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/juez-en-paraguay-ordena-trasladar-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-a-carcel-militar-sera-recluido-en-la-prision-de-vinas-cue/) reported critics denounced alleged privileges granted to the former leader, including a gymnasium.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640983/ihc-orders-medical-care-for-bushra-bibi-in-jail-amid-eyesight-concerns), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045411/ps190m-corruption-case-ihc-directs-proper-medical-care-hygienic-living-conditions-for-bushra-bibi) reported that the Islamabad High Court directed prison authorities to ensure proper medical care and hygienic living conditions for Bushra Bibi.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045191/8-pakistan-bar-council-members-call-on-judiciary-to-take-note-of-imrans-plea-for-medical-treatment) reported that eight members of the Pakistan Bar Council called upon the judiciary to ensure implementation of the Supreme Court's order regarding Imran Khan's medical treatment.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNUm9CVHJndDZlZ0dWQk9mbGJyNmNRcmpsVHRmM3IwYkxtUjl0UFlkUXhyVHNMTjhMSGNnQ0Z1NEd5UmlselRYUUxvQ2ctTV81SEhEMEtWcFU4eDh2NDZxNDZDZXJxOEJKbW5CZnZPME1vUlRKakhiNXNsZ05JV09Ial9ybEl6VDUxOHNHNFVld1JEaGZoWEdVcVY5NkxRQ19yQ1JCMXJ6MXpHcUVYdFdRU1VmT3MxNTZBbEtscW5zVnJVLVQz?oc=5) reported that Azma Bokhari called Imran Khan's medical concerns propaganda.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-20/Experts-take-How-APEC-Shenzhen-meeting-shapes-regional-cooperation-1SdXVnAQysM/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=China), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping outlined a vision for regional cooperation at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641346/apec-leaders-call-for-stronger-connectivity-fewer-trade-barriers-at-china-summit), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/ac73cec29bdc) reported that APEC leaders called for stronger transport connectivity and fewer trade barriers at the summit in China.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649021-putin-trump-apec-meeting/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that the Kremlin stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump are expected to meet after the APEC plenary session.
On 18 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2220773) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated the Putin-Trump meeting will be brief due to a lack of time.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261118-xi-jinping-calls-for-global-cooperation-on-ai-and-free-trade-at-apec-summit) reported that Xi Jinping called for stronger global cooperation on artificial intelligence.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118003400315) reported that South Korean President Lee Jae Myung was set to hold talks with Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/trump-xi-putin-discuss-world-peace-china-says), [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648943-russia-china-us-summit/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin will meet in China to discuss topics including world peace, nuclear arms, Ukraine, Iran, and trade.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117010100315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940356) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated North Korean leader Kim Jong Un would like to attend the APEC summit in China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219413) reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated no Putin-Musk meeting is planned on the sidelines of the APEC summit, and a full-format meeting with Takaichi is not scheduled.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219343), a Russian state-run outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov noted leaders could select a venue for a brief conversation between Vladimir Putin and the South Korean leader at the APEC summit.

On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219129), a Russian state-run outlet, reported that a Kremlin aide announced an APEC leaders working meeting will be held on November 19, beginning with a welcome from the President of China and a joint photo session.

On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219097) reported that Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov stated Vladimir Putin will speak about Russian investment potential and the global economy at the APEC business summit.

On 16 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374652/putin-could-meet-north-koreas-kim-if-he-also-heads-china-apec-summit) reported that Interfax quoted Ushakov as saying Putin could meet North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if he travels to China for the summit.
On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219107) reported that a high-ranking delegation including seven ministers and corporate executives will accompany Putin.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/govt-cuts-jet-fuel-kerosene-diesel-prices/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584865/government-slashes-jet-fuel-kerosene-prices-today/) reported that the federal government reduced the prices of jet fuel, kerosene oil, and light diesel oil.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045695/govt-snaps-petrol-price-reduction-spree-as-rate-raised-by-re1-per-litre-diesel-remains-unchanged), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584155/petrol-price-up-by-rs-1-per-litre-diesel-rate-unchanged/) reported that the Pakistan government increased the petrol price by Re1 to Rs323 per litre while keeping the diesel rate unchanged at Rs355 per litre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583646/petrol-and-diesel-dip-by-rs-3-per-litre/) reported that the government reduced the prices of petrol and diesel by Rs3 per litre, marking the twelfth consecutive decrease in the price of petrol.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641040/petrol-and-high-speed-diesel-drop-by-rs3-per-litre) reported that the price of petrol dropped to Rs322 and high-speed diesel to Rs355 per litre.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/petrol-price-in-pakistan-drops-to-rs325-per-litre-after-rs53-cut-in-november/) reported that petrol prices in Pakistan dropped by nearly Rs53 per litre in just over two weeks after another reduction.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640653/govt-cuts-petrol-high-speed-diesel-price-by-rs2), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044962/govt-reduces-petrol-diesel-prices-by-rs2-per-litre) reported that the government cut the price of petrol and high-speed diesel by Rs2.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/petrol-levy-relief-as-govt-cuts-publics-share-to-rs63-64-per-litre/) reported that the Pakistan government reduced the public's petrol levy burden by Rs1.65 to Rs63.64 per litre.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640162/petrol-drops-by-rs2-diesel-remains-unchanged-till-nov-16), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044318/petrol-price-cut-by-by-rs2-high-speed-diesel-price-remains-unchanged) reported that the price of petrol was reduced by Rs2 while high-speed diesel remained unchanged.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE85dHFFa0Y5Y1I5cTlYemhqdlgwRWRQanhHY2Jfb2VsbThFdGtjWUVHYXpUQlBqeVhoYUprREFvU3NjODE3N2J5MmY3RkE5dGZJSkwtT0NoTXNxdVlWdmNzOFZ6SjJXTTZyNzhFR1JB?oc=5) reported that China, Russia, and the US held their first tripartite summit in Shenzhen.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/21/japan/us-china-russia-summits-japan-wary/) reported that Japan is wary of the U.S., Russia, and China holding regular summits and is eager to maintain the existing international order.

On 20 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/diplomacy/article/3375296/trump-says-china-agreed-trilateral-despite-reluctance-notes-nuclear-gap), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222745) reported that US President Donald Trump stated China agreed to hold trilateral nuclear risk-reduction consultations with Russia and the US for the first time.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/china-russia-us-talk-un-reform-nuclear-risks-and-ukraine-at-trilateral-summit/) reported that China, Russia, and the US discussed UN reform, nuclear risks, and Ukraine at a trilateral summit hosted by Xi Jinping.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/european-regulators-warn-of-growing-risks-to-nuclear-safety-in-ukraine-3725672) reported that three European associations of nuclear and radiation safety regulators issued a joint statement warning of growing nuclear safety risks from Russian attacks on Ukraine's electricity grids and infrastructure.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/nuclear-accident-ukraine-winter/) reported that atomic safety regulators stated that without a stable electricity supply, it becomes difficult for Ukrainian nuclear plants to keep their nuclear material cool, raising nuclear accident risks this winter.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/16/4980448_riskut_ot_iadrena_avariia_v_ukraina_narastva_zaiaviha/?ref=rss), [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23943187) reported that regulatory authorities on nuclear safety from 38 countries stated that the risk of a nuclear accident in Ukraine is increasing this winter and called on Russia to cease attacks on nuclear infrastructure.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063134/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-faces-rising-nuclear-accident-risk-this-winter-regulators-warn/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/nuclear-regulators-from-38-countries-warn-of-a-growing-risk-of-a-nuclear-accident-in-ukraine-this-winter-and-urge-russia-to-stop-striking-the-power-grid) reported that nuclear safety regulators from 38 countries warned of a rising risk of a nuclear accident in Ukraine due to Russian strikes on energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Brazil fiscal adjustment bill approval

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/21/lula-critica-ala-da-esquerda-que-se-opos-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-faria-lima-nao-vai-ensina-lo-a-governar.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva criticized leftist factions opposing his government's fiscal adjustment package.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/em-busca-de-reeleicao-alcolumbre-e-motta-acenam-ao-planalto-por-ajuste-fiscal-e-a-oposicao-com-beneficio-a-bolsonaro.ghtml) reported that House President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre intensified gestures toward the Planalto and the opposition regarding fiscal adjustment.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/proposta-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-planalto-vira-estopim-e-psol-racha-sobre-relacao-com-governo-lula.ghtml) reported that the PSOL entered an internal dispute over how to react to the government's fiscal adjustment package ahead of the Chamber vote.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/os-dois-votos-do-pl-que-rogerio-marinho-ja-considera-perdidos-na-disputa-pela-presidencia-do-senado.ghtml) reported that Rogério Marinho already discounted two votes from his own party in the dispute for the presidency of the Senate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/relator-na-camara-divulga-parecer-de-pacote-fiscal-e-nao-faz-alteracoes-no-texto-para-acelerar-aprovacao.ghtml) reported that Mauro Benevides Filho, the rapporteur of the fiscal adjustment project drafted by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, released his opinion without making changes to the text in order to accelerate approval in the Chamber.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-senado-suaviza-corte-de-repasses-a-estados-e-texto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package with a gesture to states, softening cuts to transfers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/votacao-do-governo-em-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-expoe-disputa-entre-alcolumbre-e-marinho-pelo-comando-do-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate vote on the government's fiscal adjustment package exposed a dispute between Davi Alcolumbre and Rogério Marinho for control of the Senate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-passa-no-senado-entenda-os-proximos-passos-antes-de-medida-entrar-em-vigor.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package, though the measures are not yet in force.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-aprova-projeto-que-estabelece-novas-regras-para-uso-de-postes-por-empresas-de-internet.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill establishing new rules for the sharing of electricity poles by internet companies.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323780-senado-rejeita-mudancas-no-texto-e-aprova-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/alcolumbre-ve-influencia-de-disputa-eleitoral-em-criticas-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-dialogo-prevaleceu-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate rejected changes to the text and approved the government's fiscal adjustment project, sending it to the Chamber of Deputies.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2026/11/18/pena-maior-para-quem-matar-dirigindo-sob-efeito-de-alcool-e-aprovada-no-senado-e-projeto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill increasing penalties for homicide and serious bodily injury caused by drunk drivers, sending the project to the Chamber.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/chefe-da-articulacao-politica-diz-que-governo-acertou-com-motta-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-na-camara-ate-terca-feira.ghtml) reported that Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães stated he agreed with Chamber President Hugo Motta to vote on the fiscal package in the Chamber by Tuesday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-teto-para-compensacao-previdenciaria-a-estados-e-municipios-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate maintained the provision in the fiscal adjustment project limiting social security compensation transfers to states and municipalities to 3 billion reals per year between 2027 and 2030.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-restricao-ao-uso-de-creditos-tributarios-por-empresas-em-projeto-do-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate kept the section of the fiscal adjustment package authorizing the government to restrict companies from using tax credits for settlements.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mudancas-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate resumed discussion of the government's fiscal adjustment project after it was postponed due to a lack of agreement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/julgamento-dos-beneficios-fiscais-da-atem-volta-a-estaca-zero-no-stf-e-pressao-cresce.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Minister Luiz Fux requested a review of the direct unconstitutionality action regarding tax benefits for the Manaus Free Trade Zone benefiting Atem.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/ala-bolsonarista-do-pl-ve-gesto-eleitoreiro-de-motta-e-alcolumbre-ao-pedir-a-moraes-julgamento-sobre-lei-que-beneficia-bolsonaro.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323484-motta-e-alcolumbre-pedem-a-moraes-julgamento-da-lei-da-dosimetria.html) reported that Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre asked Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to judge the sentencing reduction law for January 8 prisoners this year.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/governo-conta-votos-e-aposta-em-articulacao-de-alcolumbre-para-concluir-votacao-de-ajuste-fiscal-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva government is working to secure votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote in the Senate with the backing of Davi Alcolumbre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/sem-acordo-entenda-o-que-travou-a-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate postponed concluding the vote on President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal measures package due to a lack of agreement with the opposition and guaranteed votes.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/alcolumbre-diz-que-tem-votos-para-concluir-votacao-do-ajuste-fiscal-nesta-quarta-feira.ghtml) reported that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated there are enough votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/17/janones-rebate-criticas-apos-defender-governo-se-alguns-se-acham-mais-inteligentes-que-lula-parabens-nao-e-meu-caso.ghtml) reported that federal deputy André Janones rebuffed criticism after defending the government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lula-deve-divulgar-video-defendendo-pacote-fiscal-apos-criticas-da-esquerda.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is set to release a video defending the fiscal adjustment package proposed by his government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323396-congresso-pede-que-stf-julgue-lei-que-beneficia-condenados-pelo-8-1.html) reported that the presidents of the Chamber and the Senate met with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to request judgment on a law benefiting those convicted for the January 8 events.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/17/ministros-do-stf-avaliam-que-moraes-deve-liberar-julgamento-de-acao-que-pode-reduzir-pena-de-bolsonaro-apos-reuniao-com-motta-e-alcolumbre.ghtml) reported that expectations in the Supreme Federal Court are that Minister Alexandre de Moraes will soon release for trial actions questioning the constitutionality regarding Bolsonaro's sentence following a meeting with Motta and Alcolumbre.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lula-se-reune-com-ministro-do-trabalho-para-acertar-detalhes-de-decreto-sobre-fim-da-escala-6x1.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Minister of Labor and Employment Luiz Marinho at the Alvorada Palace in Brasília to settle details on a decree regarding the end of the 6x1 work scale.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323312-dino-decide-que-escala-5x2-sera-julgada-de-forma-definitiva-pelo-stf.html) reported that Justice Dino decided that the 5x2 scale will be judged definitively by the Supreme Federal Court after the court's virtual plenary initiated evaluation to endorse the minister's injunction.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/dino-estabelece-prazos-em-acao-sobre-escala-6x1-e-julgamento-no-plenario-do-stfpode-ocorrer-em-duas-semanas.ghtml) reported that Justice Flávio Dino opened new deadlines for Congress, the Prosecutor General's Office, and the Attorney General's Office in a lawsuit regarding the 6x1 work scale.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lider-do-governo-no-congresso-apresenta-projeto-para-taxar-big-techs-meio-a-ajuste-fiscal.ghtml) reported that government leader in Congress Senator Randolfe Rodrigues presented a bill to tax big tech companies.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/o-deputado-que-mais-se-destacou-nas-redes-com-criticas-ao-ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-segundo-relatorio-para-ebc.ghtml) reported that elected deputy Jones Manoel gained prominence on social media by criticizing the Lula government's fiscal adjustment package.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/governo-tira-urgencia-de-projeto-que-criminaliza-exploracao-das-bets-para-viabilizar-votacao-de-pacote-fiscal-na-camara.ghtml) reported that the government removed urgency from a bill criminalising sports betting exploitation to facilitate the voting of the fiscal package.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/pacote-fiscal-motta.ghtml) reported that Chamber of President Hugo Motta stated the fiscal package will be voted on Tuesday if the Senate concludes its analysis.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/pt-define-que-votara-a-favor-do-pacote-fiscal-do-governo-lula-na-camara-apos-criticas-e-cobranca-do-planalto.ghtml) reported that the Workers' Party caucus in the Chamber defined that it will vote in favor of the government's fiscal adjustment project.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/ministro-do-planejamento-deve-se-reunir-hoje-com-deputados-do-pt-para-tentar-reduzir-criticas-ao-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that Planning Minister Bruno Moretti was scheduled to meet with Workers' Party federal deputies to try to reduce criticisms of the fiscal package.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/16/pt-da-camara-deve-apoiar-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-apesar-de-criticas-a-ajuste.ghtml) reported that the Workers' Party caucus in the Chamber of Deputies is expected to largely support President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal adjustment package despite criticisms.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10938696), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261116002952315) reported that South Korea's Supreme Court announced it will rule on former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo's insurrection case on Thursday, a day before his detention period expires.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/16/fim-da-escala-6x1-governo-deve-publicar-nesta-semana-decreto-com-regulamentacao.ghtml) reported that the government plans to publish a decree this week regulating the end of the 6x1 work scale following Justice Flávio Dino's provisional decision.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/16/senado-deve-concluir-nesta-semana-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-que-seguira-para-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate is expected to conclude voting on the government's fiscal package this week before sending it to the Chamber of Deputies.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/fim-da-escala-6x1-fux-pede-para-julgara-no-plenario-fisico-decisao-de-dino-que-manteve-nova-jornada-a-partir-de-dezembro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Justice Luiz Fux interrupted the judgment on Justice Flávio Dino's decision maintaining the 6x1 work scale, sending it to the physical plenary.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/fim-da-escala-6x1-dino-diz-que-negociacao-coletiva-e-melhor-caminho-para-transicao-da-nova-jornada.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Justice Flávio Dino stated collective bargaining is the best path for transitioning to the new work schedule.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/stf-caminha-para-manter-fim-da-escala-6x1-em-16-de-dezembro-veja-como-ficam-folgas-e-salario-por-hora.ghtml) reported that the plenary of the Supreme Federal Court is moving to uphold the end of the 6x1 work scale on December 16.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/victorian-election-analysis-one-week-to-go/107412322) reported that Victorian Labor MPs are conducting a pre-mortem following three successive election victories.

On 21 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-21/jess-wilson-kew-district-sophie-torney-victorian-electorate/107400636) reported that a returning independent candidate in Jess Wilson's home electorate of Kew is optimistic about her chances against the local Liberal member.

On 21 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-21/victorian-election-final-week/107412434) reported that political experts stated Labor is set for a historic defeat at the Victorian election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/victoria/the-liberal-party-s-secret-election-weapon-one-nation-and-labor-voters-20261119-p61e8h.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that in three-cornered contests between Labor, the Liberals, and One Nation, preferences from the third-place candidate will be critical in deciding the winner.

On 18 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/victorian-election-casey-briggs-analysis-state-of-play/107393822) reported that the Coalition's statewide support stood just above 30 percent while the gap between the Coalition and One Nation widened.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/victorian-premier-ben-carroll-pressed-on-labor-polling-20261118-p61f8m.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Victorians have started voting in the state's largest election on record, hours after Today show hosts pressed Ben Carroll on Labor's polling and political record.

On 17 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/victorian-election-debate-jess-wilson-winner/107397070) reported that policy discussion was light in the News24/Herald Sun election debate.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/17/voldemort-gotham-city-greens-liberal-labor-one-nation-victorian-election-leaders-debate-ntwnfb) reported that Victorian election candidates Ben Carroll, Jess Wilson, Ellen Sandell, and Warren Pickering faced questioning from undecided voters and each other in a sole debate.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/victoria/victorian-election-leaders-debate-live-ben-carroll-jess-wilson-warren-pickering-and-ellen-sandell-make-pitch-to-undecided-voters-20261117-p61exb.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Victorian premier and opposition leader squared off in a four-way debate with One Nation and Greens leaders.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/victorian-labor-and-liberals-officially-launch-campaigns-20261115-p61ebg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Victorian Labor and Liberal parties officially launched their election campaigns.

On 15 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-15/labor-liberal-coalition-campaign-launches-health-youth-crime/107387220) reported that Victorian Premier Ben Carroll highlighted his party's public health credentials while Opposition Leader Jess Wilson accused Labor of taking away services.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-za-pevnicom-u-crkvi-u-raski-povodom-slave-arandjelovdan/qp0bsvm) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić attended a liturgy in Raška and sang church songs with believers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Cupic-objavio-imena-kandidata-za-potpredsjednike-Skupstine-Srbije/993285) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, president of the National Assembly of Serbia, read the names of candidates for six vice presidents during the continued constituent session.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/stevandic-prvi-cestitao-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-pozvao-ga-da-dode-u-nsrs/261119159) reported that Republika Srpska National Assembly President Nenad Stevandic congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia and invited him to visit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089228/ko-je-aleksandar-cupic-profesor-koji-je-ugostio-studente-u-plasteniku-a-danas-vodi-skupstinu-srbije) reported that Aleksandar Čupić is a faculty assistant professor who was proposed by student representatives.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/zvanicnici-crne-gore-cestitali-cupicu-izbor-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/x5h5s39) reported that officials of Montenegro congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Aleksandar-Cupic-novi-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srbije/993241) reported that Aleksandar Čupić was elected as the new president of the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/prvi-govor-aleksandra-cupica-kao-predsednika-skupstine/8d6lsk9), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089225/novi-predsjednik-skupstine-srbije-odrzao-prvi-govor-izvinio-se-pastoru-i-lidiji-vukicevic) reported that newly elected Serbia National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić delivered his first parliamentary speech and apologized to Lidija Vukićević and Bálint Pásztor.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089177/treci-dan-konstitutivne-sjednice-skupstine-srbije-zastupnici-biraju-predsjednika-parlamenta) reported that the National Assembly session continued for its third day to choose a parliament president.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/zavrsen-i-drugi-dan-zasjedanja-skupstine-srbije-vucic-moze-pricati-jos-10-dana/) reported that the second day of the National Assembly session concluded without electing a parliamentary president and will continue on Thursday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/potpuni-haos-na-kraju-dana-u-skupstini-srbije-vucic-pobjesnio-uslikaj-ih-sve-zapisi-ih-sve/261118290) reported that the session ended in uproar with Aleksandar Vučić demanding individuals be recorded and photographed.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucica-provocirao-novinar-pitanjem-o-bratu-andreju-dobio-zestok-odgovor-video/85h9d7t), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/tenzije-u-holu-skupstine-srbije-vucic-izgubio-nerve-nesreco-sram-te-bilo/) reported that tensions occurred in the lobby of the National Assembly involving Aleksandar Vučić and a journalist.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-o-sednici-skupstine-svojoj-imovini-i-vucicu/9tdz2vx) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, a candidate for president of the National Assembly from the Student List, announced plans to submit a property report following a parliamentary session where Aleksandar Vučić spoke for five hours.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kamberi-sda-ce-glasati-za-aleksandra-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/0lg50wn) reported that MP Shaip Kamberi stated the SDA will vote for Aleksandar Čupić as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasili-se-studenti-o-govoru-jugoslava-gasica-u-skupstini-srbije/wj1j0ls) reported that students from the Faculty of Media and Communications reacted on social media to criticism directed at Student List MP Jugoslav Gašić.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-nastavila-sjednicu-Minut-cutanja-za-pilota-Vucic-ponovo-govori/993001), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste-bira-se-predsednik/dv39qz9) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia held a minute of silence for Serbian Air Force pilot Goran Bulajić during its constitutive session.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sara-valentik-studentska-lista-ocekujem-efikasniju-skupstinu-nakon-izbora-predsednika/4r7ggv4) reported that Student List youngest MP Sara Valentik stated she expects a more efficient National Assembly of Serbia following the election of a new parliament president.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Ko-je-Jovo-Bakic-novi-sef-poslanicke-grupe-Studentske-liste/992989) reported that Jovo Bakić, a 56-year-old sociology professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade, became the head of the Student List parliamentary group in the new National Assembly of Serbia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-novog-saziva-skupstine-srbije/dv39qz9) reported that members of the 15th parliamentary session of the National Assembly of Serbia continued their constitutive session with discussions on candidates for assembly president.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/jovo-bakic-otkrio-ko-je-kandidat-studentske-liste-za-potpredsednika-skupstine-srbije/lhpd4cq) reported that Jovo Bakić, head of the Student List parliamentary group, held a press conference to reveal the candidate for vice president of the National Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/lija-srdanovic-nakon-sednice-sutra-dobijamo-predsednika-skupstine/wd4r421) reported that Ilija Srdanović, the first on the Student List - Students Win list, stated after the National Assembly session that they will get a parliamentary president the next day and criticized Aleksandar Vučić.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ana-brnabic-o-studentskoj-listi-posle-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije-video/zf5qshz) reported that member of parliament Ana Brnabić spoke out after the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia regarding the Student List candidate for the presidency of the assembly.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-o-programu-studentske-liste-republika-srpska-i-srbija-su-jedno-zajedno-smo-jaci/261116356) reported that SNSD general secretary Igor Dodik stated on X that Republika Srpska and Serbia are one and stronger together in reaction to the Studentska lista program.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ovo-je-govor-jugoslava-gasica-aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-predsednika-skupstine/g9e9h7z) reported that Student List member of parliament Jugoslav Gašić nominated Aleksandar Čupić for the presidency of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/polemika-u-skupstini-o-izvinjenju-lidiji-vukicevic/0dp5872) reported that National Assembly presiding officer Stojan Radenović and parliamentary group leader Aleksandar Vučić called on Student List deputies to oppose all violence during a parliamentary debate.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/od-profesora-do-kandidata-za-celo-parlamenta-ko-je-aleksandar-cupic/) reported profiles of figures discussed for the presidency of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Vucic-vise-od-sat-i-po-govorio-u-Skupstini-Bakic-mu-uzvratio/992887), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-reagovao-na-obracanje-vucica/jzw7gwg) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia was constituted and commenced discussions on parliamentary leadership.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/kcerka-legendarnog-fudbalera-dragana-dzajica-polozila-zakletvu-u-skupstini-srbije-ispred-sns-a/261117197), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088724/kcerka-fudbalera-dragana-dzajica-ponovo-u-skupstini-srbije-polozila-poslanicku-zakletvu-kao-predstavnica-sns-a) reported that Sanja Džajić took the oath of office as a Member of Parliament in the new convocation of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-bira-predsjednika-U-trci-dva-kandidata/992845) reported that two proposals were submitted for the president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/konstituisanjem-skupstine-poceo-da-tece-rok-od-90-dana-za-izbor-nove-vlade-srbije/4f2sb64) reported that the 90-day legal deadline to form a new government in Serbia began with the constitution of the new National Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-se-obraca-u-skupstini-srbije-jovo-bakic-negoduje/j4mp6l7) reported that Aleksandar Vučić addressed the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-novog-predsjednika-skupstine-srbije-preuzet-ce-i-ulogu-vd-predsjednika-drzave/261117138) reported that the Studentska lista nominated Aleksandar Čupić for president of the National Assembly of Serbia, and he stated he was ready to take on the role of acting head of state.

stories.label: Nigeria 2027 election violence crackdown

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/petrol-imports-jump-47-despite-local-refining/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nigeria's petrol imports rose 47% to 15 million litres per day in October according to NMDPRA data.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fg-suspends-lagos-ibadan-bridge-work-after-20-hour-gridlock/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nigerian Federal Government suspended construction on the pedestrian bridge at Aseese along the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway following a severe gridlock.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926362-2027-politics-watch-from-apcs-benue-ticket-setback-to-tinubus-state-police-bill.html) reported that a court invalidated the APC's substitution of Gabriel Suswam in Benue North-East, while President Bola Tinubu received a constitutional amendment bill on state police.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/at-last-senate-sends-state-police-bill-to-president-demands-operational-guidelines/) reported that the Senate sent the State Police Bill to the President and demanded operational guidelines while lawmakers warned against abuse.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/state-police-on-verge-of-reality-operational-guidelines-bill-submitted-to-justice-ministry/) reported that an operational guidelines bill for state police was submitted to the Justice Ministry.
On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-senate-demands-safeguards-against-abuse/) reported that the Senate demanded safeguards against the abuse of state police.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-why-constitutional-amendment-is-just-the-first-step-omole/) reported that a constitutional amendment allowing states to establish their own police services is considered the first step in decentralising policing in Nigeria.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/state-police-senate-clears-final-hurdle-sends-constitutional-amendment/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-bill-forwarded-by-senate-to-tinubu-for-assent/) reported that the Senate cleared the final hurdle and directed the Clerk to transmit the constitutional amendment bill seeking to establish state police for presidential assent.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-seeks-decriminalisation-of-attempted-suicide-proposes-support-for-victims/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-to-decriminalise-attempted-suicide/) reported that President Bola Tinubu transmitted the National Mental Health (Amendment) Bill, 2026, to the House of Representatives seeking to decriminalise attempted suicide.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-receives-state-police-bill-to-consult-agf-before-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu will consult the Attorney-General before giving assent to the state police bill.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/senate-sends-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-demands-operational-guidelines/) reported that Senator Akpabio stated the new policing structure could tackle 70% of insecurity.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/just-in-senate-directs-clerk-to-forward-state-police-bill-for-tinubus-assent/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/breaking-senate-directs-clerk-to-forward-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-for-assent/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/state-police-senate-completes-amendment-process-seeks-tinubus-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Senate directed its Clerk to forward the Constitution Amendment Bill to establish a State Police Service to President Bola Tinubu for assent.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/state-police-barau-praises-tinubu-as-senate-sends-bill-for-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin praised President Bola Tinubu as the Senate moved to transmit the bill.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/state-police-bill-clears-hurdle-as-tinubu-pushes-intelligence-led-security/) reported that Nigeria's proposed state police bill received unanimous backing from all 36 State Houses of Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/mental-health-tinubu-sends-bill-to-senate-seeking-decriminalisation-of-attempted-suicide/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/suicide-attempts-tinubu-sends-decriminalisation-bill-to-senate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-sends-bill-to-senate-to-decriminalise-attempted-suicide/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu sent the National Mental Health Amendment Bill 2026 to the Senate to decriminalise attempted suicide.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-introduces-nin-linked-verification-system-for-domestic-air-passengers/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/industry/1741858-fg-announces-airport-rules-airlines-december-deadline-meet-requirements/) reported that the Nigerian Federal Government introduced a biometric passenger verification system linked to the National Identification Number for domestic air travel.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/industry/1741858-fg-announces-airport-rules-airlines-december-deadline-meet-requirements/) reported that airlines were given until December 31, 2026, to adopt the V-Pass system to curb identity fraud.

On 16 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611160089.html), [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-state-police-bill-may-reach-tinubu-friday-ig-redeploys-15-officers-other-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that 32 state assemblies approved the State Police Bill, which is expected to reach President Tinubu this week.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/state-police-senate-sets-nov-17-deadline-for-four-states/) reported that the Nigerian Senate gave four remaining State Houses of Assembly until Tuesday to submit their reports on the proposed creation of state police.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/senate-to-transmit-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-this-week-bamidele/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/state-police-nass-to-transmit-bill-to-tinubu-this-week-senator-bamidele/) reported that Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele stated the National Assembly will transmit the State Police Bill to President Bola Tinubu this week.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-atiku-promises-to-end-insecurity-if-elected/) reported that presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar promised to end insecurity and revive the economy by providing affordable fuel and electricity and cutting taxes.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/senate-leader-to-nigerians-judge-national-assembly-by-impact-of-laws-not-number-of-bills-passed/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/925402-state-police-four-states-yet-to-transmit-resolutions-to-nass-senate-leader.html) reported that Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele stated that four states have yet to transmit resolutions on state police to the National Assembly, but their failure will not prevent further legislative processes.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/state-police-senate-sets-november-17-deadline-for-four-states/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741488-sstate-police-senate-sets-deadline-states/) reported that the Nigerian Senate set a November 17 deadline for four remaining state assemblies to submit reports on the proposed creation of state police.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-ill-restore-fuel-subsidy-tackle-insecurity-if-elected-atiku-vows/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-atiku-promises-to-restore-fuel-electricity-subsidies-if-elected/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar promised to restore fuel and electricity subsidies if elected president in the 2027 general elections.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741290-tinubus-convoy-presidency-reacts-alleged-attack-friday-prayers-abuja/) reported that the Nigerian presidency disputed a video shared by Dino Melaye alleging an attack on President Bola Tinubu's convoy in Abuja and released separate footage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-aide-dismisses-claims-of-convoy-stoning/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubus-aide-dismisses-reports-of-attack-on-presidential-convoy-in-abuja/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that O’tega Ogra, Senior Special Assistant to President Bola Tinubu, disputed and dismissed claims and misleading videos suggesting the president's convoy was attacked by youths in Abuja.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-fani-kayode-south-africa-clash-tinubu-aide-denies-convoy-attack-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported on top stories including a denial of an attack on Tinubu's convoy.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-orders-security-agencies-to-crush-political-thuggery/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Tinubu authorized security agencies to crush political thuggery and warned politicians against violence.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-orders-crackdown-on-thuggery-violence/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925036-2027-tinubu-orders-security-agencies-to-crack-down-on-political-thuggery.html) reported that Nigerian President Bola Tinubu ordered security agencies to crack down on political thuggery and violence ahead of the 2027 general elections.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010302/adiong-on-questions-to-vp-sara-s-tree-planting-link-with-cale88-don-t-be-onion-skinned/story/) reported that House prosecution spokesperson Zia Adiong responded to criticism from the Office of the Vice President regarding questions on tree planting.

On 21 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010288/ovp-tree-planting-campaign-not-associated-with-cale88-boi-compliance/story/) reported that the Office of the Vice President denied that its tree planting campaign is related to Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the Board of Investments.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010253/sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-day-45-cale88-seen-as-small-time-despite-millions-in-money-flows/story/) reported that the 45th day of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial began with the Senate impeachment court ordering OVP spokesperson Paolo Panelo to explain money flows related to Cale88.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010254/rodrigo-duterte-camp-asks-icc-to-reject-ex-davao-cop-s-prior-recorded-testimony/story/) reported that former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team asked the International Criminal Court to reject an ex-Davao City police officer's prior recorded testimony.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/defense-witness-cannot-explain-discrepancy-cale88-sales-cash-inflows/) reported that DTI Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo's testimony on Cale88 raises suspicions about the banana chips exporter's inward remittances from China.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926855-court-orders-removal-of-tukur-ribadu-as-adc-governorship-candidate.html) reported that a court ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC governorship candidate for Adamawa State and restrained him from parading himself as the candidate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-sacks-ribadu-declares-suleiman-adamawa-adc-governorship-candidate/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja removed Tukur Ribadu and declared Suleiman the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate for Adamawa State.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742472-breaking-drama-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate-in-adamawa/) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC Adamawa governorship candidate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-ndc-pdp-others-halt-campaigns-sign-common-agreement-nov-30/) reported that member parties of the Coalition for Democracy, including the African Democratic Congress, the Nigeria Democratic Congress, and a faction of the Peoples Democratic Party, agreed to halt campaigns and sign a common agreement on November 30.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/group-asks-inec-to-list-abidikugu-as-oyo-adc-reps-candidate/) reported that an African Democratic Congress support group urged INEC to implement a judgment regarding the Oyo ADC Reps candidate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adc-crisis-deepens-as-bot-orders-atiku-others-to-halt-campaigns/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Board of Trustees aligned with Nafiu Bala Gombe demanded that Atiku and others halt campaigns.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742326-court-sacks-atiku-inec-announces-final-decision-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC has disclosed when it will take a final decision on the leadership crisis rocking the ADC.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-crisis-bot-faction-asks-inec-to-delist-mark-candidates/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nafiu Gombe-led ADC Board of Trustees faction urged INEC to enforce a Federal High Court judgment and delist uploaded candidates.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubus-interview-with-us-strategist-london-sparks-debate-over-access-to-nigerian-media/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's decision to grant an exclusive interview to American political strategist Diana London has triggered public debate over access to Nigerian media.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fresh-scandal-rocks-tinubus-us-lobbying-team-as-interviewers-2018-theft-conviction-emerges/) reported that questions have emerged regarding the professional background of individuals involved in President Bola Tinubu's American lobbying campaign following revelations about an interviewer's past.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/diana-london-tinubu-should-grant-interviews-to-nigerian-journalists-osinbajos-ex-aide/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-should-grant-interviews-to-nigerian-journalists-akande-says/) reported that Laolu Akande, a former spokesman for ex-Vice-President Yemi Osinbajo, urged President Bola Tinubu to grant interviews to Nigerian journalists.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-contest-a-family-civil-war-lamido/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Sule Lamido stated that the 2027 presidential contest between Tinubu, Atiku, and Obi is a family civil war because the three share similar political backgrounds.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndume-accuses-politicians-of-using-poor-youths-for-political-violence/) reported that Senator Ali Ndume accused politicians of exploiting poor youths to perpetrate political violence ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-why-atiku-is-still-adc-candidate-despite-court-order-inec/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission explained why former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar remains listed on its website as the ADC candidate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/adc-pcc-seeks-postponement-of-inec-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise/) reported that the ADC-PCC sought the postponement of the INEC November 28 mock accreditation exercise, accused the commission of bias, and raised concerns over short notice.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndume-warns-political-violence-could-threaten-nigerias-elections/) reported that Senator Ali Ndume warned that rising political violence and intolerance could threaten Nigeria's 2027 general elections.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rising-political-violence-could-threaten-2027-elections-ndume/) reported that Senator Ndume proposed the establishment of special courts to handle electoral violence cases.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-to-tinubu-tell-nigerians-if-recorded-interview-was-part-of-4-5m-lobbying-deal/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded to know whether President Bola Tinubu's recorded interview was part of a $4.5 million lobbying deal.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/diana-london-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview-as-atiku-demands-full-disclosure/) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving $4.5 million from the Nigerian government.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-in-us-lobbying-controversies/) reported that a widening row over American lobbying activities embroiled President Bola Tinubu, Atiku Abubakar, and Peter Obi.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-strategist-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving 4.5 million dollars from the Nigerian government or anyone else in the country.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-strategist-restricts-x-comments-after-tinubu-interview-backlash/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/american-strategist-restricts-x-comment-after-backlash-over-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London restricted access to comments on her X account and deleted posts praising the Nigeria-US security partnership following backlash over her interview with President Bola Tinubu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/american-strategist-deletes-posts-on-tinubu-nigeria-us-security-ties/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/american-strategist-deletes-posts-on-tinubu-nigeria-us-security-partnership/) reported that American political strategist Diana London deleted her social media posts regarding her engagement with the Nigerian government and security ties.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nigeria-is-uss-greatest-ally-in-africa-american-strategist-says-as-tinubu-grants-interview-to-london/) reported that American political strategist Diana London described Nigeria as the United States' greatest ally in Africa.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-tinubu-grants-interview-to-american-political-strategist-diana-london/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu granted an exclusive interview to American political strategist Diana London.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-asks-inec-to-postpone-mock-accreditation-faults-irev-plan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-faults-inec-over-short-notice-for-mock-accreditation-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/adc-pcc-demands-postponement-of-inecs-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise-alleges-bias/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council asked the Independent National Electoral Commission to postpone its mock accreditation exercise, citing short notice and alleging bias.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742114-2027-election-inec-takes-decision-retaining-atiku-final-list-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC provisionally retained Atiku Abubakar on the final presidential candidate list amid the ADC leadership crisis.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-campaign-accuses-inec-of-bias-demands-postponement-of-mock-election-test/) reported that the ADC campaign accused INEC of bias and demanded the postponement of a mock election test.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742124-peter-obi-tinubu-atiku-tertiary-institution-students-announce-preferred-presidential-candidate/) reported that students across tertiary institutions in a Nigerian state disclosed the presidential candidate they intend to support in the 2027 elections.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926007-adc-challenges-judgement-on-leadership-crisis-seeks-injunction-against-inec.html) reported that the ADC challenged a judgment regarding its leadership crisis and is seeking an injunction against INEC.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-seeks-injunction-against-inec-changing-party-records/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-asks-court-to-stop-inec-from-altering-party-candidates-records/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the African Democratic Congress asked the Court of Appeal to restrain the Independent National Electoral Commission from altering party and candidate records.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/i-have-resumed-as-adc-chairman-nafiu-bala-says/) reported that factional African Democratic Congress National Chairman Hon. Nafi'u Bala Gombe notified the Independent National Electoral Commission of his resumption.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/senate-orders-probe-of-attacks-on-tinubu-obi-atiku/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-elections-senate-moves-against-rising-political-violence-orders-probe-of-attacks-on-political-leaders-supporters/) reported that the Nigerian Senate ordered security agencies to investigate attacks on political leaders and supporters ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741898-2027-elections-coalition-raises-alarm-rising-political-violence-nigeria/) reported that a civil society coalition gave major political parties a 48-hour warning over rising political violence.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741909-tinbubu-atiku-peter-obi-delta-born-millionaire-announces-preferred-presidential-candidate/) reported that Amaju Pinnick disclosed his preferred presidential candidate for the 2027 general elections.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-adc-dismisses-leadership-change-claims/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Jigawa State chapter of the African Democratic Congress dismissed rumors of a leadership change and reaffirmed Sani MuhdGumel as its chairman.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/jigawa-adc-passes-vote-of-confidence-in-state-chairman-27-lg-bosses/) reported that the Jigawa ADC passed a vote of confidence in the state chairman and 27 local government bosses while reaffirming its commitment to the leadership of presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925407-2027-jigawa-adc-backs-atiku-passes-vote-of-confidence-in-state-leadership.html) reported that the Jigawa ADC backed Atiku and passed a vote of confidence in state leadership during a gathering led by governorship candidate Sabo Nakudu.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-amaechi-alleges-efcc-plot-to-arrest-him-accuses-agency-of-targeting-adc/) reported that former Rivers State governor Amaechi alleged an EFCC plot to arrest him and accused the agency of targeting the ADC.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741653-2027-election-atiku-accuses-tinubu-presidency-using-ai-fabricate-rally-crowds/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/atiku-mocks-presidency-over-alleged-ai-generated-rally-crowds/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar accused President Bola Tinubu's presidency of using artificial intelligence to fabricate rally crowds.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010019/tech-outages-attributed-to-rapid-software-patching-us-officials-experts/story/) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated software patching efforts are sometimes creating short-term disruptions.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/faa-sean-duffy-flight-stoppage) reported that the head of the Federal Aviation Administration urged people to blame him rather than Sean Duffy for the flight stoppage.

On 18 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crkgvxxwpwz2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there was zero evidence supporting online theories that recent technical disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks, and flights are connected.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/zero-evidence-recent-tech-outages-linked-marco-rubio), [Punch](https://punchng.com/no-evidence-of-coordinated-cyberattack-behind-us-outages-rubio/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is zero evidence linking the recent technical disruptions and outages to any coordinated cyberattack or malign actor.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/rubio-rules-out-cyberattacks-or-links-between-tech-outages?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is no evidence linking technical outages to each other or to cyberattacks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941144) reported that technology outages shut down email for many companies and grounded thousands of flights over several days before extending to the US government.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/US-transportation-secretary-refuses-to-apologize-for-FAA-ground-stop-1S6PigDFnPy/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-flight-disruptions-may-continue-until-monday-trump-administration/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/us-aviation-crisis-flight-cancellations-may-continue-until-monday/) reported that the Trump administration stated flight disruptions and cancellations across the United States caused by a system upgrade failure may continue until Monday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/trump-atribui-falha-no-controle-aereo-dos-eua-a-gestao-biden-e-cobra-recursos-do-congresso.ghtml) reported that US President Donald Trump commented on the telecommunications interruption in the air traffic control system.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914962) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced investigators determined a contractor's error or faulty router caused the disruption.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-biden-flight-delays-cancellations-faa-b3085211.html) reported that transportation secretary Sean Duffy blamed a defense contractor for Saturday flight cancellations exceeding 6,000.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/trump-blames-biden-for-us-flight-disruptions/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former US President Donald Trump blamed Joe Biden's administration for the nationwide ground stop that disrupted travel.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-urge-al-congreso-aprobar-mas-fondos-para-modernizar-el-sistema-aereo-de-ee-uu_0_CbBJD7DqKM.html), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7322603-trump-cobra-congresso-por-verbas-para-modernizar-sistema-de-aviacao.html) reported that Donald Trump urged Congress to approve urgent funding to modernize the US air traffic control system following massive flight suspensions caused by technical failures.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-culpa-al-gobierno-de-biden-por-paralizacion-de-los-vuelos-reportan-mas-de-16-mil-vuelos-cancelados/) reported that Donald Trump blamed the Biden government for the suspension of flights following cancellation reports.

On 15 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/se-normalizan-los-vuelos-en-estados-unidos-y-trump-culpa-a-biden-por-la-paralizacion-nid15112026/) reported that flights normalized in the United States after over 18,000 flights were affected across the territory between Friday and Saturday.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/el-fbi-investiga-si-una-actualizacion-de-software-causo-la-falla-que-afecto-al-trafico-aereo-en-estados-unidos-segun-bloomberg-3600982) reported that the FBI is investigating whether a software update caused the failure affecting air traffic in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/fallo-mantenimiento-rutina-causo-mayor-caos-aereo-estados-unidosun-fallo-sistema-augura-miles-cancelaciones_202611146af8975dd3bddc0868b1d65c.html) reported that the White House stated a system failure occurred during routine maintenance while replacing old copper wiring with fiber optics.
