reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/periodista-colombiana-estefany-rodriguez-quien-estuvo-16-dias-detenida-por-ice-en-estados-unidos-recibio-premio-internacional-del-cpj-en-nueva-york-3602665) reported that Colombian journalist Estefany Rodríguez received an international CPJ award in New York after being detained for 16 days by ICE.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/kirsten-davies-llega-a-la-direccion-nacional-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallas-en-eeuu-nid20112026/) reported that Kirsten Davies will replace Sean Cairncross as national cybersecurity director following failures affecting services in the United States.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-dejara-su-cargo-en-medio-de-fallas-tecnologicas-que-afectaron-a-empresas-y-agencias-de-estados-unidos-3602610) reported that Kirsten Davies will assume the national cybersecurity directorship following her appointment by Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/casa-blanca-despide-al-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallos-tecnologicos-33221131) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the appointment of Kirsten Davies.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-despido-del-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-tras-serie-de-fallas-tecnologicas-kirsten-davies-asume-sus-funciones/) reported that the removal of Sean Cairncross follows disruptions affecting air traffic, automated teller machines, emails, and alert services.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/avion-hercules-c130-colombia-estados-unidos-fuerza-aerea-donacion-fac-1019-BH43770166) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delivered a C-130 Hercules aircraft to Colombia, restoring its fleet to six such planes.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/captura-trillizos-colombianos-ee-uu-ice-advierte-tener-solicitud-pendiente-no-da-estatus-legal-FD43738904) reported that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement issued a warning after detaining 19-year-old Colombian triplets, stating that a pending application grants no legal status.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/esta-es-la-enfermedad-que-padece-la-mama-de-los-trillizos-colombianos-detenidos-por-ice-en-ee-uu-fue-sometida-a-una-cirugia-y-esta-en-recuperacion-3602082) reported that family testimony indicated the 19-year-old individuals arrived in the United States to provide financial support for their recovering mother.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/que-hay-detras-de-la-inquietante-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-nid18112026/) reported that a succession of technology disruptions in airlines, banks, and intelligence networks exposed digital vulnerabilities in the United States.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/marco-rubio-hablo-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-y-descarto-interferencia-extranjera-no-estamos-bajo-un-ataque-cibernetico-3601898) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that technology outages affecting Microsoft, Chase, airlines, and the NSA were unrelated and not caused by a foreign cyberattack.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/la-caida-de-la-red-secreta-de-la-nsa-se-suma-a-una-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-coincidencia-o-amenaza-cibernetica-3601808) reported that disruptions in bank and technology platform services coincided with cyberattacks affecting approximately 200 websites.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-hit-sudden-system-outage/) reported that United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that left planes unable to take off.
On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219263) reported that a major outage hit United Airlines affecting a system related to flight departures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/drama-na-americkim-aerodromima-pao-sistem-united-airlinesa/npgmhe1) reported that United Airlines confirmed a system failure occurred on Monday afternoon.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/jpmorgan-chase-atribuye-los-fallos-a-un-error-de-software-y-descarta-un-ciberataque-33166828) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed banking service outages affecting thousands of customers to a software error and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/united-airlines-reporta-interrupcion-generalizada-sus-sistemas_202611176afb8b9903bbf30bb04e2f1a.html) reported that United Airlines experienced a widespread system disruption in the United States attributed to instability in communications and radar systems.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/united-airlines-restablece-sistema-tras-falla-tecnologica-interrupcion-provoco-retrasos-en-vuelos/) reported that on November 13 the FAA ordered flights to remain on the ground because a new router failed and saturated the system.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-system-outage) reported that United Airlines acknowledged a technology issue that delayed flight departures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

On 16 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/united-airlines-reports-widespread-outage-just-days-after-nationwide-ground-stop/CHU2RQYJERCJNHQAEB4INTZEGY/) reported that old network equipment was overloaded, disrupting 17 of 22 major control centres.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-915107) reported that there was no indication that United's outage was connected to the Federal Aviation Administration shutdown.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-recupera-la-normalidad-aerea-tras-miles-de-cancelaciones-y-una-falla-en-el-sistema-de-nid16112026/) reported that more than 18,000 flights were canceled and 28,000 suffered delays over three days due to an FAA router issue before normal operations resumed.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/estados-unidos-united-airlines-reporta-falla-generalizada-sistemas_0_H77eHnDPQG.html) reported that United Airlines reported a generalized failure in its systems days after the national flight suspension.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/sitios-de-bancos-en-eeuu-presentan-fallos-pero-no-hay-ciberataque-segun-jpmorgan-chase_0_gtsuRx0yIe.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase stated there was no ciberattack despite users reporting banking app failures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/bancos-de-eu-reportan-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that Zelle also registered interruptions in its transfer services alongside bank platform issues.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-desploman-las-acciones-de-grandes-bancos-en-wall-street-tras-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-en-estados-unidos-3601471) reported that shares of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Capital One registered losses on Wall Street following digital platform failures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aeroportos-dos-eua-comecam-a-voltar-a-normalidade-apos-caos-aereo-mas-ainda-ha-atrasos.shtml) reported that the US aviation sector began returning to normality following three days of cancellations and delays caused by a system outage.

On 15 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/voos-nos-eua-devem-ser-normalizados-ate-o-fim-de-domingo-promete-faa-passageiros-ainda-devem-enfrentar-transtornos.ghtml) reported that the FAA administrator promised US flights would be normalized by Sunday evening.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/caos-nos-eua-mais-de-12-mil-voos-foram-cancelados-entre-sexta-feira-e-sabado.ghtml) reported that official FlightAware data showed more than 12,000 flights were cancelled between Friday and Saturday in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/troca-de-cabos-causou-suspensao-que-cancelou-mais-de-16-mil-voos-nos-eua.shtml) reported that a cable swap caused a suspension that cancelled more than 16,000 flights in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7322457-anac-sete-voos-previstos-para-os-eua-foram-cancelados-e-14-atrasaram.html) reported that the head of the US Federal Aviation Administration forecasted between 4,000 and 5,000 flight cancellations on Saturday.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/business/economy-finance/2026-11-21/ty-article/.premium/israeli-banks-fear-sanctions-are-closing-in-netanyahu-looks-away/000001a1-f967-d381-ade5-fbe7269d0000) reported that Israeli banks fear sanctions targeting settlement construction could spread to the wider economy.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-netanyahu-using-iran-threat-to-obstruct-eisenkot-government-bid-israeli-analysts-say/) reported that Israeli analysts stated Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is seeking to use the Iranian threat to push for another war to obstruct Gadi Eisenkot’s government bid.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-19/ty-article-magazine/.premium/the-great-undo-why-the-new-knesset-is-racing-to-dismantle-netanyahus-coup-laws/000001a1-f447-dad7-a9fd-f64fc6130000) reported that the new Knesset majority is moving to undo laws that weakened courts, the attorney general, and the media.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-israeli-knesset-approves-9-deputy-speakers-including-2-arab-lawmakers/) reported that the Israeli Knesset approved the appointment of nine deputy speakers, including two Arab lawmakers.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/jerusalem-daily-chaos-in-the-knesset-as-new-speaker-elected?traffic_source=rss) reported chaos in the Knesset as a new speaker was elected and the Israeli army beat a journalist near Jericho.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-elects-matan-kahana-new-knesset-speaker) reported that the Israeli opposition elected Matan Kahana as new Knesset speaker following a deadlocked general election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374954/israels-parliament-moves-roll-back-netanyahus-divisive-legacy) reported that Israel's parliament met under a new speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc as opponents began a legislative rollback of his legacy.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/netanyahu-seeks-to-appoint-ex-knesset-speaker-as-minister-against-legal-advice/000001a1-edf1-d165-a7bd-fdffd6bf0000) reported that despite legal advice from the deputy attorney general regarding Supreme Court rulings on caretaker governments, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to appoint the outgoing Knesset speaker as a minister.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915294) reported that the Israeli Knesset advanced bills repealing judicial overhaul laws while supported by a parliamentary majority that includes Arab parties.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-as-new-knesset-speaker/), [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/israels-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-weakening-netanyahus-grip-on-power/) reported that the Israeli Knesset elected a new speaker backed by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's opponents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/with-new-speaker-elected-eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-repeal-judicial-overhaul-laws/000001a1-edc2-dd16-adbf-edc2b2990000) reported that the Arrangements Committee approved fast-tracking bills to reverse political control over judicial appointments.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPZ0FvY0VGYXV2RkxSOFMxOENQVF85Mkt5SjZUUXFQS0VuZGpBZjBRbmxnNkVMNWVuRXFOa3lpY09XaE9HNk00UjYtVXJURmtTZGpyaEhEajVoUjh6bGZYbFRzd2NTQUVNd2ExdGFBbkdyXzhnOFZoWjNuRGtuTWpLMmU0U0FrdE40aEtTRnZtZTY5WWRJbFV2UUZXMzI3ZTZSVzFKNDZhYkpYc2hmd3Y2Yg?oc=5) reported that the Israeli parliament elected a speaker backed by Netanyahu opponents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israeli-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-backed-by-netanyahus-opponents/article71714379.ece) reported that the Israeli parliament elected Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, as the new Knesset Speaker.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-elected-israeli-parliament-speaker-in-setback-for-netanyahu-101794952478403.html) reported that Matan Kahana secured 66 votes in the 120-member Knesset.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/eisenkot-ally-elected-knesset-speaker-with-arab-blocs-backing?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker with support from Arab parties.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-rejects-likud-request-to-bar-arab-parties-from-knesset-leadership-role/000001a1-ea29-d9ff-a7b5-fbafd0bb0000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot rejected demands to bar Arab lawmakers from Knesset leadership roles ahead of a vote to replace the current Likud speaker.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/who-matan-kahana-israels-new-knesset-speaker) reported that Matan Kahana's election gives the opposition control of the Knesset's legislative agenda.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/who-is-matan-kahana-poised-to-be-israels-next-knesset-speaker/000001a1-e99c-d848-abeb-fb9c8f3e0000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's ally Matan Kahana has expressed a pragmatic view about ending the war in Gaza while taking a hard line on West Bank settlements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/major-setbacks-for-netanyahu-ahead-of-vote-to-name-new-knesset-speaker) reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party repeatedly claimed Israel's October 27 election was stolen by Arab-led parties.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israels-parliament-set-to-select-new-speaker-opposed-to-netanyahu-3725693) reported that Israel's parliament is set to select Matan Kahana as Knesset speaker as Likud resists.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261117-%F0%9F%94%B4-israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-speaker), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/middleeast/israel-opposition-selects-parliamentary-speaker.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915242) reported that Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker by a vote of 66 to 52.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-israeli-knesset-opens-session-to-elect-new-speaker-amid-government-deadlock/) reported that Israel's parliament opened a session to elect a new speaker to succeed Likud's Amir Ohana amid uncertainty over forming the next government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915171) reported that Shas and United Torah Judaism announced they would back Ofir Katz against Kahana in the Knesset speaker vote.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915387) reported that ahead of meetings with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump warned of possible Iranian unconventional weapons threats.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-17/ty-article/iran-developing-plans-for-dirty-bomb-or-chemical-attack-in-d-c-report-says/000001a1-e8c8-d848-abeb-fac893430000) reported that according to CNN, US officials stated there was no evidence Tehran had decided to carry out an attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-intelligence-says-iran-explored-dirty-bomb-chemical-attack-scenarios-targeting-trump-officials-report-101794873460122.html) reported that new US intelligence prompted contingency planning in Washington, though the White House stated there are currently no credible threats to the US homeland.

stories.title: Rwanda: Rwanda, Five EU Countries Announce Migration Partnership

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261117-five-eu-member-states-open-talks-with-rwanda-on-deportation-centre) reported that Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece are jointly spearheading a project to open talks with Rwanda on a deportation centre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/436787/rwanda-migrant-deportation-centre-what-we-know-about-europes-five-nation-plan/) reported that the plan involves an open welcome centre, residence permits, and a path into Rwandan society, though NGOs expressed fears.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/migration-partnership-with-rwanda-sparks-eu-backlash-over-human-rights-record) reported that Rwanda's interior minister rejected criticism regarding the country's human rights record as it prepares to host the first EU return hubs outside the bloc.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seekers-migrants-eu-uk-b3086442.html) reported that Rwanda's interior minister positioned the East African nation as a welcoming country for refugees and migrants.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-5-european-countries-aim-to-send-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648950-eu-states-seek-deport-asylum-seekers-rwanda/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that five European countries announced plans to establish a return hub in Rwanda starting in 2027 to send rejected asylum seekers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

On 17 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

On 16 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.
On 16 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90286) reported that Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen defended the plan.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cinq-pays-de-l-union-europeenne-devoilent-leur-projet-de-centre-pour-migrants-au-rwanda-20261116) reported that the project aims to facilitate the return of individuals whose asylum applications were rejected or who lack the right to stay in the European Union.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1116/1599373-eu-migrant-hub-deal/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/5-eu-nations-present-plan-for-1st-migrant-return-hub-in-rwanda) reported that five EU nations presented a plan alongside Rwandan officials to establish the first migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-unveil-rwanda-deportation-plan-in-migration-crackdown), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/5-countries-announce-plan-to-deport-failed-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands aim to begin deporting rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda in 2027.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1741658-5-eu-countries-plan-open-migrant-deportation-centre-rwanda-2027/) reported that rights groups raised concerns over detention and DR Congo.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-to-announce-first-ever-return-hub-for-migrants-in-rwanda), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261116-eu-nations-to-unveil-rwanda-deal-for-migrant-return-hub) reported that Denmark, Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece are set to announce a deal to establish a migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seeker-deportation-eu-scheme-b3085455.html) reported that two lawmakers were shown facilities earmarked for Britain's abandoned Rwanda scheme.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/politics/article/3375298/trump-replaces-us-cyber-chief-after-outages-hit-flights-banks-and-nsa) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump appointed the Pentagon's chief information officer as the new cyber chief following major outages.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/11/20/pentagon-cio-replaces-white-house-national-cyber-director-after-tech-outages/) reported that Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies will temporarily replace fired White House national cyber director Sean Cairncross.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/20/trump-sean-cairncross-fired-resigned/) reported that Donald Trump did not think fired US cyber director Sean Cairncross was good enough.
On 20 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k3nn5p5mo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the White House removed the cybersecurity chief after a series of tech outages.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/white-house-cyber-chief-kirsten-davies-b3088470.html) reported that the White House appointed Kirsten Davies as the new cyber chief following widespread outages that disrupted air travel, banking, and other critical services.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/20/us-national-cyber-director-ousted-following-wave-of-tech-outages/) reported that the US national cyber director was ousted following a wave of tech outages.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/who-is-kirsten-davies-white-house-names-new-us-cyber-chief-after-cairncross-exit/articleshow/136011523.cms) reported that the White House named Kirsten Davies as the new US cyber chief following the exit of Cairncross.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOR1gxYnBpX3A3aDBXNVlpS3dkeUVsZHdQYTdYMjFCMDc5R21mYnhvdEVUNWZxS0poMlAxSm5TbnRMeUg3dmQ4S1M0NnNwN25ocms4VzhqQnhKYnhYcFlod2doeGdTSHdTc1B5cmZTbmY5UTdZRzhHdEU0bTRlbkF2Z0NlMUR3UEpBaTRzTlpRVUVHT3BkWEZMcjFrLXAxdV93MERLdXNwVlI?oc=5) reported that the White House tapped Kirsten Davies as cyber chief following outages.

On 20 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBsMjNHamI1VDZnYjRudmN1X2s5cHlQeGEwTDdMTTFpVUlrR2xzWm5DaTVheWNKQzZpTENJYjlKa2lEU3ZCR1pZd21sVVZHQnJGcDdVUHJTM2dNLUFUay1OUjZtbHpNVE5POEprYUxuMERrMk9URTJldGc2bHg?oc=5) reported that Kirsten A. Davies replaced Sean Cairncross as White House national cyber director.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/white-house-replaces-cyber-security-chief-after-tech-outages/a-79998531?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/white-house-fires-cybersecurity-chief-after-widespread-outages/article71722952.ece) reported that current Defense Department Chief Information Officer Kirsten Davies will fill the national cyber director role in an acting capacity.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/white-house-replaces-cybersecurity-official-after-tech-outages-101795143948994.html) reported that Sean Cairncross had helped spearhead the Trump administration's AI policy amid new cyber threats.

On 20 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/us/politics/white-house-cyber-director-departs.html) reported that top White House cybersecurity official Sean Cairncross stepped down following a series of technological outages affecting U.S. companies and federal agencies.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cyber-director-sean-cairncross-quits-leaving-job-b3088339.html) reported that White House national cyber director Sean Cairncross was fired following a series of technical outages affecting airlines, banking, and national security.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/19/white-house-cyber-director-ousted) reported that Department of Defense official Kirsten Davies will take over the position.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Defense One](https://www.defenseone.com/policy/2026/11/pentagon-cio-replaces-white-house-cyber-director-sean-cairncross-major-shakeup/417359/) reported that Sean Cairncross is to be replaced by the Pentagon's CIO.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/markwayne-mullin-tech-outages-white-house-b3087329.html) reported that Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin's statement attributing technology outages to artificial intelligence met with incredulity in the West Wing.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/17/former-press-secretary-karoline-leavitt-tells-administration-upfront/), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/transparency-is-key-ex-white-house-press-secretary-karoline-leavitt-urges-trump-team-to-address-us-tech-outages/articleshow/135959217.cms) reported that former press secretary Karoline Leavitt told the administration to be upfront with Americans about ongoing tech outages.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/18/novo-chefe-de-gabinete-de-trump-linha-dura-stephen-miller-cobra-mexico-por-fronteira-zero-mesmo-com-travessias-em-minima-historica.ghtml) reported that White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller pressed Mexico for zero border crossings while illegal border crossings fell to their lowest level in decades.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/i-am-checking-my-bank-account-karoline-leavitt-says-trump-or-any-white-house-official-should-issue-a-statement-on-whats-exactly-going-on/articleshow/135931517.cms) reported that Karoline Leavitt stated that Donald Trump or any White House official should issue a statement on ongoing matters.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-addresses-bessent-lutnick-rift-amid-nvidia-china-chip-row-says-he-won-t-fire-commerce-secretary-101794842790660.html) reported that Donald Trump stated Howard Lutnick delayed restrictions on Singapore-based Megaspeed to avoid escalating tensions with Beijing.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fact-check-posts-falsely-claim-trump-top-white-house-officials-moved-to-bunker-amid-faa-outage-101794679770886.html) reported that officials ruled out cyberattacks or foul play regarding the FAA outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914863) reported that new White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller requires prior approval for lobbyist meetings on administration policy.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/inside-stephen-miller-s-frenetic-first-week-as-white-house-chief-of-staff-101794652829659.html) reported that Stephen Miller is moving to reshape the White House policymaking process during his first week as chief of staff.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/who-is-stephen-miller-the-wartime-consigliere-now-running-trump-s-white-house-20261114-p61d1l.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Stephen Miller, the architect of Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, is now serving as his chief of staff.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-considering-firing-white-house-cabinet-secretary-meghan-bauer-amid-post-midterm-reshuffle-report-101794570976572.html) reported that White House Cabinet Secretary Meghan Bauer reportedly faces departure amid a post-midterm reshuffle.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/espns-stephen-a-smith-speaks-out-amid-speculations-over-becoming-trumps-next-white-house-press-secretary-101794573985255.html) reported that Stephen A. Smith dismissed speculation about becoming White House press secretary after meeting with Donald Trump.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/stephen-millers-new-rule-on-white-house-staffers-meeting-lobbyists-work-for-the-people-of-the-nation-like-donald-trump-not-for-lobbyists/articleshow/135803346.cms) reported that Stephen Miller outlined a new rule requiring White House staffers to work for the nation rather than lobbyists.

On 13 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/politics/stephen-miller-memo-wiles.html) reported that the office of Stephen Miller outlined a new policy seeking to show independence from special interests following influence peddling claims.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/bijela-kuca-uvela-nova-pravila-nakon-skandala-sa-susie-wiles-sastanci-s-lobistima-samo-uz-odobrenje/261113021) reported that White House staff must now obtain prior approval from the legal counsel for meetings with registered lobbyists.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1087581/bijela-kuca-zavodi-red-medju-lobistima-bez-posebnog-odobrenja-nema-sastanaka-nova-pravila-i-za-dodikove-lobiste) reported that the new rules were introduced following the departure of Susie Wiles.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/operaciones-militares-conjuntas-estados-unidos-permiso-congreso-colombia-EN43827407) reported that Colombian Foreign Minister Omar Bula stated that the Congress of the Republic is the sole entity authorized to approve joint military operations with other countries on Colombian soil.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/secretario-de-defensa-de-eu-firma-acuerdo-sobre-ciberdefensa-con-el-gobierno-de-honduras-plantea-operaciones-militares-conjuntas/) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth signed a cyberdefense agreement with the government of Honduras and proposed joint military operations.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/on-the-same-page-hegseth-hails-us-ties-with-colombias-de-la-espriella?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth praised security cooperation with Colombia as the country joins the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/el-secretario-de-defensa-de-eeuu-visita-ecuador-y-honduras_0_Hu5jIajuuo.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is visiting Ecuador and Honduras after meetings in Colombia and Venezuela to discuss combating drug trafficking.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/19/hegseth-unveils-new-us-venezuela-military-deal?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth unveiled a new military deal with Venezuela.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-hegseth-makes-surprise-trip-to-venezuela-renews-military-cooperation) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Caracas and announced a resumption of military cooperation with Venezuela.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/hegseth-in-colombia-to-deepen-anti-drug-ties-after-surprise-venezuela-stopover) reported that Pete Hegseth is in Colombia to deepen anti-drug ties after a surprise Venezuela stopover, with Colombian Defense Minister Jorge Eduardo Mora stating the Pentagon chief would hand over a C-130 Hercules military aircraft.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-venezuela-sign-military-deal-as-trump-administration-seeks-closer-ties/articleshow/135975509.cms) reported that the United States established a new military partnership with Venezuela following the capture of Nicolás Maduro.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Estímulo](https://elestimulo.com/venezuela/2026-11-18/pete-hegseth-caracas/) reported that Pete Hegseth defended the operation capturing Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores during his visit to Caracas.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-gobierno-de-trump-refuerza-su-vinculo-con-delcy-rodriguez-con-un-acuerdo-militar-nid18112026/) reported that Pete Hegseth announced a joint training and intelligence exchange agreement in Caracas to counter common threats.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/secretario-de-defensa-de-ee-uu-llega-colombia-tras-visitar-venezuela) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth arrived in Colombia after visiting Venezuela.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/hegseth-alardea-captura-maduro-primera-visita-venezuela-secretario-defensa-ee-uu-decadas_1795043469) reported that Hegseth described the capture of Maduro as the most sophisticated military operation in history during a speech at the U.S. Embassy in Venezuela.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-18/us-defense-secretary-announces-agreement-with-venezuela-against-threats-from-foreign-actors.html), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/us-defence-secretary-announces-military-cooperation-in-surprise-caracas-visit) reported that acting President Delcy Rodríguez welcomed U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in Caracas.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-and-venezuela-agree-to-revive-military-cooperation-as-hegseth-lauds-interim-government-101795027915218.html) reported that Pete Hegseth's visit occurred amid uncertainty regarding Venezuela's political future.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/us-defence-secretary-announces-military-partnership-on-trip-to-venezuela?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a military partnership agreement with Venezuela involving joint training and intelligence sharing.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxONFk1RlZIUXh1dXlFVHVzSlh1YjVibG0wdV81RS1na0Ywc3p5MEhaOXB6YlREV3FFRzJpM1VhMFgzYnNLU3hvaXBXOUh4TkpXa01XYTRzS1o1R0VXcHhzZXc4ZkRZYUIxRVVpRXB6Zm9BRUNMQlE5aGFySVUzR2RpVmpsV1A2UFNSLTRITEZNVG5BdUlZ?oc=5) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is in Venezuela to meet interim leaders in the latest Cabinet visit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-and-venezuela-sign-a-deal-to-reestablish-military-ties-hegseth-says-on-visit-to-interim-leaders), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374965/us-and-venezuela-sign-deal-re-establish-military-ties-during-hegseth-visit) reported that the United States and Venezuela signed a deal to re-establish military ties, ranging from training to intelligence sharing, as announced by Pete Hegseth.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/hegseth-vai-a-caracas-e-eua-e-venezuela-anunciam-acordo-militar.shtml) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth visited Caracas and announced a military cooperation agreement with Venezuela.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/pete-hegseth-venezuela-nicolas-maduro-military) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used his visit to Venezuela to assert U.S. dominance and mention Maduro's capture by the U.S. military.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/venezuela-y-estados-unidos-reanudan-la-cooperacion-militar-33194700), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/ee-uu-retoma-la-cooperacion-militar-con-venezuela-para-llevar-a-cabo-reformas-profundas_0_zaXgjUOMzT.html) reported that Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodríguez received US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to resume military cooperation and address common threats.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-se-reune-con-delcy-rodriguez-en-caracas_0_BPhgudHrUA.html) reported that US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with provisional president Delcy Rodríguez in Caracas.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-18/el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-anuncia-un-acuerdo-de-defensa-con-venezuela-contra-amenazas-de-actores-extranjeros.html) reported that Pete Hegseth announced an agreement against threats from foreign actors.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/venezuela/ultima-hora-venezuela-y-estados-unidos-suscriben-acuerdo-de-cooperacion-militar-tras-visita-de-pete-hegseth-al-palacio-de-miraflores-3602058) reported that the military cooperation agreement was signed by Pete Hegseth and Venezuelan Defense Minister Gustavo González López.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/pete-hegseth-visita-colombia-avion-c-130-fuerza-publica-NB43718498) reported that U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth is arriving in Colombia to discuss military and security cooperation.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/que-viene-a-hacer-el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-a-colombia-FA43707471) reported that United States Secretary of War Pete Hegseth will arrive in Colombia on Wednesday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-llega-hoy-colombia) reported that one of the main points on the agenda during the US official's visit is the delivery of a C-130 Hercules aircraft.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461932/) reported that the director of the Ministry of Migration and Displaced branch in Anbar Governorate stated that 1430 displaced families from Jurf al-Sakhor are currently residing in informal settlements in the Bzeebiz camp.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203816/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1/), [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461886/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces announced the establishment of a controlling headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhor north of Babylon province, subordinate to the Federal Police forces command.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461856/) reported that energy police commenced procedures to secure oil pipeline bundles in the Jurf al-Nasr area. [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203815/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zeidi asked security forces entering Jurf al-Sakhor to exercise self-restraint.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kataib-hezbollah-faces-deadline-to-leave-iraqi-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kataib Hezbollah faces a deadline to leave an Iraqi stronghold.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461787/), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203784/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities opened a controlling headquarters in the Jurf al-Sakhr area north of Babylon province.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461830/) reported that security forces began implementing a plan to reorganize the security file in Jurf al-Sakhr.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461835/) reported that energy police commenced duties to secure the oil pipeline in Jurf al-Nasr.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203610/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D8%B6%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities initiated security procedures to reorganize military deployment in Jurf al-Sakhr north of Babylon province, with the Popular Mobilization Forces starting a troop rotation process.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/iraq-s-risky-standoff-the-state-vs-iran-allied-militias/a-79995757?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Iraqi security forces surrounded an area run by the Kataib Hezbollah militia in what onlookers described as a dangerous confrontation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461820/) reported that a spokesperson for Kataib Hezbollah confirmed the group's refusal to surrender its weapons or leave the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461813/) reported that Iraq's Ministry of Interior announced the participation of its security formations in redeployment arrangements in the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/iraq-reaches-compromise-with-kataib-hezbollah-over-armed-group-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iraq reached a compromise with Kataib Hezbollah to station forces including Popular Mobilisation Forces brigades in the armed group's stronghold.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/whats-behind-iraqs-standoff-kataib-hezbollah-militia) reported that the dispute over the Iran-backed group's presence in Jurf al-Sakhr tested Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi's efforts to rein in proxy groups.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/19/irgcs-esmail-qaani-holds-talks-with-kataib-hezbollah-as-showdown-with-iraqi-forces-averted/) reported that top IRGC commander Esmail Qaani held talks with Kataib Hezbollah while a showdown with Iraqi forces was averted.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461801/) reported that authorities arrested Ali Abdul Karim al-Moussawi, general manager of the Oil Pipelines Company, following judicial confessions regarding oil smuggling in Jurf al-Sakhar.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461733/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi directed joint forces to deploy to Jurf al-Sakhar as the deadline approaches.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203578/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%87%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%87-%D9%86%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B0-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that the Iraqi government is facing the Jurf al-Sakhar file between withdrawal deadlines and oil smuggling investigations through political settlement, military confrontation, or temporary containment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explainer-what-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-militia) reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made his riskiest move since coming to power six months ago, targeting Kataib Hezbollah.
On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915335) reported that pro-Iranian militias including Kataib Hezbollah enjoy a semi-official status in Iraq.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461639/) reported that Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi approved joint forces of the army, police, and Popular Mobilization Forces to take control of Jurf al-Sakhar.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461501/) reported that economic researcher Ahmed Hadhal warned of continuing structural imbalances in Iraq's public finances as current expenditures in the 2027 draft budget absorb oil revenues.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/top-irgc-commander-in-iraq-for-talks-amid-kataib-hezbollah-tensions?traffic_source=rss) reported that the head of Iran's IRGC Quds Force attended meetings in Iraq over alleged oil smuggling linked to pro-Iranian armed groups.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203449/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9/) reported that oil smuggling investigations in Jurf al-Sakhar led to broader Iraqi security measures and force deployments to assume security responsibility.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461590/) reported that Prime Minister Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani decided to enter the Jurf al-Sakhar area despite mediation efforts by Shiite leaders to dissuade him.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461464/) reported that Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Quds Force commander Brigadier General Esmail Qaani arrived in Baghdad at the head of an Iranian delegation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461488/) reported that political and security movements continue to contain tension regarding the Jurf al-Sakhar area north of Babylon while the government spoke of official security forces entering the area.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203350/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D8%AC%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B9-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%87%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%83%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%A8-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87/) reported that Iraqi Parliament Speaker Hebat Al-Halbousi chaired a committee meeting on the Jurf al-Sakhar area with the ministers of defense and interior and intelligence officials.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/iran-deploys-army-to-stronghold-of-iran-backed-kataib-hezbollah?traffic_source=rss), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/16/iraqs-al-zaidi-meets-top-judge-to-discuss-jurf-al-sakhar-oil-smuggling-case/) reported that Iraq deployed its army to the stronghold of Kataib Hezbollah amid US pressure and an oil-smuggling inquiry.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/iraqi-armed-group-denies-involvement-in-oil-smuggling-calls-probe-a-lie?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran-aligned Kataib Hezbollah denied involvement in oil smuggling and called the probe a lie and blackmail.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/iraqi-pms-crackdown-on-oil-smuggling-raises-tensions-with-kataib-hezbollah.php) reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al Zaidi launched an oil smuggling crackdown in Jurf al Sakhar, dismissing senior security figures and raising tensions with Kataib Hezbollah.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/iraqi-pm-escalates-jurf-al-sakhar-smuggling-crackdown-sacks-security-chiefs-and-refers-suspects-to-court/), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-armed-group-denies-accusation-oil-smuggling-1) reported that the Iraqi Prime Minister sacked nine provincial security chiefs and referred suspects to court in an oil smuggling crackdown.

stories.title: US Asked Trump-Putin-Xi Summit to Drop Ukraine Clause From ‘Peace Declaration,’ Stubb Says
stories.label: US, China, and Russia APEC summit meetings

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063799/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90722), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/ukraine-clause-dropped-from-trump-putin-and-xi-s-peace-declaration-at-u-s-request-finland-s-president-says) reported that Finnish President Alexander Stubb revealed a section on Ukraine was dropped from the Trump-Putin-Xi peace declaration at the request of the United States.

On 19 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-19/Full-text-China-Russia-US-Heads-of-State-Declaration-toward-Peace-1SczM9jzJII/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=China) reported the full text of the joint declaration toward peace issued by Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and US President Donald Trump following their summit.

On 20 Nov 2026, [IPS Latin America](https://www.ipsnews.net/2026/11/shenzhen-is-not-yalta-what-a-historic-china-us-russia-summit-can-and-cannot-achieve/) reported that the leaders of China, the United States, and Russia gathered in Shenzhen for their first-ever face-to-face trilateral summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/dialogo-para-evitar-proliferacion-de-armas-nucleares-acuerdan-xi-trump-y-putin) reported that Xi, Trump, and Putin agreed on dialogue to avoid nuclear weapons proliferation and to increase petroleum product production and supply.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/xi-trump-y-putin-acuerdan-declaracion-de-paz-en-su-historica-reunion-en-china-33209323) El Sol de México reported that the presidents of China, US, and Russia agreed on a peace declaration in China aiming to reduce nuclear risks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/misterioso-maletin-nuclear-acompano-a-putin-hasta-china-33212916) El Sol de México reported that a nuclear briefcase accompanied Vladimir Putin to China.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/asi-es-la-declaracion-de-paz-de-trump-xi-y-putin-que-dejo-fuera-las-guerras-de-ucrania-e-iran-33213399) El Sol de México reported that the four-point declaration proposed reforming the UN, increasing fuel supplies, and opening nuclear risk dialogues without addressing the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/donald-trump-vladimir-putin-y-xi-jinping-en-una-historica-cumbre-trilateral-desarme-nuclear-y-las-relaciones-comerciales-entre-los-temas-clave-3602258) reported that nuclear disarmament and commercial relations were among the key topics at the trilateral summit between Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-19/trump-y-putin-interactuan-en-shenzhen-antes-de-las-reuniones-con-xi.html) reported that Donald Trump met with the Russian leader for 40 minutes in a citation that was not on the agenda.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/china-us-russia-issue-declaration-toward-peace-after-first-summit) reported that China, the United States, and Russia issued a 'Declaration toward Peace' after their leaders held an unprecedented summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23961306) reported that China, Russia, and the United States will continue working-level coordination following the summit between Presidents Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Bijela-kuca-objavila-cetiri-kljucna-dogovora-Trampa-Putina-i-Sija-FOTO/993283), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/objavljena-cetiri-kljucna-dogovora-trumpa-putina-i-xija-nakon-sastanka/) reported that the White House published four key agreements reached by Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261118-%C3%A0-shenzhen-le-pr%C3%A9sident-russe-vladimir-poutine-s-affiche-au-centre-du-jeu-mondial) reported that Chinese, American, and Russian presidents held a meeting in Shenzhen.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/a-shenzhen-xi-jinping-s-affiche-en-pilier-d-un-nouvel-ordre-mondial-en-tutoyant-trump-et-en-menageant-poutine-20261119) reported that at the end of their meeting, the Chinese, American, and Russian presidents expressed commitment to peace and stability.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/geography-violence-distrust-hitting-dr-congo-ebola-fight-handicap-international-3013396) reported that Handicap International stated geography, violence, and distrust are three major challenges hampering efforts to quell the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/scientists-are-learning-more-about-the-rare-ebola-virus-in-congo-outbreak-3013248) reported that researchers gained insights into the rare Bundibugyo strain during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/congo-ebola-outbreak-africa-chidlren-b3088643.html) reported that more than 1,200 children under five contracted the rare Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261118-strain-specific-ebola-vaccines-to-be-trialled-in-drc-who-announces) reported that two vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain are set to enter trials in the outbreak's epicentre next week.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/11/18/congo-ebola-outbreak-budnibugyo-constitution-conflict-m23/) reported that six months in, the out of control Ebola outbreak shows no sign of slowing down.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/a-hunger-crisis-is-making-ebola-even-deadlier-101794971716235.html) reported that an Ebola outbreak sweeping East Africa is fueling a hunger crisis that increases the chances of death for infected individuals.

On 17 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168827) reported that the UN announced the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo more than doubled in three months, with over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths reported.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/ebola-congo-six-months-radio-children-b3086362.html) reported that children in DR Congo are sharing information on the airwaves to fight myths as the Ebola outbreak passes the six-month mark.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Barrick is furloughing some personnel at its Congo mine due to Ebola concerns.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/africa/congo-ebola-community-transmission.html) reported that health teams in eastern Congo struggle against fear and mistrust that drive fatal delays in seeking medical care during the Ebola outbreak.

On 17 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170097.html) reported that Africa's top public health agency warned that the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains out of control six months after it was declared.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Africa-CDC-warns-of-immense-challenges-over-fragile-Ebola-gains-1S7pjUCAWQ0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the Africa CDC warned of immense challenges over fragile Ebola gains as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces in the DR Congo with over 11,100 confirmed cases and more than 5,400 deaths.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ebola-who-declares-major-success-as-3000-recover-in-drc-early-outbreak-hotspots-contained/) reported that the World Health Organisation announced that 3,000 people recovered from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and that early outbreak hotspots were contained.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/congo-ebola-outbreak-biggest-in-history-crisis-armed-violence-hunger-healthcare-system-101794807183530.html) reported that over 11,000 people were infected and 5,500 died in Congo's Ebola outbreak, while hunger, armed violence and mistrust hamper control efforts.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/science-health/africa-ebola-outbreak-six-months/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak remains out of control due to problems including deadly attacks on health workers, unpaid staff, and a lack of resources.

On 15 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/african-union-warns-drc-ebola-could-cause-a-large-continental-outbreak/) reported that Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the humanitarian crisis and insecurity could cause a large continental Ebola outbreak.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-africa-cdc-says-ebola-outbreak-still-out-of-control-six-months-since-it-was/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak in Congo remains out of control six months after being declared.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ebola-outbreak-kills-over-5400-in-dr-congo-as-conflict-hampers-response/) reported that over 5,400 people died in an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/health-news/925381-ebola-drc-cases-surpass-11000-insecurity-hampers-response.html) reported that according to the WHO, an armed attack in Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians including three health workers and looted three health facilities.

On 15 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-international/20261115-ebola-l-absence-de-vaccin-explique-l-ampleur-de-cette-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-dit-jean-kaseya-africa-cdc) reported that Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya stated the lack of vaccines explains the scale of the epidemic.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ebola-outbreak-remains-out-of-control-in-congo-six-months-into-response/article71704179.ece) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks and remains out of control six months into the response.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-claims-nearly-half-of-infected-as-cases-cross-11000/articleshow/135849071.cms) reported that the outbreak has resulted in over 11,000 cases with high fatalities and inadequate basic health measures.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/15/ebola-outbreak-not-under-control-amid-dysfunctions-in-response-msf-warns/) reported that MSF warned the Ebola outbreak is not under control due to response dysfunctions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9GUWp5OWp5ZzEyOERaTnRzZ1kyQjRvOVkzR1FoNWxQUEwyY2NoM3JyOXB0LWJEQlBVVk92R2JST2VYaWQ0MjFzVm1tLUFvdHdJcXM2N3dac0JWd05namhJRmtuRFVzZFplTl9yNzF1RFp3RHZV?oc=5) reported that the UN hailed progress in the Ebola response while citing insecurity as the biggest challenge.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648807-drc-ebola-attacks-health-workers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Africa CDC stated deadly attacks on medical teams and facilities are disrupting efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-insecurity-in-eastern-drc-blocks-response-5668350) reported that insecurity in eastern DRC is blocking the Ebola response as deaths pass 5,300.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-spreads-into-rural-areas-of-drc-as-violence-hampers-response) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into remote rural communities.

On 13 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168797), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130262.html) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread amid repeated attacks on civilians and frontline health workers.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/attacks-on-health-workers-hamper-congo-ebola-fight-africa-cdc-warns-5669136) reported that the Africa CDC warned attacks on health workers are hampering the Ebola fight in Congo following an armed group attack in North Kivu that killed 66 people.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx98757ymm6zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training, and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies according to MSF.

On 12 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261112-funds-for-dr-congo-ebola-fight-not-reaching-front-french-medical-charity-msf-says) reported that six months into Congo's Ebola outbreak, the virus is still spreading out of control and large sums of international aid are not reaching the front line.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/21/jose-maria-neves-e-reeleito-presidente-de-cabo-verde-com-quase-64percent-dos-votos.ghtml) reported that Cape Verde's National Electoral Commission confirmed the re-election of President Jose Maria Neves for a second five-year term with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Cape-Verde-s-incumbent-president-declares-re-election-victory-1S7pTVdY97q/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that Cape Verde's incumbent president received 80,018 votes, or 63.8 percent, with nearly 97 percent of polling stations reporting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/victoire-du-president-sortant-au-cap-vert-ces-defis-qui-attendent-jose-maria-neves/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves was elected without surprise in the first round with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [AMAP (Mali)](https://amap.ml/2026/11/16/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-en-tete-avec-pres-de-64-des-voix/), [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/international/infos-afrique/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-reelu-pour-un-second-mandat/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves won re-election with 63.8 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNcWxnVEpfWXdSVkNERnExVXJGbFJzUW5MTFR3MEtGWHBYMFZWZkZHRldTal9oLS00VnJQdnM1MmNJVkhkRFlkVjJEYjVMLWo4Tk5xUzV1OG9Xa1BxYUdmZ3FSaVp5Q0htZGYwcFpZSFZCYnFrR0szX1FRRk1yNHcteXRWWkpvZkFvck5scnFydzRnME55WktPVngxTklNSWxwVUl5Z3B3TWJHZVQwNDY0NG5CbGNuNmphV0o4?oc=5), [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/cape-verde-president-neves-wins-second-term--5672296) reported that challenger Joana Rosa conceded defeat in the Cape Verde presidential election.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jos-maria-neves-re-elected-president-of-cape-verde-for-second-five-year-term-101794809266807.html) reported that José Maria Neves was re-elected for a second five-year term in a campaign focused on jobs for young people.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648895-cape-verde-president-wins-second-term/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that provisional results show Cape Verdean President Jose Maria Neves won a second presidential term.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261116-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-au-cap-vert-jos%C3%A9-mar%C3%ADa-neves-rempile-pour-un-second-mandat-de-cinq-ans) reported that provisional results from the presidential election in Cape Verde gave incumbent President Jose Maria Neves a victory for a second five-year term in the first round.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Istorijski-izbori-Zelenortska-Ostrva-dobijaju-prvu-predsjednicu/992509), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/zelenortska-ostrva-bi-mogla-dobiti-prvu-predsjednicu-od-nezavisnosti-1975/261115164) reported that presidential elections were held in Cape Verde, with former justice minister Joana Rosa running as a candidate to potentially become the first female head of state since independence in 1975.

On 15 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cape-verde-election-jose-maria-neves-set-to-win-second-term/a-79952606?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2026/11/16/au-cap-vert-jose-maria-neves-reelu-president-des-le-premier-tour_6811072_3212.html) reported that provisional results showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won a second term in office, winning over 63% of the vote in the first round.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/15/presidential-polls-open-in-cape-verde-with-first-female-candidate/) reported that presidential polls opened in Cape Verde with incumbent Jose Maria Neves favored to win a second term.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQUWI3OGxfWTRxVTVMY3diaEZFMWZmRlZGYnZ0dnJKSzZqYjN4U2xmMTIyMVJ4U3QxcnI1VEVSblhZck40NTZCaGVhamRFQ2l0VDZnNXhYLTRTRUNRSDNqVW9FQ2pHZXRfQzNQOUEzRG9vaU82Q094M2J0eGo4T3N3QWdadEVmQ3BJR3FPRGNHUXdmcWpWcWItVl9LVERRUQ?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election with emigration in focus.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNNEZaaVg2di1CeGcyQlpLZjBmeHpaYXQ5YTRGMk8xM0NyZkVtSmFuX2d1ckFqOExOMVhmbzk4U0lEYk96VVd3OENPVTd6bERTNTJDQl8tR3ZxS2JZX2xER3JfSHdCRF9JQkxLMm11bnFTYmN1LUN4R3lfRy15MmJsSS04VUEzX183SDFYSVFDaHJIaTJFT1VQeHljX2FFbkYwV0hmY1VB?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election that could yield its first woman president since independence in 1975.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/cabo-verde-polls-open-neves-favored-rosa-challenger/) reported that voting is underway in Cabo Verde with President José Maria Neves favored among six candidates, and a potential run-off scheduled for 29 November.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/cape-verde-heads-to-the-polls-in-presidential-election), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/polls-open-in-cape-verde-in-race-with-first-female-presidential-candidate?traffic_source=rss) reported that voters in Cape Verde went to the polls for a presidential election where incumbent President José Maria Neves faces opposition candidates including Joana Rosa.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261115-cape-verde-could-make-election-history-with-first-female-president), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cape-verde-could-elect-first-woman-president-since-gaining-independence-in-1975/article71704206.ece) reported that six candidates are competing in the presidential election, which could result in the nation's first female president.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-cape-verde-president-eyes-new-term-as-party-builds-on-legislative-win/) reported that Cape Verde President Jose Maria Neves is expected to win a second term in office.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/cape-verde-presidential-election-neves-seeks-second-term/) reported that the island nation off the coast of Senegal is regarded as one of Africa's strongest democracies.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/bienvenue-a-phnom-penh-why-cambodias-francophonie-summit-matters/) reported that political divisions overshadowed the 20th Francophonie summit hosted in Cambodia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261117-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-des-n%C3%A9gociations-tendues-et-des-r%C3%A9formes-en-attente) reported that leaders of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie prolonged discussions and postponed the election of the secretary-general due to a lack of agreement.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/cambodian-sins-overshadow-global-francophonie-summit-in-phnom-penh/) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron urged Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet to investigate the assassination of former Cambodian lawmaker Lim Kimya.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-afrique-midi/20261116-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-sur-le-fond-la-position-de-la-rdc-a-gagn%C3%A9) reported that regarding the postponement of the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie, the position of the DR Congo has gained ground.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-francophonie-summit-avoids-major-disaster-after-clash-over-leadership) reported that the Francophonie summit postponed the election of a new chief following a row between DR Congo and Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/dr-congo-rwanda-row-derails-francophone-summit-vote-6555176) reported that the DR Congo-Rwanda row derailed the vote for a new secretary general of the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie during talks in Phnom Penh.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/arts-et-culture/francophonie-lelection-du-secretaire-general-reportee-a-novembre-2027/) reported that the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie was postponed to November 2027.

On 15 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/15/a-phnom-penh-au-royaume-du-cambodge-la-tunisie-au-sommet-de-la-francophonie-aujourdhui/) reported that Dhia Khaled led the Tunisian delegation to the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/20e-sommet-de-la-francophonie-sur-fond-de-tensions-entre-kigali-et-kinshasa-une-gueguerre-qui-pourrait-couter-a-lafrique-le-poste-de-secretaire-general-de-linstitution/) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened on November 15, 2026, in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

On 15 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261115-tensions-and-economic-turbulence-in-cambodia-as-it-hosts-francophonie-summit) reported that the 20th Francophonie summit opened on November 15 in Phnom Penh amidst rising tensions with Thailand and declining tourism.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261115-francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-overshadowed-by-tensions-in-africa) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, overshadowed by a leadership dispute.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-amid-rwanda-dr-congo-rift?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Francophone summit opened in Cambodia amidst a clash between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda over leadership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/politics/francophone-summit-congo-rwanda/) reported that the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie summit opened with a Congo-Rwanda clash.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-leadership-as-francophone-summit-opens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a summit of French-speaking nations opened amid a clash between DR Congo and Rwanda over the organization's leadership, with DR Congo threatening to quit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85895265), [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/phnom-penh-accueille-la-48e-conference-ministerielle-de-la-francophonie/) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan will attend the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-vote/) reported that DR Congo stated it will consider dropping its Francophonie candidate while Rwanda refused, and spokesman Patrick Muyaya responded ahead of the leadership vote.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261114-dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-leadership-as-macron-seeks-compromise), [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophone-top-job/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that DR Congo and Rwanda clashed over the leadership of the Francophonie.
