reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/israel-block-aid-gaza-floods-rain-humanitarian-crisis-b3085824.html) reported that 150,000 tents continue to be denied entry into Gaza as the enclave faces flooding.

On 17 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168821) reported that winter rains are deepening the crisis in Gaza by flooding makeshift shelters, destroying scarce food supplies, and affecting displaced people.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249477/WHO-chief-urges-unrestricted-access-to-aid-in-Gaza), a state-media outlet, reported that World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated Palestinians in Gaza need unrestricted access to shelter materials and aid.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-german-foreign-minister-calls-on-israel-to-allow-more-aid-to-reach-gaza-before-winter/) reported that German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul called on Israel to allow significantly more humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip before winter.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eu-commissioner-calls-on-israel-to-ease-gaza-aid-restrictions-as-winter-deepens-crisis/) reported that European Commissioner Hadja Lahbib called on Israel to ease Gaza aid restrictions on more days as winter deepens the crisis.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/australia-uk-canada-italy-urge-israel-rapid-gaza-aid-access) reported that Australia, the UK, Canada, and Italy urged the Israeli government to immediately allow rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access throughout Gaza.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/gaza/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/israels-own-numbers-reveal-gaza-aid-deliveries-fell-far-short-of-commitments/000001a1-de03-d1ce-a9a3-fe1371dd0000) reported that IDF data obtained by Haaretz show that since March, the number of trucks entering Gaza has fallen short of the 18,000 monthly target under the cease-fire deal, with shortages in medical supplies and tents.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/australia-canada-italy-uk-urge-israel-to-allow-150000-tents-into-gaza-3725626), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/stop-the-delays-wong-counterparts-blast-israel-over-gaza-humanitarian-crisis-20261116-p61eeh.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the foreign ministers of Australia, Canada, Italy, and the United Kingdom issued a joint statement urging Israel to allow the immediate entry of 150,000 tents and vital aid into Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-16/el-reino-unido-australia-canada-e-italia-exigen-al-gobierno-de-israel-que-permita-la-entrada-de-ayuda-humanitaria-en-gaza.html) reported that the UK, Australia, Canada, and Italy demanded that the Israeli government allow the entry of humanitarian aid into Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/europe/2026/11/16/four-foreign-ministers-urge-israel-to-allow-rapid-and-unimpeded-aid-into-gaza/) reported that four foreign ministers urged Israel to allow rapid and unimpeded aid into Gaza.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/16/australia-uk-canada-italy-urge-israel-critical-aid-gaza-winter-ntwnfb), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/australia-canada-italy-and-the-uk-urge-israel-to-allow-aid-into-gaza?traffic_source=rss), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374519/australia-uk-canada-and-italy-urge-israel-allow-rapid-gaza-aid-access) reported that Australia, the UK, Canada, and Italy urged Israel to allow rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access and critical aid to Gaza.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/australia-canada-italia-y-reino-unido-instan-a-israel-a-permitir-acceso-rapido-de-ayuda-para-gaza-se-registran-5-muertos-por-lluvias/) reported that five deaths were registered due to rains and that the WHO stated 950,000 displaced people live under the risk of floods.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPNGxWWm5Ic0k3UVM0aE5GdmI3NXU3dWZRdXZTZThwTjg1OHNxdmtIcFVrc3BCdG9YZVlsRjYxYk1UR09FMzdGaGFybUU3WXMydVV3NTN3YkhvTXh1NW8xZjNmbWZBZGwwTlFOZGV5RlpqS3gxcEFpRkJGSUdBclhaYjhtV1JiZDBsc3NzeXFKTUQ2bmIwNDBNOGRfczBPYWNja0Z3bktZZTRqOXJSUFNwTVJBRThDcmt1ZWQ3QmpKal8tOW5yUkFIXw?oc=5) reported that the UN urged immediate winter aid deliveries to besieged Gaza.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/states-urge-israel-open-gaza-land-crossings-winter-hits) reported that at least 50 countries demanded that Israel open land crossings and allow urgent aid as winter approaches.
On 13 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168799) reported that humanitarians issued an urgent appeal for the swift entry of winter supplies into the Gaza Strip.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/13/a-group-of-53-countries-urge-israel-to-open-gaza-to-unrestricted-aid/) reported that a group of 53 countries urged Israel to open Gaza to unrestricted aid.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261112-53-countries-organizations-urge-israel-to-allow-rapid-humanitarian-access-to-gaza/), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86320364/53-countries-organizations-call-for-unrestricted-humanitarian), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/53-countries-urge-israel-to-open-gaza-access-3725512) reported that a group of 53 countries and organizations urged Israel to allow rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access to Gaza.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/15/prince-harry-ukraine-war-surprise-trip-invictus-games) reported that Prince Harry told Ukrainian soldiers they are going to win the war during a surprise trip to Lviv, where he met wounded veterans and said the country could one day host the Invictus Games.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/prince-harry-in-ukraine-meeting-invictus-2027-hopefuls?traffic_source=rss) reported that Prince Harry made his fourth visit to Ukraine to meet wounded veterans and Invictus 2027 hopefuls.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062969/) reported that Invictus Games founder Prince Harry visited Lviv to cheer on wounded Ukrainian service members in wheelchair rugby.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4184766-prince-harry-visits-lviv-for-first-superhumans-war-trauma-conference.html), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581860/prince-harry-visits-ukraine-for-war-trauma-conference/) reported that Prince Harry visited Lviv in Ukraine to participate in the first international Superhumans War Trauma Conference.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044577/creating-new-smaller-provinces-a-national-necessity-kamal), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581857/mustafa-kamal-says-referendum-will-decide-new-provinces/) reported that Federal Health Minister and MQM-P leader Syed Mustafa Kamal called the creation of smaller provinces a national necessity and stated a referendum would determine the decision.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89862223) reported that a jet-propelled drone repeatedly crossed the state border amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186943-moldova-reports-second-drone-incursion-into-its-airspace-in-one-day.html) reported that an unauthorized drone flight into Moldova's airspace was recorded twice on November 20.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89369445) reported that the Moldovan Ministry stated an unauthorized drone crossed Moldovan airspace for nine minutes overnight after entering from Ukraine's Vinnytsia region and exiting toward Chernivtsi.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88294566) reported that the General Police Inspection identified a drone that crashed in a forest strip near the village of Baxani in Soroca district as a Gerbera-2 model.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88188175) reported that an aircraft detected near Cuhurestii de Sus in northern Floresti district was identified as a Gerbera-2 model that exploded upon impact.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90394) reported that a Russian drone was spotted over the Moldovan capital of Chisinau.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063339/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185796-seven-drones-enter-moldovan-airspace.html) reported that seven drones entered Moldovan airspace on November 17, with some crashing near settlements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/moldova-closes-airspace-after-shahed-type-drone-detected-heading-towards-chisinau), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/7-drones-cross-into-moldovan-airspace-during-latest-russian-attack-against-ukraine-1-spotted-over-chisinau/) reported that Moldovan authorities and President Maia Sandu stated that several Russian drones violated Moldovan airspace.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87515748) reported that three flights from Yerevan, Istanbul, and Sharm El-Sheikh were unable to land in Chisinau due to the airspace closure.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063332/) reported that Moldova closed six border crossing points with Ukraine in Ocnița, Otaci, Unguri, Briceni, Grimăncăuți, and Clocușna.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-tightens-control-over-government-information-as-democrats-prepare-investigations-101795251875656.html) reported that Donald Trump issued an order to control information reaching Congress and limit Democratic investigations.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/new-leader-us-democrats-pledges-target-trump-corruption.1137326) reported that US House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries pledged to target Trump corruption.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10942704) reported that US Representative Robert Garcia sent letters to twelve of Donald Trump's top allies and former aides to investigate corruption and Epstein files.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90523), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063526/) reported that US House Republicans are seeking to strip Ukraine-related provisions and intelligence sharing from the National Defense Authorization Act.

On 18 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/politics/democrats-cast-investigative-net.html) reported that House Democrats preparing investigations into President Trump and his administration would focus on officials including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

On 18 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/us-democrats-nominate-hakeem-jeffries-to-be-first-black-house-speaker/FZUIGY57NBFHLPB4ARKRE67QME/) reported that Hakeem Jeffries secured 251 votes to become the new leader of US House Democrats.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/robert-garcia-trump-records-investigations) reported that incoming Democratic oversight chair Robert Garcia plans investigations into Trump family finances, Department of Homeland Security misconduct, and Epstein files.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/house-democrats-target-trump-family-senior-officials-as-oversight-investigations-loom-101795010718436.html) reported that Robert Garcia asked 13 people, including Trump Jr., Eric Trump, Jared Kushner, and JD Vance, to preserve records.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-17/record-revenues-over-60-deaths-and-little-oversight-democrats-target-trumps-immigration-jails.html) reported that lawmakers taking control of Congress in January stated there will be increased oversight of ICE detention centers.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/politics/congress-trump-investigations.html) reported that the Trump administration has been laying the groundwork to thwart newly empowered Democrats' attempts at oversight.

On 11 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/politics/trump-democrats-congress-oversight-committee.html) reported that the White House threatened Congress, stating that aggressive oversight investigations could be a crime.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/11/democrat-investigation-white-house-letter-garcia) reported that the incoming Democratic chair of the congressional committee responded that Trump has something to hide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062720/) reported that Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets stated that Kostiantynivka was not raised in talks on humanitarian missions.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/16/capital/035n2cap?partner=rss) reported that Morena in the Mexico City Congress will correct the fair rent initiative sent by the head of government to maintain certain rights.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQeGJEcXlMZEdyc2NNa1BnTXdNZVU1Mkp5ZzJEODlCS3FKd003Z0d5WmtTV05lRnB6b0hYVldhR1hDeXhxUHM3c3BSN1l4RnNhanFhYndZYjQ0cGxxaTF0Z194NldTbTk1NWc3VDkwODIybDI5ZVRxNVRRSlQzMFEtLXpBbXZJblhiVGpUNlVTdVp3aGpqbkN5TkdFZnROTjQwRnhMMg?oc=5), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/turkey-raids-another-opposition-tv-channel-appoints-trustees-to-take-over-operations/articleshow/135918473.cms) reported that Turkish authorities raided Sozcu TV's headquarters, detained executives, and appointed trustees.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/turkish-court-appoints-trustee-to-opposition-mouthpiece-sozcu-tv/news) reported that Turkish prosecutors ordered the detention of four company executives and authorized searches at the offices of Sözcü newspaper and SZC TV.

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/dva-fonda-intesa-invest-izlozena-u-alta-banci-direktor-otkrio-sta-su-ga-prvo-pitali/14wn1n1) reported that Intesa Invest funds had a cumulative exposure of less than 1 percent toward Alta banka according to executive director Srdjan Maletic.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/banka-postanska-stedionica-produzen-rad-zbog-isplate-depozita-alta-banke-termin/4mt6466) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica extended working hours for branches handling insured deposit payouts to Alta banka clients, with 16,450 clients having scheduled appointments.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-u-alta-banci-prijavilo-se-14-419-klijenata/) reported that 14,419 clients applied for payouts up to 50,000 euros per depositor.

stories.title: IMF Loan Review and Financial Discussions for Ukraine

reports.text: On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4186713-government-directs-additional-uah-814-bln-to-urgent-defense-ministry-needs.html) reported that the Cabinet of Ministers allocated an additional 81.4 billion Ukrainian hryvnias for the urgent needs of the Ministry of Defense.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1088950/eu-sprema-novu-finansijsku-injekciju-ukrajini-planirano-dodatnih-45-milijardi-eura-za-2027-godinu) reported that the European Union is preparing an additional financial injection of 45 billion euros for Ukraine for 2027, split into a 20 billion euro loan and another portion.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90303) reported that the IMF made major progress in talks with Ukraine on the second and third reviews of its $8.1 billion loan program, bringing $1.6 billion in aid closer.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/herzog-issues-rare-rebuke-of-arab-activists-election-day-arrests/000001a1-efa5-d381-ade5-efe555d40000) reported that Isaac Herzog made remarks during an official visit to Kafr Manda regarding the police arrest of Arab activists on Election Day.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/former-israeli-president-apologizes-to-arab-activist-arrested-on-election-day/000001a1-ea2f-d3ad-a5e3-ebffb1160000) reported that former Israeli President Reuven Rivlin telephoned United Arab List activist Seaf Abu Reash to apologize for his arrest on Election Day.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/police-to-review-their-conduct-after-arrest-of-arab-activists-on-election-day/000001a1-e3d4-df03-a3ad-fbdfd6f90000) reported that Israel's deputy police chief will submit a report within a week after reviewing the arrest and investigation of United Arab List activists.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/arab-leaders-urge-probe-into-netanyahu-offices-role-in-election-related-arrests/000001a1-e4ca-d294-a7bd-fdff55660000) reported that Arab party leaders called for an investigation into the prime minister's office role in the Election Day arrests.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/report-source-for-arab-parties-election-fraud-claims-was-ex-netanyahu-employee/000001a1-e09b-dfb8-adfd-ecbf384c0000) reported that a former Netanyahu aide referred Israeli police to a source claiming information about three United Arab List activists, leading to their arrest on Election Day.
